yajñena | vardhata | jātavedasam | agnim | yajadhvam | haviṣā | tanā | girā | samidhānam | suprayasam | svaḥbharam | dyukṣam | hotāram | vṛjaneṣu | dhṛṣadam || 1 ||
he yajamānā ṛtvijo vā yūyaṃ 'jātavedasaṃ jātānāṃ veditāraṃ jātadhanaṃ jātaprajñaṃ vā 'agniṃ 'yajñena yāgena 'vardhata pravardhata |
agnipāṭave sati śārīraṃ balaṃ bhavatīti prasiddham ||
abhi tvā naktīruṣaso vavāśire'dha vṛtsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ |
divaivedaratirmānuṣā yugā kṣapo bhāsi puruvāra saṃyataḥ ||
abhi | tvā | naktīḥ | upasaḥ | vavāśire | agne | vatsam | na | svasareṣu | dhenavaḥ | divaḥ'iva | it | aratiḥ | mānuṣā | yugā | ā | kṣapaḥ | bhāsi | puruvāra | sam'yataḥ ||2||
yadvā naktaśabdaḥ sāyaṃ kālaṃ lakṣayati sāyaṃprātarabhihotrasya sadbhāvāt |
sarveṣu kāleṣu sāyaṃprātaḥ- kāleṣu vā 'vavāśire ākāṃkṣante yajamānā yaṣṭum |
yadvā ahāni rātrayaśca tvāmeva kāmayante hotṛm |
'svasareṣu svayaṃ saraṇaśīlaḥvahaḥsu sukhasaraṇādhikaraṇeṣu' goṣṭheṣu vā 'dhenavaḥ 'vatsaṃ 'na vatsamiba |
kiṃca he 'puruvāra bahubhirvarṇīyāgne 'saṃyataḥ niyatastvaṃ 'divaiva dyulokasyeva 'aratiḥ vyāpto vistṛtaḥ |
tatratyānāṃ devānāṃ haviḥ- pradānāyaiva sarvatra vyāpta ityarthaḥ |
1. ma-pravardhata | 2. tha-ma-dhṛṣadaṃ tam | 3. ma-śarīrasya balaṃ bhavati hi siddham | 4. ka-ja-ṇa- 1 ma-sarveṣu | 5. va-mukhaśaraṇādhikaraṇeṣu | 6. ka-ṇa-na-ma- mānuṣāṇām | ka. 2
taṃ devā budhe rajasaḥ sudaṃsasaṃ divaspṛthivyoriti nyeriraṃ |
rathamiva vedyaṃ śukraśociṣamagniṃ mitraṃ na kṣitiṣu praśaṃstyam ||
taṃ | devāḥ | budhe | rajasaḥ | su'daṃsasam | divaḥ | pṛthivyoḥ | aratim | ni | erira | ratham'iva | vedyam | śukra'śociṣam | agnim | mitram | na | kṣitiṣu | pra'śaṃstyam ||3||
‘taṃ prasiddham uktaguṇaviśiṣṭamagniṃ ‘devāḥ prasiddhā vyavahāra ṛtvijo vā ‘rajasaḥ rajnātmakasya lokasya ‘budhe mūle |
‘sudaṃsasaṃ śobhanadarśanaṃ ‘divampṛthivyoḥ dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ ‘aratim īśvaraṃ gantāraṃ vyāsaṃ vā |
yadvā rathamiva prāptisādhanatvena vartamānaṃ vedyaṃ veditavyam |
tamukṣamāṇaṃ rajasi sva ā dame candramiva suruceṃ dvāra ā dadhuḥ |
pṛnyāḥ pataraṃ citayantamukṣabhiḥ pātho na pāyuṃ janasī ubhe anu ||
tam | ukṣamāṇam | rajasi | sve | ā | dame | candram'iva | su'rucam | dvāre | ā | dadhuḥ | pṛnyāḥ | pataram | citayantam | akṣadbhiḥ | pāthaḥ | na | pāyam | janasī iti | ubhe iti | anu || 4 ||
‘taṃ stutyataraṃ ‘rajasi antarikṣe ‘ā ‘ukṣamāṇaṃ sarvataḥ siñcantaṃ vṛṣṭi jalaṃ rajasi pṛthivyāṃ vedyāṃ ghṛtādinā āsicyamānaṃ vā |
bhūmyāṃ homādhāratvena sthitvā haviṣprāpaṇāya dyulokagābhinamiti bhāvaḥ |

sa hotā viśvaṃ pari̭ bhūtvadhvaraṃ tamṷ havyairmanṷṣa ṛñjate girā | hiri̭śipro vṛdhasā̭nāsu jarbhura॒dyaurna stṛbhi̭ścitaya॒droda̭sī anṷ || 5 || saḥ | hotā | viśvam | pari̭ | bhūtu | adhvaram | tam | ū~ iti | havyaiḥ | manṷṣaḥ | ṛñjate | girā | hiri̭'śipraḥ | vṛdhasā̭nāsu | jarbhurat | dyauḥ | na | stṛbhiḥ | citayat | roda̭sī iti | anṷ ||5||
^saḥ agniḥ ^hotā homaniṣpādakaḥ san ^viśvaṃ sarvam ^adhvaraṃ yāgaṃ ^pari ^bhūtu parito bhavatu |
^tamu tamevāgniṃ ^havyaiḥ havirbhiḥ ^girā stutyā ca ^manuṣaḥ manuṣyāḥ ^ṛñjate pramādyanti |
‘śiprāḥ śīrṣasu vitatā hiraṇyayīḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 5. 54. 11 ) ityādi mantrāntarāt |

sa nau reva̭ntsamadhaḥ svastayḙ saṃda॒dasvā॒trayi̭masmāsṷ dīdihi | ā na̭: kṛṇuṣva suvi॒tāya̭ roda̭sī a॒gne ha॒vyā ma̭nu॒ṣo de॒va vī॒tayḙ || 6 || saḥ | naḥ | reva̭t | sam'idhānaḥ | svastayḙ | sam'dadasvān | rayim | asmāsṷ | dīdihi | ā | naḥ | kṛṇuṣva | suvi॒tāya̭ | roda̭sī iti | a॒gne | ha॒vyā | ma̭nu॒ṣaḥ | de॒va | vī॒tayḙ ||6||
^revan rayiman ^rayiṃ dhanaṃ uparyuparivṛddhimānayogyaṃ vā dhanam ^asmāsu ^saṃdadasvān samyak prayacchan ^samidhānaḥ asmābhiḥ samyagdhyamānaḥ san ^dīdihi dīpyasva |
tathābhūtaḥ san ^naḥ asmabhyaṃ ^suvitāya suhitāya śobhanaphalāya ^rodasī dyāvā- pṛthivyau ^ā ^kṛṇuṣva sarvataḥ kuruṣva |
he ^deva ^agne ^manuṣaḥ manuṣyasya yajamānasya mama sambandhīni ^havyā havīṃṣi ^vītaye devebhyo bhakṣaṇāya |

dā nau a̭gne bṛha॒to dāḥ sa̭hasriṇo॒ duro॒ na vā॒jaṃ śru॒tyai a॒rpā vṛ̭dhi | prācī॒ dyāvā̭pṛthivī bra॒hmaṇā̭ kṛdhi॒ svaḥ na̭ śuka॒muṣo॒ vi di̭dyutaḥ || 7 || dāḥ | naḥ | a̭gne | bṛha॒taḥ | dāḥ | sa̭hasriṇaḥ | duraḥ | na | vā॒jam | śru॒tyai | a॒rpā | vṛ̭dhi | prācī̭ | dyāvā̭pṛthivī iti | bra॒hmaṇā̭ | kṛdhi | svaḥ | na | śuka̭m | u॒ṣasa̭ḥ | vi | di̭dyutaḥ ||7||
he ᵛagne ᵛnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵛbṛhataḥ mahataḥ prabhūtān gavāśvādidhanaviśeṣān ᵛdāḥ dehi |
tathā ᵛsahasriṇaḥ sahasrasaṃkhyopetān putrabhṛtyādīn ᵛdāḥ dehi ||
ᵛśrutyai kīrye ᵛvājam annaṃ ᵛduro ᵛna tasya dvāraṇyapi |
tadarthaṃ ᵛdyāvāpṛthivī ᵛbrahmaṇā parivṛḍhena karmaṇā ᵛprācī prakṛṣṭājñane asmadanukūle ᵛkṛdhi kuru |
ᵛśukraṃ dīptaṃ ᵛtvām ᵛupamaḥ upaḥkālāḥ ᵛvi ᵛdiśyutaḥ vidyotayanti |

sa idhāna upaso rāmyā anu svarna dīdedaruṣeṇa bhānunā | hotrābhiragniramanuṣaḥ svadhvaro rājā viśāmatithiścārurāyavai || 8 || saḥ | idhānaḥ | upasaḥ | rāmyāḥ | anu | svaḥ | na | dīdet | aruṣeṇa | bhānunā | hotrābhiḥ | agniḥ | manuṣaḥ | su'adhvaraḥ | rājā | viśām | atithiḥ | cāruḥ | āyavai ||8||
ᵛsaḥ agniḥ ᵛrāmyāḥ ramaṇahetubhūtāḥ ᵛupasaḥ ᵛanu anulakṣya ᵛidhānaḥ idhyamānoḥ dīpitaḥ man ᵛaruṣeṇa rocamānena ᵛbhānunā tejasā ᵛsvarṇa āditya iva ᵛdīdet dīpyate |
saḥ ᵛagniḥ ᵛmanuṣaḥ manuṣyasya hotuḥ ᵛhotrābhiḥ |
homasādhanabhūtābhiḥ stutibhiḥ stūyamānaḥ ᵛsvadhvaraḥ śobhanayāgaḥ ᵛviśāṃ prajānāṃ ᵛrājā rājamānaḥ svāmī ᵛāyave manuṣyāya yajamānāya tadarthaṃ ᵛcāruḥ caraṇaśīlaḥ ᵛatithiḥ atithirvatpūjyo bhavati ||

evā nau agne amṛteṃṣu pūrvya dhīṣpīpāya bṛhadiveṣu mānuṣā | duhānā dhenurvṛjaneṣu kārave tmanā śatinaṃ pururūpamirṣaṇi || 9 || eva | naḥ | agne | amṛteṣu | pūrvya | dhīḥ | pīpāya | bṛhat'diveṣu | mānuṣā | duhānā | dhenuḥ | vṛjaneṣu | kārave | tmanā | śatinam | pururūpam | irṣaṇi || 9 ||
ᵛbṛhadiveṣu prabhūtadyutiṣu ᵛamṛteṣu deveṣu madhye he ᵛpūrvya pūrvabhāvinan ᵛagne tvāṃ ᵛmānuṣā manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye ᵛnaḥ asmadīyā ᵛdhīḥ buddhiḥ stutiḥ karma vā ᵛeva evaṃ ᵛpīpāya pyāyayati |
yadvā mānuṣā manuṣyān ᵛdhīstvadīyā buddhiḥ karma vā pyāyayatu |
tathā tvadīyā dhīḥ ᵛvṛjaneṣu yajñeṣu ᵛkārave stotre ᵛduhānā ᵛdhenuḥ |
ᵛtmanā ātmanaiva ᵛirṣaṇi eṣaṇāyāṃ satyāṃ ᵛśatinam aparimitasaṃkhyākaṃ ᵛpururūpaṃ gavāśvādi rūpeṇa nānārūpaṃ dhanasamūhaṃ duhānā bhavati ||
vyama̭gne arva̭tā vā su॒vīrya̭ṃ bra॒hmaṇā̭ vā ci॒tayḙmā॒ janā̭~ a॒ti |
a॒smāka̭ṃ yu॒gmamadhi̭ pa॒śca kṛ॒ṣṭi॒ṣvā sva॒rṇaṃ śṷśucīta du॒stara̭m ||
vyam | a॒gne | arva̭tā | vā | su॒vīrya̭m | bra॒hmaṇā̭ | vā | ci॒tayḙma | janā̭n | a॒ti | a॒smāka̭m | yu॒gmam | adhi̭ | pa॒śca | kṛ॒ṣṭi॒ṣu | u॒ccā | sva̭ḥ | na | śṷśucīta | du॒stara̭m ||10||
he 'gne 'vayaṃ yajamānāḥ 'suvīryaṃ śobhanasāmadhyopetaṃ yathā tathā 'arvatā 'vā araṇakuśalenāśvena |
'brahmaṇā 'vā agnena ca tvaddhattena 'janān asmayamānān 'ati 'citayema atikramya jñāyemahi |
yadvā tvaddhattenāśvena ca suvīryaṃ citayema prakāśayema |
tadartham 'asmākaṃ 'pañca pañcasu 'kṛṣṭiṣu janeṣu nipādapañcameṣu caturṣu varṇeṣu 'uccā uccairtiprabhūtaṃ 'dustaram anyenā- prāptaṃ 'yugmaṃ dhanaṃ 'svarṇa sūrya ivādhikaṃ 'śuśucīta dīpyatām |
sa naṷ bodhi saha̭sya pra॒śaṃsyo॒ yasmi̭nsa॒sujā̭tā i॒ṣya̭nta॒ sūrya̭: |
yama̭gne ya॒jñamupa̭yanti vā॒jino॒ nityḙ to॒ke dī̭di॒vāṃ sre damḙ ||
saḥ | naḥ | bodhi | saha̭sya | pra॒śaṃsya̭: | yasmi̭n | su॒jā̭tāḥ | i॒ṣya̭nta | sūrya̭: | yam | a॒gne | ya॒jñam | upa̭yanti | vā॒jina̭: | nityḙ | to॒ke | dī॒di॒vāṃsa̭m | sve | damḙ ||11||
he agne 'sahasya śatrūṇāmabhibhavitarbalaprabhava vā 'praśaṃsyaḥ stutyaḥ 'saḥ tvaṃ 'naḥ asmadīyaṃ stotrādikaṃ 'bodhi budhyasva |
'yasmin agnau 'sujātāḥ śobhanajananāḥ 'sūryaḥ stotāra ṛtvijaḥ 'iṣyanta gamayanti stotrāṇi |
kiṃca he 'agne 'yajñaṃ yajanīyaṃ 'yaṃ 'vājinaḥ havirlakṣaṇānnavanto yajamānāḥ 'nitye 'toke aurase putre nimittabhūte sati |
putragṛhe yathā pitā dīpyate tadvat 'sve 'dame svakīye yāgagṛhe savanīyādisthāne 'dīdivāṃsaṃ dīpyamānam 'upayanti haviḥstotrādinā |
u॒bhayā̭so jātavedaḥ syāma te sto॒tāro̭ agne॒ sūrya̭śca śa॒rmaṇi̭ |
va॒svo rā॒yaḥ purṷścandrasya bhū॒yasa̭ḥ pra॒jāva̭taḥ sva॒patya̭sya śa॒gdhi na̭ḥ ||
u॒bhayā̭saḥ | jā॒ta'vḙdaḥ | syāma̭ | te | sto॒tāra̭: | a॒gne | sūrya̭: | ca | śa॒rmaṇi̭ | va॒sva̭ḥ | rā॒yaḥ | purṷ'candrasya | bhū॒yasa̭ḥ | pra॒jā'va̭taḥ | su॒'apa̭tyasya | śa॒gdhi | na̭ḥ ||12||
he 'jātavedaḥ jātānāṃ veditaḥ 'agne 'stotāraḥ tvāṃ stuvanta ṛtvijaḥ 'sūryaḥ medhāvino yajamānāḥ 'ca iti 'ubhayāsaḥ ubhaye vayaṃ 'śarmaṇi sukhe nimittabhūte sati 'te tvatsaṃbaṃdhinaḥ 'syāma bhavema |
gavādinadhanasya ᵥpuruṣandrasya atiśayenāhrādakasya bahuhiraṇyopetasya vā ᵥbhūyasaḥ prabhūtasya ᵥprajāvataḥ bhṛtyādyupetasya putrādibhogaparyāptasya vā ᵥsvapatyasya śobhanaputrasya |
īdṛgrūpaṃ dhanaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥśagdhi dehi |
asmāśca tāṃśca pra hi neṣi vasva ā bṛhaddema vidarthe suvīrāḥ ||
ye | stotṛbhyaḥ | go'agrām | arśa'peśasam | agne | rātim | upa'sṛjanti | sūrayaḥ | asmān | ca | tān | ca | pra | hi | neṣi | vasvaḥ | ā | bṛhat | vadema | vidarthe | su'vīrāḥ ||13||
‘ samiddho agniḥ ’ ityekādaśarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ gārtsamadaṃ trai

vnarāśaṃsa: narairnaitubhi: ṛtvigbhi:1 śaṃsanīya: etannāmako'gni: vsvarci: śobhanajvāla: san vdhāmāni sthānānyāhutyadhikaraṇāni tejāṃsi vprati pratyekaṃ vmahā svamahimnā vajann vyaktīkurvan vtisro vdiva: dyotamānānbhīn bhūmyādilokāṃśca vprati pratyekamajann |
yadvā lokānāṃ pratyekaṃ tritvopetatvāt tisro diva ityaviruddham |
‘tisro diva: pṛthivīstitta:’ (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 54. 5) ityādimantravarṇāt ‘trayo vā ime trivṛto lokā:’ (ai. brā. 2. 17) iti brāhmaṇānca |
tathā vghṛtaprapā ghṛtaṃ siñcatā vmanasā vhavyam vundan kledayan vsribhīkurvan vyajñasya vmūrdhan mūrdhani sugdhe homasamaye vdevān yakṣyan vsamant samyak vyaktīkarotu |
īḻito agne manasā no aheṃndrevānyakṣi mānupātpūrvā adya |
sa ā vaha marutāṃ śardho acyutamindraṃ naro barhiṣadaṃ yajadhvam |
īḻita: | agne | manasā | na: | aheṃn | devān | yakṣi | mānupāt | pūrva: | adya | sa: | ā | vaha | marutām | śardha: | acyutam | indram | nara: | barhiṣadam | yajadhvam ||3||

he vagne vīḻita: asmābhi: snuta: san vmanasā asmadanuraktena devānāṃ yāgabuddhyā vā vahan yāgayogya: san vmānupāt hotṛ: vpūrva: pūrvabhāvī vna: asmadartham vadya asmin dine vdevān yakṣyan vyakṣa tvameva yajasi |
vsa: tādṛśo yajñā tvam vā vaha ākāraya |
anantaraṃ he vnara: netāra ṛtvija: vbarhiṣadaṃ barhiṣi sīdantaṃ tamindraṃ vyajadhvaṃ pūjayadhvam |
deva barhirvardhamānaṃ suvīraṃ stīrṇaṃ rāye subharaṃ vedyasyām |
ghṛtenāktaṃ vasava: sīdatedaṃ viśve devā ādityā yajñiyāsa: |
devaṃ | barhi: | vardhamānam | suvīram | stīrṇam | rāye | subharam | vedyasyām | ghṛtena | aktam | vasava: | sīdata | idam | viśve | devā: | ādityā: | yajñiyāsa: ||4||
he vbarhi: vdeva etadabhimāninne vvardhamānaṃ vsuvīraṃ śobhanavīrasaṃpādakaṃ vsubharaṃ supūrṇaṃ vstīrṇam asmadīyairṛtvigbhistṛtaṃ bhava |
vghṛtena ājyena vaktam idaṃ snigdhaṃ barhi: vsīdata |
vyajñiyāsa: yajñārhaste yūyamidaṃ barhirnipīdata asmin barhiṣi nigīdatetyartha: |

vi śrayantāmurviyā hayamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā namobhiḥ | vyacasvatīrvi prathantāmajūryā varṇaṃ punānā yaśasaṃ suvīram || vi | śrayantām | urviyā | hayamānāḥ | dvāraḥ | devīḥ | supra'ayanāḥ | namo'bhiḥ | vyacasvatīḥ | vi | prathantām | ajūryāḥ | varṇam | punānā | yaśasam | su'vīram || 5 ||
vi śrayantāṃ vivicya śrayantāṃ vivṛtāpidhānā bhavantu |

ajūryāḥ ahiṃsyā ajananā vā suvīraṃ śobhanaputrādyupetaṃ yaśasaṃ yaśoyuktaṃ varṇaṃ varṇanīyaṃ rūpaviśeṣaṃ punānā yajamānāya śodhayitryaḥ saṃpādayitryo devyaḥ vi prathantāṃ viśeṣeṇa prakhyātā bhavantu ||

sādhvapāṃsi sanatā na ukṣite upāsanaktā vyayaiva raṇvite | tantuṃ tataṃ saṃvayantī sabhīcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudughe paryasvatī || 6 || sādhu | apāṃsi | sanatā | naḥ | ukṣite iti | upasānaktā | vyayā'iva | raṇvite iti | tantum | tatam | saṃvayantī iti sam'vayantī | samīcī iti sam'īcī | yajñasya | peśaḥ | sudughe iti su'dughe | paryasvatī iti | paryasvatī || 6 ||
sādhu sādhūni naḥ asmadyāni apāṃsi karmāṇihyisya manatā sanātanaināvicchinnapravṛttikena stotrādinā ukṣite pūjite |

upā- sānaktā ahorātradevate vayayāiva vānakuśale iva raṇvite śabdite snute parasparaṃ gacchantyau vā tataṃ vistṛtaṃ tantuṃ tantusthānīyaṃ yajñāyavayaṃ saṃvayantī samyak citraṃ saha vā vayantyāvutpādayitryau samīcī samyakpravṛttike parasparānukūle |
yajñasya anuṣṭhīyamānasya peśaḥ rūpaṃ nirmātumiti śeṣaḥ |
sudughe suṣṭhu phalasya dogdhyau paryasvatī udakavatyau |

daivyā hotārā prathamā viduṣṭara ṛju yakṣataḥ samrucā vapuṣṭarā | devānyajaṃtāvatuthā samañjato nābhā pṛthivyā adhi sānuṣu triṣu || 7 || daivyā | hotārā | prathamā | viduḥ'tarā | ṛju | yakṣataḥ | sam | ṛcā | vapuḥ'tarā | devān | yajantau | ṛtu'thā | sam | añjata: | nābhā | pṛthivyāḥ | adhi | sānuṣu | triṣu ||7||

tasmāddivādaprerjātau ^hotārā āhvātārī devānāṃ homa- niṣpādakau vā agnī pārthivāntarikṣayau ^prathamā prathamaṃ ^yaṣṭavyau ^viduṣṭarā viduttamau ^vapuṣṭarā prakṛṣṭa- vapuṣau devau ^ṛcā mantreṇa ^ṛju avikalaṃ yathā tathā samyak ^yakṣataḥ pūjayataḥ |
^ṛtuthā tattadṛtau tatra tatra kāle ^devān yaṣṭyān ^yajantau ^devau ^pṛthivyāḥ ^nābhā nābhāvuttaravedyām ^adhi upari ^triṣu ^sānupa samucchriteṣu pradeśeṣu gārhapatyādiṣu ^samañjataḥ samāktām ||
sarasvatī sādhayantī dhiyaṃ na iḻā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ |
tisro devīḥ svadhayā barhiredamicchidraṃ pāntu śaraṇaṃ niṣadya ||
sarasvatī | sādhayantī | dhiyam | naḥ | iḻā | devī | bhāratī | viśvatūrtiḥ | tisraḥ | devīḥ | svadhayā | barhiḥ | ā | idam | acchidram | pāntu | śaraṇam | niṣadya || 8 ||
^naḥ asmadīyāṃ ^dhiyaṃ buddhiṃ yāgaṃ vā ^sādhayanto nirvartayantī ^sarasvatī^3 etannāmikeyaṃ devī tathā ^iḻā ^devī ^bhāratī ca ^viśvatūrtiḥ viśvāni tṛṇāni yasyāḥ sā tādṛśī sarvaviṣayagatā vāk |
^tisro ^devīḥ etāstisro devyaḥ ^svadhayā asmaddhaviṣā nimittena ^idaṃ ^barhiḥ yajñam ^acchidraṃ yathā tathā ^pāntu pālayantu |
svadhayā idaṃ barhiḥ imaṃ yajñamāgadhyāsmadīyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gṛhaṃ nipadyācchidraṃ yathā tathā pāntu ||
atha 'piśaṅgarūpaḥ' iti navamī tvāṣṭre paśau puroḍāśasya yājyā |
'piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ prathamabhājaṃ yaśasaṃ vayodhām' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti sūtritatvāt |
piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ śruṣṭī vīro jāyate devakāmaḥ |
prajāṃ tvaṣṭā vi ṣyatu nābhiṃasme arthā devānāmpyaitu pārthaḥ ||
piśaṅgarūpaḥ | subharaḥ | vayaḥdhāḥ | śruṣṭī | vīraḥ | jāyate | devakāmaḥ | pra'jām | tvaṣṭā | vi | syatu | nābhim | asme iti | arthā | devānām | arpi | etu | pārthaḥ || 9 ||

^piśaṅgarūpaḥ suvarṇavarṇo nānārūpo vā ^subharaḥ śobhanayajñaḥ śobhanabharaṇo vā ^vayodhāḥ vayaso'nnasya dhārayitā dātā vā ^śruṣṭī kṣipraguṇaḥ ^vīraḥ vividhamīrayitā ^devakāmaḥ devāḥ kāmyante yena tādṛśaḥ ^putraḥ ^jāyate jāyatāmupadyatāṃ tvaṣṭuranugrahāt |
sa ca ^tvaṣṭā etannāmako devaḥ ^asme asmabhyaṃ ^nābhi kulasya bandhikāṃ ^prajāṃ putrādirūpāṃ ^vi ^ṣyatu vimuñcatu vitaratvityarthaḥ |
^atha api ca ^devānāṃ sambandha ^pāthaḥ annam ^api asmān ^etu gacchatu |

1. ma-va-prathamayaṣṭavyau | 2. ka-jha-jha-1-ma-yajantī pūjayantī | 3. kha-ga-ṇa-dha-na-va-sarasvatī etannāmikā devī bhāratī ca | 4. ta-navamīpāṭhastu | 5. jha-1-ṇa-ta-tha-na-va-tādṛśaḥ | īdṛśaḥ | ka. 2-3

^agniḥ pākādhāro'gniśca ^haviḥ paśurūpaṃ ^dhībhiḥ karmabhiḥ viśeṣaiḥ pākasādhanaiḥ prakarṣeṇa ^sūdayāti kṣārayati |

kiṃca <sup>v</sup>jātavedāḥ jātānāṃ veditā <sup>v</sup>yaḥ <sup>v</sup>devaḥ agniḥ <sup>v</sup>mitrahva sakheva āditya iva vā <sup>v</sup>didhiṣāyyaḥ dhārayitā <sup>v</sup>bhūta bhavati |

imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe dvidādadhṛrbhṛgavo viśviāyoḥ | eṣa viśvānyabhyastu bhūmā devānāṃmagniraratirjīrāśvaḥ || 2 || imam | vidhantaḥ | apām | sadha'sthe | dvidā | adadhuḥ | bhṛgavaḥ | viśvi | āyoḥ | eṣaḥ | viśvāni | agni | astu | bhūma | devānām | agniḥ | aratiḥ | jīra'aśvaḥ || 2 ||

<sup>v</sup>imam agniṃ <sup>v</sup>vidhantaḥ paricarantaḥ <sup>v</sup>bhṛgavaḥ asmatpūrve maharṣayaḥ <sup>v</sup>apāṃ <sup>v</sup>sadhasthe sahasthāne antarikṣe <sup>v</sup>āyoḥ manuṣyasya yajamānasya svabhūtāsu <sup>v</sup>viśva prajāsu viśvi teṣāṃ madhye ca <sup>v</sup>dvitā dvayoḥ |
<sup>v</sup>eṣaḥ <sup>v</sup>agniḥ <sup>v</sup>bhūma bhūmnā anyarthaṃ <sup>v</sup>viśvāni bhūta- jātāni asmadvirodhīni <sup>v</sup>abhyastu abhibhāvatu |

agniṃ devāso mānuṣīṣu viśvi priyaṃ dhuḥ kṣedhyanto na mitram | sa dīdayaduśatīrūrmyā ā dākṣavyo yo dāsvate dama ā || 3 || agnim | devāsaḥ | mānuṣīṣu | viśvi | priyam | dhuḥ | kṣedhyantaḥ | na | mitram | saḥ | dīdayat | uśatīḥ | ūrmyāḥ | ā | dākṣavyaḥ | yaḥ | dāsvate | dame | ā || 3 ||

<sup>v</sup>devāsaḥ devāḥ <sup>v</sup>kṣedhyantaḥ svargaṃ prati gacchantaḥ santaḥ pūrvaṃ <sup>v</sup>mānuṣīṣu manuṣyasambandhinīṣu <sup>v</sup>viśvi prajāsu <sup>v</sup>priyaṃ devānāṃ prīṇayitāram agniṃ <sup>v</sup>dhuḥ adhuḥ sthāpitavantaḥ |

yadvā dvitā dvitvena vaidyutāmanāntarikṣaṃ yāgārthamṛtvikṣu vā adhārayan ; jha1-kṣityantarikṣayoḥ sthānayostu astāyamānam |
yadvā dvitā dvitvena vaidyutāmanāntarikṣe yāgārthamṛtvikṣu vādyadhuḥ adhārayan |
asya raṇvā svasyaiva puṣṭiḥ saṃdṭirasya hiyānasya dakṣoḥ |

kiṃca 1hiyānasya samṛddhiṃ gacchato vyāmuvataḥ 2dhakṣoḥ 2kāṣṭhān didhakṣordagdhumicchoḥ asya agreḥ 1saṃdṛṣṭiḥ saṃdarśanāvirbhāvo'pi raṇvā |

4saḥ agniḥ 4uśigbhyaḥ asmadīyaṃ rūpaṃ kāmayamānebhya ṛtvigbhyaḥ 4varṇaṃ svasadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ 4nāmimīta |

kiṃca 4yaḥ agniḥ 4jujurvān jīrṇaḥ san jvālopaśame sa eva 4muhuḥ punaḥ punaḥ 4ā 4yuvā sarvato miśrayitā taruṇo vā bhā 4bhūta ābhavati punarājyādisaṃyogāt ||

kha-ga-yadvā asyāmeḥ saṃbandhini puṣṭyarthā yajamānaviṣayā raṇvā tadvat |

ā yo vanā̭ tātṛṣā॒ṇo na bhāti॒ vārṇa pathā॒ radhyai̭va svānīt | kṛṣṇādhvā॒ tapṷ̄ ra॒ṇvaści̭keta॒ dyauri̭va smarya॒māno॒ nabho̭bhiḥ || 6 || ā | yaḥ | vanā̭ | tatṛ̭ṣāṇaḥ | na | bhāti̭ | vāḥ | na | pathā̭ | radhyā̭'iva | svānīt | kṛṣṇa'adhvā | tapūḥ | raṇvaḥ | ci̭keta | dyauḥ'iva | smarya॒mānaḥ | nabha̭ḥ'bhiḥ || 6 ||
kiṃca ^vāṇaṃ udakamiva ^pathā pravaṇena mārgeṇa gacchati tadvat itastato gacchati |
yathā ratho yuddhamārgeṇa gacchan svanati tadvat |

nīlavarṇāntarikṣaryādiśyo yathā jñāyate tadvat ^svasaṃcāreṇa kṛṣṇībhūte mārge jñāyate |

sa yo vyasthā̭dabhi da̭kṣadu॒rvī pa॒śunai̭ti॒ svayṷrago॒pāḥ | agniḥ śoci̭ṣmā~ a॒tasā̭nyuṣṇa॒nkṛṣṇa॒vyathi̭rasvada॒yanna bhūma̭ || 7 || saḥ | yaḥ | tri | asthāt | abhi | dhakṣat | urvīm | pa॒śuḥ | na | eti | svayuḥ | ago॒pāḥ | agniḥ | śoci̭ṣmān | a॒tasā̭ni | uṣṇan | kṛṣṇa'vyathiḥ | asvada॒yat | na | bhūma̭ || 7 ||
yathā jātaḥ ^paśuḥ svacchandena carati tathā ^svayuḥ svayameva gacchan ^agopāḥ goparahitaḥ ^ |
^śociṣmān prakṛṣṭadīptiḥ ^kṛṣṇavyathiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ prāptā dagdhā vyathākarāḥ kaṇṭakādayo yena tādṛśaḥ san ^bhūma atyadhikam ^asvadayat āsvādayatīva vṛkṣagatāna rasān |

nū tḙ pū॒rvyāva̭so॒ adhī̭tau tṛtī॒ye vi॒dathe॒ manma̭ śaṃsi | a॒sme a̭gne॒ saṃya̭dvīraṃ bṛha॒ntaṃ kṣuma̭ntaṃ vā॒jaṃ svapa̭tyaṃ ra॒yiṃ dāḥ || 8 || nu | te | pū॒rvyasya | ava̭saḥ | ardhi'itau | tṛtī॒ye | vi॒dathḙ | manma̭ | śaṃsi | a॒sme iti̭ | a॒gne | saṃya̭t'vīram | bṛha̭ntam | kṣu'mantam | vā॒jam | su'apatyam | ra॒yim | dāḥ ||8||

he agne ᵥte tava saṃbandhinḥ ᵥpūrvasya pūrvaṃ yāgasamaye kṛtasya ᵥavasaḥ abhimatatarpaṇasya ᵥadhītau smaraṇe sati tatsmṛtyā ᵥnu adyāpi ᵥtṛtīye ᵥvidathe yāge tṛtīyasavane |

he ᵥagne tvaṃ ca ᵥasme asmabhyaṃ ᵥsaṃyadvīraṃ saṃyato vīrā yasmin tādṛśaṃ ᵥbṛhantaṃ mahāntaṃ ᵥkṣumantaṃ śabdavantaṃ kīrtimantaṃ ᵥvājam uktalakṣaṇamannaṃ ᵥsvapatyaṃ ᵥrayiṃ ca ᵥdāḥ dehi ||
tvayā yathā gṛtsamadāsau agne guhā vanvantu uparāṃ abhi pyuḥ |
suvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ smatsūribhyo gṛṇate tadvayo dhāḥ ||
tvayā | yathā | gṛtsa'madāsaḥ | agne | guhā | vanvantaḥ | uparān | abhi | syuḥ | iti syuḥ | su'vīrāsaḥ | abhimāti'sahaḥ | smat | sūribhyaḥ | gṛṇate | tat | vayaḥ | dhāḥ || 9 ||
he ᵥagne ᵥtvayā rakṣakeṇa ᵥvanvantaḥ chāndasaṃ' bhajantaṃ' gṛtsamadā ṛṣayaḥ |
ᵥyathā ᵥguhā guhāyāṃ vartamānān ᵥuparān uparamaṇasādhanān upari utkṛṣṭe vartamānānvā dhanaviśeṣān ᵥabhi ᵥsyuḥ abhibhaveyuḥ |

sūtritaṃ ca—'agnāyo hotājaniṣṭa' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti |
hotā | ajaniṣṭa | cetanaḥ | pitā | pitṛ'bhyaḥ | ūtaye | pra'yakṣjñeyam | vasu | śakema | vājinaḥ | yamam || 1 ||
ᵥhotā homaniṣpādakaḥ ᵥcetanaḥ cetayitā'smadadhiṣṭhitasya ᵥpitā pālaka'smadyajñasya īdṛśo'gniḥ ᵥajaniṣṭa utpannaḥ |
vayaṃ ca ᵥvājinaḥ havirlakṣaṇānnavantaḥ santaḥ ᵥprayakṣaṃ prakarṣeṇa pūjyaṃ ᵥjenyaṃ jetavyaṃ ᵥyamaṃ yama- yitavyaṃ3 ᵥvasu dhanaṃ ᵥśakema |
yadvā vājino'jñasya yamaṃ yamanaṃ kartuṃ śakema |
ā | yasmin | sapta | raśmayaḥ | tatāḥ | yajñasya | netari | manuṣbat | daivyam | aṣṭamam | potā | viśvam | tat | invati || 2 ||

vtā: vāyuva: gandhyo vyāsā: vdhenava: prīṇayinya: vsvasāra: svayaṃ sāriṇyo'ṅgulaya: vneṣṭu: haviryāciturbhakṣayita: śodhayita: vpopayitu: vnetvā vasya agre: |
vtisṛbhya vā gārhapatyādimūrtīnāmapi vvaraṃ vvarṇaṃ vkuvit bahukṛtva: vsacanta sevante |
yadi | mātuḥ | upa | svasā | ghṛtam | bharantī | asthita | tāsām | adhvaryuḥ | āgatau | yavaḥ | vṛṣṭīva | modate || 6 ||

ᵥā ᵥsatsi āsīda ᵥcāsmin stīrṇe ᵥbarhiṣi |

yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |

he ᵥvṛṣabha abhimataphalavarṣakaᵂ haṃ ᵥagne ᵥtvaṃ ᵥdūtaḥ asmadīye yajñe ᵥdevāhānārthaṃ² dūtaṃ bhava |

tathā ca brāhmaṇam- 'agnirvai devānāṃ gopā agnimeva tatsarvato goptāraṃ paridatta ātmane ca yajamānāya ca' ( ai. brā. 1. 28 ) iti |

ᵥtvaṃ ᵥrayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ madhye ᵥrayipatiḥ uttamasya dhanasya patiḥ ᵥasi ᵥhi |
ᵥtvaṃ ᵥśukrasya dīptasya ᵥvacasaḥ asmadīyasya stotrasya ᵥmanotā prajñātā bhavasi |

śruyā agniścitrabhānurhave me viśvābhirgīrbhirāmṛto vicaitāḥ | śyāvā rathe vahato rohitā votāruṣāhe cakre vibhutraḥ || 2 || śruyāḥ | agniḥ | citrabhānaḥ | havam | me | viśvābhiḥ | gīḥ'bhiḥ | amṛtaḥ | vi'caitāḥ | śyāvā | ratham | vahataḥ | rohitā | vā | uta | aruṣā | aha | cakre | vi'bhṛtraḥ || 2 ||

uttānāyāmajanayantasūṣūtaṃ bhuvadagniḥ purupeśāsu garbhaḥ | śiriṇāyāṃ cidatkunā mahobhiraparīvṛto vasati pracetāḥ || 3 || uttānāyām | ajanayan | su'sūtam | bhuvat | agniḥ | purupeśāsu | garbhaḥ | śiriṇāyām | cit | atkunā | mahaḥ'bhiḥ | aparivṛtaḥ | vasati | pra'caitāḥ || 3 ||
^uttānāyām uttānaśayāyāmaṇyāṃ ^supūtam agnihotrārthaṃ suṣṭhu preritamagnim ^ajanayan adhva- rvāyadaya utpādayana |
tena tamasā ^aparīvṛtaḥ1 asaṃspṛṣṭaḥ ata eva ^mahobhiḥ tejobhiryuktaḥ ^pracetāḥ prakṛṣṭaprajñaḥ san ^vasati dīpyamāno vartate ||
jigharmyagniṃ haviṣā ghṛtena pratiśikṣayantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā |
pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ darśānam ||
jigharmi | agnim | haviṣā | ghṛtena | prati'kṣiyantam | bhuvanāni | viśvā | pṛthum | tiraścā | vayasā | bṛhantam | vyaciṣṭham
jñeyā bhāgaṃ sahasāno vareṇyaṃ tvād‌tāso manurvadema |
anūnamagniṃ juhvā vacasyā madhupṛcaṃ dhanasā johavīmi ||
jñeyāḥ | bhāgam | sahasānaḥ | vareṇyam | tvād‌tāsaḥ | manurvat | vadema | anūnam | agnim | juhvā | vacasyā | madhupṛcam | dhanasā | johavīmi || 6 ||
tena sahasānaḥ śatrūnabhibhavan tvaṃ bhāgaṃ bhajanīyaṃ stotraṃ jñeyāḥ jānīhi ||
yadvā tvayā preritā vayaṃ manurvat manuriva vadema stotraṃ brūmaḥ ||
tayā anūnaṃ saṃpūrṇa madhupṛcaṃ madhunā karmaphalena yajamānaṃ saṃyojayantam agniṃ dhanasā dhanasya saṃbhaktāhaṃ vacasyā stutika
^ukthaiḥ śastraiḥ ^vāvṛdhānastvaṃ ^dāsaṃ sarvarayopakṣapayitāram ^amartyaṃ ^cit maraṇadharmarahitamevātmānaṃ ^manyamānaṃ tamasuram ^avābhinat avāṅmukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā |

uktheṣvāśu śūra yeṣu ^cākanstomeśtvindra rudriyeṣu ca | tubhyedetā yāsu mandasānaḥ pra vāyavai sisrate na śubhrāḥ || 3 || uktheṣ | it | nu | śūra | yeṣu | cākan | stomeṣu | indra | rudriyeṣu | ca | tubhya | it | etāḥ | yāsu | mandasānaḥ | pra | vāyavai | sisrate | na | śubhrāḥ || 3 ||

^yāsu stotraśastrarūpāsu stutiṣu ^mandasānaḥ hṛṣyan bhavasi tāḥ ^etāḥ ^śubhrāḥ dīpyamānāḥ stutayaḥ ^vāyavai asmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ pratyāgacchate ^tubhyameva tubhyameva ^pra ^sisrate tvadarthameva prasaranti |

śubhraṃ nu te śubhraṃ vardhayantaḥ śubhraṃ vajraṃ bāhvordadhānāḥ | śubhrastvamindra vāvṛdhāno asme dāsīrviśaḥ sūryyaṇa sahyāḥ || 4 || śubhram | nu | te | śubhram | vardhayantaḥ | śubhram | vajram | bāhvoḥ | dadhānāḥ | śubhraḥ | tvam | indra | vavṛdhānaḥ | asme iti | dāsīḥ | viśaḥ | sūryyaṇa | sahyāḥ || 4 ||
he ^indra ^te tava ^śubhraṃ śobhanaṃ ^śubhraṃ balaṃ stotraiḥ ^vardhayantaḥ ^śubhraṃ dīptaṃ ^vajram āyudhaṃ ^nu kṣipraṃ tava ^bāhvordadhānāḥ nidadhānāḥ |
stūyamāno hi indraḥ asuravadhāya vajramādatta itītthaṃrūpeṇa^ āyudhaṃ nidadhānā bhavāmaḥ |
^vāvṛdhānaḥ stotraiḥ vardhamānaḥ ^śubhraḥ tejasā yuktaḥ ^tvaṃ ^asme asmākaṃ ^dāsīḥ upakṣapayitrīḥ ^viśaḥ āsurīḥ prajāḥ ^sūryyaṇa suṣṭhu prerakeṇa |

guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻahampsu ^dhṛṣṭaṃ māyinaṃ kṣiyantam | uto apo dyāṃ tastamvāṃsamahannahiṃ śūra vīryeṇa || 5 || guhā | hitam | guhyam | gūḻaham | apsu | arpi'vṛtam | māyinam | kṣiyantam | uto iti | apaḥ | dyām | tastamvāṃsam | ahan | ahim | śūra | vīryeṇa || 5 ||
he ^śūra indra ^guhā guhāyāṃ ^hitaṃ nihitaṃ ata eva ^guhyam aprakāiyaṃ ^gūḍhaṃ gūḍham ^apīvṛtaṃ tirohitam |

tādṛśaṃ ^māyinaṃ māyāvinamasuraṃ ^kṣiyantaṃ bhiva- santaṃ ^uto api ca ^apo ^yāṃ diyaṃ ca ^tastambhāṃsaṃ svasāmarthyena stambhayantam ^dṛṣṭabhūtam ^ahim asuraṃ meghaṃ vā ^vīryeṇa sāmarthyena vajreṇa ^ahan hatavānasi ||
stavā nu taṃ indra pūrvyā mahānyuta stavām nūtanā kṛtāni |
stavā vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ stavā harī sūryasya ketū ||
stave | nu | te | indra | pūrvyā | mahāni | uta | stavām | nūtanā | kṛtāni | stave | vajram | bāhvoḥ | uśantam | stave | harī iti | sūryasya | ketū iti || 6 ||
he ^indra ^pūrvyā purātanāni ^mahāni mahānti ^te tava karmāṇi ^nu kṣipaṃ ^staca stavāma |
kiṃca ^sūryasya suṣṭhu prerakasya suvīryasya vā sūryātmano vendrasya ^ketū prajñāpakau ^harī etannāmakāvaśvau ^stava stavāma ||
harī nu taṃ indra vājayantā ghṛtaśrutaṃ svāramasvāryam |
harī iti | nu | te | indra | vājayantā | ghṛtaśrutam | svāram | asvāryam | vi | samanā | bhūmiḥ | aprathiṣṭa | aresta | parvataḥ | cit | sariṣyan || 7 ||
^te tava ^harī etannāmakāvaśvau ^ghṛtaśrutaṃ ghṛtasyodakasya cyāvayitāraṃ ^svāraṃ meghadhvaniṃ ^su kṣipram ^asvāryam |
1. ka-eko dhātuḥ; ca-ekadhātoḥ; jha-ekavādako dhātuḥ; jha1-eko dhātuḥ; ṇa-ta-tha-na-ekā dhātuḥ;
dūre pāre vāṇīṃ vardhayanta indraiṣitāṃ dhamanaṃ praprathan ||
ni | parvata: | sādi | apra'yucchan | sam | mātṛbhi: | vāśāna: | akrān | dūre | pāre | vāṇīm | vardhayantaḥ | indra'iṣitām | dhamanam | praprathan | ni || 8 ||
ᵥaprayucchan apramādyan varṣaṇe sāvadhāna: ᵥparvata: megha: ᵥni ᵥpādi nabhasi nipaṇṇa āsīt |
ᵥmātṛbhi: agnimādhyamikābhirbhirvā ᵥsaṃ ᵥvāśāna: saha śabdaṃ kurvan ᵥakrān akramīt |
kramaterliha ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti vikaraṇasya luk ||

ᵥdūre ᵥpāre atidre'ntarikṣe sthitāṃ ᵥvāṇīṃ mādhyamikāṃ vācaṃ ᵥvardhayantaḥ stotrai: samṛddhāṃ kurvantaḥ stotāro maruto vā ᵥindraiṣitām indreṇa preritāṃ ᵥdhamani śabdaṃ kurvāṇāṃ tāṃ vācaṃ nitarāṃ ᵥpraprathan aprathayan ||
arejetāṃ rodasī bhiyāne kanikradato vṛṣṇo asya vajrāt ||
indra: | mahām | sindhum | ā'śayānam | māyā'vinam | vṛtram | asphurat | ni: | arejetām | rodasī iti | bhiyāne iti | kanikradata: | vṛṣṇa: | asya | vajrāt || 9 ||
balavān ᵥindro ᵥmahāmaṃ mahāntaṃ ᵥsindhum syandate itastata: saṃcaratīti sindhurmegha: |
tam ᵥāśa- yānaṃ tamadhiṣṭhāya śayānaṃ ᵥmāyāvinaṃ ᵥvṛtram asuram |
ᵥvṛṣṇa: varṣakasya ᵥasya indrasya ᵥkani- kradata: śabdaṃ kurvāṇāt ᵥvajrāt ᵥbhiyāne bhayaṃ prāpte ᵥrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥarejetām akampaitām ||
arauravīt | vṛṣṇa: | asya | vajra: | amānuṣam | yat | mānuṣa: | ni'jūrvāt | ni | māyina: | dānavasya | māyā: | apādayat | pivān | sutasya || 10 ||
ᵥvṛṣṇa: kāmānāṃ varṣakasya ᵥasya indrasya ᵥvajra: ᵥarauravīt bhṛśaṃ śabdamakarot |
yadvā mānuṣo'haṃ na bhavāmītyevaṃ manyamānaṃ tamasuraṃ ᵥmānuṣa: manuṣyāṇāṃ hitakārī yadvā matimānindra: ᵥnijūrvāt nitarāṃ hiṃsyān jighāṃsatītyartha: ||
ᵥsutasya abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ ᵥpivān pītvān ᵥmāyina: māyāvina:
tasyāḥ putrasya vṛtrasya 'māyāḥ vañcanāni' 'ni 'apādayat nyapātayat babādheti yāvat ||
pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mandantu tvā mandinaḥ sutāsaḥ |
pṛṇantaste kukṣī vardhayantvitthā sutaḥ paura indramāva ||
piba'piba | it | indra | śūra | somam | mandantu | tvā | mandinaḥ | sutāsaḥ | pṛṇantaḥ | te | kukṣī iti | vardhayantu | itthā | sutaḥ | pauraḥ | indram | āva || 11 ||
te tava 'te 'kukṣī udarasyobhau pārśvau 'pṛṇantaḥ pūrayantaḥ santastvāṃ 'vardhayantu |
'itthā anena prakāreṇa 'pauraḥ udarapūrakaḥ 'sutaḥ abhiputaḥ somaḥ 'indraṃ tvām 'āva tarpayat ||
tve indrāpyabham viprā dhiyaṃ vanema ṛtayā sarpantaḥ |
avasyavo dhīmahi praśasti sudhastai rāyo dāvanai syāma ||
tve iti | indra | arpi | abham | viprāḥ | dhiyam | vanema | ṛta'yā | sarpantaḥ | avasyavaḥ | dhīmahi | pra'śastim | sadhaḥ | te | rāyaḥ | dāvanai | syāma || 12 ||
te tava hṛdaye kiṃ vartāmaha iti |
tatkāmanayā 'sapantaḥ tvāṃ paricaraṇākhyena karmaṇā spṛśanto vayaṃ 'dhiyaṃ tvaduddeśena kriyamāṇaṃ karma 'vanema saṃbhajemahi ||
tataḥ 'te tvadīyasya 'rāyaḥ dhanasya 'dāvane dānāya pātrabhūtāḥ 'saccaḥ 'syāma idānīṃ bhavema ||
syāma te taṃ indra ye taṃ ūtī avasyava ūrjaṃ vardhayantaḥ |
śuṣmintamuṃ yaṃ cākanāma devāso rayi rāsi vīravantam ||
syāma | te | te | indra | ye | te | ūtī | avasyavaḥ | ūrjam | vardhayantaḥ | śuṣmintam'amum | yam | cākanāma | deva | asme iti | rayim | rāsi | vīra'vantam || 13 ||
1. ka-kha-ga-ca-a-ṇa-1-na-ma-va- vacanāni | 2. jha1-pibapiba | 3. kha-ga-ṇa-ta-tha-ma-laḍi | 4. kha-ga-ga1-prakṛṣṭaśaṃsanam; ca-prakṛṣṭaśāsanam | 5. ka-jha-ma-pātrībhūtāḥ |
he ᐡindra ᐡte tava ᐡūtī ūtyā praṇayanena ||
ᐡye ᐡte tavaᐡ ᐡavasyavaḥ rakṣākāmāḥ ᐡūrjaṃ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ ᐡvardhayantaḥ bhavanti te ᐡtava ᐡsyāma svadadhīnā bhavema |
ᐡdeva dyotamāna he indra ᐡśubhimantaṃ dānabhogāyārhatayā3 balavattamaṃ yadvā śatrūṇāṃ śoṣayitṛtamaṃ ᐡyaṃ rayiṃ ᐡcākanāma kāmayāmahe ||
ᐡvīravantaṃ putrapautraiḥ sahitaṃ tādṛśaṃ ᐡrayiṃ ᐡasme asmabhyaṃ ᐡrāsi dehi ||
rāsi kṣayaṃ rāsi mitramasme rāsi śardha indra mārutaṃ naḥ |
sajoṣaso ye ca mandasānāḥ pra vāyavaḥ pāntyagraṇītim ||
rāsiṃ | kṣayam | rāsiṃ | mitram | asme iti | rāsiṃ | śardhaḥ | indra | mārutam | naḥ | sa'joṣasaḥ | ye | ca | mandasānāḥ | pra | vāyavaḥ | pānti | agra'nītim || 14 ||
tathā ᐡmitraṃ sakhāyam ᐡasme asmabhyaṃ ᐡrāsi ||
ᐡmārutaṃ marutāṃ devaviśāṃ saṃbandhi ᐡśardhaḥ balaṃ ᐡnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᐡrāsi |
ᐡye marutaḥ ᐡsajoṣasaḥ saha prīyamāṇāḥ ᐡmandasānāḥ ᐡmodamānāḥ ᐡvāyavaḥ yajñaṃ prati gantāraḥ santaḥ ᐡagraṇītim agre nīyamānaṃ somaṃ ᐡpra ᐡpānti prakarṣeṇa pibanti teṣāṃ śardha iti samanvayaḥ |
yadvā ye ca vāyavaḥ agre nīyamānaṃ somaṃ pibanti teṣāṃ vāyūnāṃ balaṃ rāsi ||
vyantu | it | nu | yeṣu | mandasānaḥ | tṛpat | somam | pāhi | druhat | indra | asmān | su | putva'su | ā | tarutra | avardhayaḥ | dyām | bṛhadbhiḥ | arkaiḥ || 15 ||
he ᐡindra ᐡyeṣu tava sahāyabhūteṣu marutsu ᐡmandasānaḥ mādyan bhavasi te marutaḥ ᐡnu kṣipraṃ ᐡvyantu somaṃ bhakṣayantu |
ātmānaṃ dṛḍhīkurvan tvaṃ tṛpat tarpayantama imaṃ ᐡsomaṃ ᐡpāhi piva |
ᐡtarutra śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsaka he indra ᐡgrahadbhiḥ balavadbhiḥ arkaiḥ arcanīyairmarudbhiḥ sahita- svam |
tena asmān ᐡtvāṃ ca ᐡsu suṣṭhu ᐡputsu paśuputrādibhiḥ6 asmān asmatpālanena7 ca divam ᐡavadhayaḥ |

7. ka-ca-jha-ṇa-ta-tha-na-va-pālanena; kha-ga-ṇa-asmān pālanena; jha1-somapānena; ma-pālayate na |

bṛhanta innu ye tai tarutrokthebhirvā sumnamāvivāsān | stṛṇānāsau barhiḥ pustyāvvatā idindra vājamagman || 16 || bṛhantaḥ | it | nu | ye | te | tarutra | ukthebhiḥ | vā | sumnam | ā'vivāsān | stṛṇānāsaḥ | barhiḥ | pustya'vat | tvā'ūtāḥ | it | indra | vājam | agman || 16 ||
vtarutra āpadyastāraka’ he vindra vye pumāṃsaḥ vsumnaṃ sukhakaraṃ tvāmukthaiḥ śāstraiḥ vāvivāsān paricareyuḥ ||
vte tava pumāṃsaḥ vnu kṣipamavilambena vbṛhantaḥ mahānto bhavanti |
kiṃca vbarhiḥ vstṛṇānāsaḥ vedyāṃ barhirācchādayanto ye tvāṃ paricaranti te vūtā vit tvayā rakṣitāḥ santaḥ eva vpastyāvat gṛhasahitaṃ vvājam annam vagman gacchanti ||

ugreṣvinnu śūra mandasānastrikadrukeṣu pāhi somamindra | pradoṣuvacchuśru ṣu prīṇāno yāhi haribhyāṃ sutasya pītim || 17 || ugreṣu | it | nu | śūra | mandasānaḥ | trikadrukeṣu | pāhi | somam | indra | pra'doṣuvat | śmaśruṣu | prīṇānaḥ | yāhi | hari'bhyām | sutasya | pītim || 17 ||
he vśūra balavan vindra vugreṣu udgreṣu bahustotraśastreṣu vtrikadrukeṣu jyotigaurāyurādiyajñāma- keṣvābhiṣavikevvahaḥsu vmandasānaḥ havyan vsomaṃ vpāhi piba |
tataḥ vprīṇānaḥ somapānena prīto bhavan vśmaśru liptaṃ somaṃ vpradoṣuvat ||
punaḥpunardhunvan vsutasya abhiṣutasya vpītiṃ pānamuddiśya vharibhyāṃ aśvābhyām yuktaḥ san vyāhi gaccha ||

dhiṣvā śavaḥ śūra yenaṃ vṛtramabhinadanumaurṇāvābham | apāvṛṇojyotirāyyāya ni saṃvyataḥ sādi dasyurindra || 18 || dhiṣvā | śavaḥ | śūra | yena | vṛtram | ava'abhinat | dānum | aurṇa'vābham | apa | avṛṇoḥ | jyotiḥ | āryāya | ni | saṃvyataḥ | sādi | dasyuḥ | indra || 18 ||

sanḙm | ye | te | ūti̭bhiḥ | ta॒ranta̭ḥ | viśvā̭: | spṛdha̭: | ārya̭ṇa | dasyūna̭ | a॒smabhya̭m | tat | tvā॒ṣṭram | viśva̭'rūpam | a॒ra॒ndhaya̭ḥ | sāsya̭sya | tri॒tāya̭ || 19 ||
^sanema tān puruṣān saṃbhajema ^ye ^te tava ^ūtibhiḥ pālanaiḥ ^viśvāḥ ^spṛdhaḥ spardhamānāḥ sarvā viśaḥ ^tarantaḥ hiṃsantaḥ tathā ^āryeṇa āryabhāvena ^dasyūna upakṣapayitnū hiṃsanto bhavanti |
indrastvāṣṭramavadhīdityamarthastaittirīyake ‘viśvarūpo vai tvāṣṭraḥ’ (tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 1. 1) ityatra mahatā prabandhena prapañcitaḥ |
yadvā sanema te vayaṃ pravṛddhā bhavema ye tava rakṣābhiḥ spardhamānāḥ prajā dasyūṃśca taranto'tikrāmanto bhavema ||
asya sṷvānasya॒ mandi̭na॒strita̭sya॒ nyarbṷdaṃ vāvṛ॒dhāno̭ a॒staḥ |
asya | su॒vānasya̭ | mandi̭naḥ | tri॒tasya̭ | ni | a॒rbuda̭m | va॒vṛ॒dhāna̭ḥ | a॒staḥ | a॒rva॒ta॒t | sūrya̭: | na | cakra̭m | bhi॒nat | va॒lam | indra̭: | a॒ṅgira̭svān || 20 ||
^mandinaḥ ^asya madakaramimaṃ ^suvānasya sutavataḥ ^tritasya tīrṇatamaskasya mahapairathaṃ ^vāvṛdhānaḥ somena vardhamāna indraḥ ^arbudam |
‘stu hiṃsāyām’ ityasya laṅi tipi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk |
‘mahantaṃ cidarbudaṃ ni kramīḥ padā’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 51. 6) ityādiṣu arbudavadhaḥ ^spaṣṭamuktaḥ |
yadvā yasmādasurāñjayā sūryaḥ svakīyaṃ rathacakaṃ nāvartayat |
vartayituṃ nāśakat taṃ balaṃ paṇīnāṃ prabhumasuraṃ bhinat vajreṇābhinat |
yadvā dvicakro hi pūrvaṃ sūryasya rathaḥ |
sūrya iti ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanasya suḥ ||

sa ca gṛtsamado vainyena pūjito yajñavāṭādbahirgacchat |

yo jāta eva prathamo manasvāndevo devānkratunā paryabhūṣat |
yasya śuṣmādrodasī abhyasetāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
yaḥ | jātaḥ | eva | prathamaḥ | manasvān | devaḥ | devān | kratunā | pari'abhūṣat |

vjanāsaḥ janā he asurāḥ vyo vjāta veva jāyamāna eva san vprathamaḥ devānāṃ pradhānabhūtaḥ vmanasvān manasvināmagragaṇyaḥ vdevaḥ dyotamānaḥ san vkratunā vṛtravadhādilakṣaṇena svakīyena karmaṇā vdevān sarvān yāgaṃdatvān vparyabhūṣat rakṣakatvena 2 paryagrahīt ||

tathā ca mantrāntaram—‘ ime cittava manyave vepete bhayasā mahī ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 80. 11 ) iti |
vnṛmṇasya senālakṣaṇasya balasya vmahnā mahatvena yuktaḥ vsaḥ vindraḥ nāhamiti ||

atra niruktaṃ—‘ yo jāyamānaḥ eva prathamāṃ manasvī devo devān kratunā karmaṇā paryabhavatparyagṛhātparyakṣadadati vā yasya balāt dyāvāpṛthivyāvapyavibhītāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā balasya mahattvena sa janāsa indra ityetedarthasya prītibhavavyākhyānasaṃyuktā ’ ( niru. 10. 10 ) iti ||
4. kha-ga-asminpakṣe pravṛttavyasyena kyaḥ; ṇa-ta-tha- asminpakṣe pratyaye vyatyayena kasaḥ; ma-asminpakṣe pavatervyatyayena ca saḥ |

yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānāmahaṃhat parvatānprakupitāṃ aramṇāt | yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyo yo dyā mastambhātsa janāsa indraḥ || 2 || yaḥ | pṛthivīm | vyathamānām | ahaṃhat | yaḥ | parvatān | prakupitān | aramṇāt | yaḥ | antarikṣam | vimame | varīyaḥ | yaḥ | dyām | astambhāt | saḥ | janāsaḥ | indraḥ ||2||
he janāḥ yaḥ indraḥ vyathamānāṃ calantīṃ pṛthivīm ahaṃhat śarkarādibhirdṛḍhāmakarot ||
yaḥ ca prakupitān itastataścalitān pakṣayuktān parvatān aramṇāt niya- mitavān sve sve sthāne sthāpitavān ||
yaḥ ca varīyaḥ urutamam antarikṣaṃ vimame nirmame vistīrṇaṃ cakāretyarthaḥ |
yaḥ ca dyāṃ divam astambhāt tastambha’ niruddhāmakarot ||

yo hatvāhimariṇātsapta sindhūnyo gā udājadapadhā valasya | yo aśmanorantaragniṃ jajāna saṃvṛksamatsu sa janāsa indraḥ || 3 || yaḥ | hatvā | ahim | ariṇāt | sapta | sindhūn | yaḥ | gāḥ | ut | ājat | apadhā | valasya | yaḥ | aśmanoḥ | antaḥ | agnim | jajāna | sam | vṛk | samatsu | saḥ | janāsaḥ | indraḥ ||3||
yaḥ ahiṃ meghaṃ hatvā meghahananaṃ kṛtvā sapta sarpaṇaśīlāḥ sindhūn syandanaśīlā apaḥ ari- ṇāt prerayat |
yaḥ ca valasya valanāma kasyāsurasya apadhā tatkartṛkāgnirodhātrihaddhāḥ |
antaḥ madhye vaidyutam agniṃ jajāna utpādayāmāsa |

ya: ca kṛśasya ca daridrasya ca ya: ca nādhamānasya |

yasya sarvāntaryāmitayā vartamānasya pradiśi pradeśane'nuśāsane'śvāsa: aśvā vartante |

yasmānna ṛte vijayante janāso yaṃ yudhyamānā avase havante | yo viśvasya pratimānaṃ babhūva yo acyutacyutsa janāsa indraḥ || 9 || yasmāt | na | ṛte | vi'jayante | janāsaḥ | yam | yudhyamānāḥ | avase | havante | yaḥ | viśvasya | prati'mānam | babhūva | yaḥ | acyut'cyut | saḥ | janāsaḥ | indraḥ || 9 ||
ᵛyasmāt ᵛṛte ᵛjanāsaḥ janāḥ ᵛna ᵛvijayante vijayaṃ na prāpnuvanti |
ataḥ ᵛyudhyamānāḥ yuddhaṃ kurvoṇā janāḥ ᵛavase svarakṣaṇāya ᵛyam indraṃ ᵛhavante āhvayanti |
ᵛyaḥ ca ᵛviśvasya sarvasya jagataḥ ᵛpratimānaṃ pratinidhiḥ ᵛbabhūva |
ᵛyaḥ ca ᵛacyutacyut acyutānāṃ kṣayarahitānāṃ parvatādīnāṃ cyāvayitā ᵛsaḥ ᵛindraḥ ityādi prasiddham ||

yaḥ śaśvato maheno dadhānānmanyamānāñcharvī jaghāna | yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śrudhyāṃ yo dasyurhantā sa janāsa indraḥ || 10 || yaḥ | śaśvataḥ | māha | enaḥ | dadhānān | amaṃyamānān | śarvīm | jaghāna | yaḥ | śardhate | na | anudadāti | śrudhyām | yaḥ | dasyoḥ | hantā | saḥ | janāsaḥ | indraḥ || 10||
ᵛyaḥ ᵛmahi mahat ᵛenaḥ pāpaṃ ᵛdadhānān ᵛśaśvataḥ bahūn ᵛamanyamānān ātmānamajānata indramapūjayato vā janān ᵛśarvīm |
ᵛyaḥ ca ᵛśardhate utsāhaṃ kurvate anātmajñāya janāya ᵛśrudhyām utsāhanīyaṃ karma ᵛnānudadāti na prayacchati ||
ᵛyaḥ ca ᵛdasyoḥ upakṣapayituḥ śatroḥ ᵛhantā ghātakaḥ ᵛsaḥ ᵛindraḥ ityādi pūrvavat ||

yaḥ śambaraṃ parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śaradyanvavindat | ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna dānuṃ śayānaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ || 11 || yaḥ | śambaram | parvateṣu | kṣiyantam | catvāriṃśyām | śaradi | anu'avindat | ojāyamānam | yaḥ | ahim | jaghāna | dānum | śayānam | saḥ | janāsaḥ | indraḥ || 11 ||

ᵛyaḥ ᵛparvateṣu ᵛkṣiyantam indrabhiyā bahūn saṃvatsarān pracchanno bhūtvā parvataguhāsu nivasantaṃ ᵛśambaram etannāmakaṃ māyāvinamasuraṃ ᵛcatvāriṃśyāṃ ᵛśaradi catvāriṃśe saṃvatsare ᵛanvavindat anvidhyālabhata |
'kartuḥ kyaṅ ca salopaśca', 'ojaso'psaraso nityam' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 11. 2 ) iti sakāralopaḥ ||
balamācarantam ᵛahim ahantāraṃ ᵛdānuṃ dānavaṃ ᵛśayānaṃ śambaramuraṃ ᵛjaghāna hatavān ᵛsaḥ ᵛindraḥ nāhamiti ||

yaḥ sapta̭raśmi॒rvṛṣa̭bhastu॒viṣma̭nā॒vāsa̭sṛ॒tave॒ sapta̭ sindhūn | yo rauhi̭ṇamasphura॒dvajra̭bāha॒ryāro̭ha॒ntaṃ sa ja̭nāsa॒ indra̭: || 12 || yaḥ | sapta̭-raśmiḥ | vṛṣa̭bhaḥ | tu॒viṣma̭ān | ava̭-sṛjat | sa॒pta'i̭ve | sapta̭ | sindhūn | yaḥ | rauhi̭ṇam | asphurat | vajra̭-bāhaḥ | dyām | ā'ro̭hantam | saḥ | ja̭nāsaḥ | indra̭: || 12 ||

te ca raśmayaḥ 'varāhavaḥ svatapaso vicunmahaso dhṛpayaḥ śrāpayo gṛhamedhāścetyete ye ceme'śmididriyaḥ parjanyāḥ sapta pṛthivīmabhivarṣanti vṛṣṭibhiḥ' (tai. ā. 1. 9. 4-5) iti taittirīyāraṇyake hyāmnātāḥ |

dyāvā̭ cidasmai pṛthi॒vī na̭mete॒ śuṣmā̭ccidasya॒ parva̭tā bhayante | yaḥ soma̭pā ni॒cito॒ vajra̭bāha॒rvajra̭hastaḥ sa ja̭nāsa॒ indra̭: || 13 || dyāvā̭ | ci॒t | asmai̭ | pṛthi॒vī iti̭ | na॒mete॒ iti̭ | śuṣmā̭t | ci॒t | a॒sya | parva̭tāḥ | bha॒yante॒ | yaḥ | soma̭-pāḥ | ni॒'citaḥ | vajra̭-bāhaḥ | yaḥ | vajra̭-hastaḥ | saḥ | ja̭nāsaḥ | indra̭: || 13 ||
karmakartari 'na duhastunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti yakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||

yaḥ su॒nvanta̭mavati॒ yaḥ pa̭ca॒ntaṃ yaḥ śaṃsa̭nta॒ṃ yaḥ śaśa̭mānamūtau | yasya॒ brahma॒ vardha̭na॒ṃ yasya॒ somo॒ yasye॒daṃ rādha॒ḥ sa ja̭nāsa॒ indra̭: || 14 || yaḥ | su॒nvanta̭m | a॒vati | yaḥ | pa॒ca॒ntam | yaḥ | śaṃsa̭ntam | yaḥ | śaśa̭mānam | ū॒tau | yasya̭ | brahma̭ | vardha̭nam | yasya̭ | soma̭: | yasya̭ | i॒dam | rādha̭ḥ | saḥ | ja̭nāsaḥ | indra̭: || 14 ||
śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ ca śaśamānam avati stotraṃ kurvāṇaṃ rakṣati |

yasya ca idam asmadīyaṃ rādhaḥ puroḍāśādilakṣaṇamatra vṛddhikaraṃ bhavati |
yaḥ sunvate pacate dudha ā cidvāaṃ dardarṣi sa kilāsi mṛtyaḥ |
vayaṃ te indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||
yaḥ | sunvate | pacate | dudhaḥ | ā | cit | vājam | dardarṣi | saḥ | kila | asi | satyaḥ | vayam | te | indra | viśvaha | priyāsaḥ | suvīrāsaḥ | vidatham | ā | vadema || 15 ||
he indra yaḥ dudhaḥ durdharaḥ san sunvate somābhipavaṃ kurvate puroḍāśādihavīṃṣi pacate yajamānāya vājam annaṃ balaṃ vā ā dardarṣi bhṛśaṃ prāpayasi saḥ

sa॒dhī॒mā ya̭nti॒ pari̭ vi॒bhra̭ntī॒ḥ payo̭ vi॒śva॒psnyā̭ya॒ pra bhara̭nta॒ bhojana̭m | sa॒mā॒no a॒dhvā pra॒vatā̭nu॒ṣyade॒ yastā̭kṛ॒ṇoḥ pra॒thama̭ṃ sā॒syukthya̭ḥ || 2 || sa॒dhī | ī̭m | ā | ya॒nti॒ | pari̭ | vi॒bhra̭ntīḥ | pa॒rya̭ | vi॒śva॒psnyā̭ya | pra | bha॒ra॒nta | bhojana̭m | sa॒māna̭ḥ | a॒dhvā | pra॒vatā̭m | a॒nu॒'syadḙ | yaḥ | tā | a॒kṛ॒ṇoḥ | pra॒thama̭m | saḥ | a॒si | u॒kthya̭ḥ ||2||
sadhīcīnāḥ ^payaḥ udakaṃ ^pari paritaḥ ^vibhrantīḥ bibhrāṇāḥ ^īm enā nadyaḥ ^ā ^yanti sarvato gacchanti |

a॒nve॒ko va̭dati॒ yahdā̭ti॒ tadrṷ̄pā॒ mina̭nta॒darpā॒ eka̭ ī̭yate | vi॒śvā eka̭sya॒ vinṷda॒stiti̭kṣate॒ yastā̭kṛ॒ṇoḥ pra॒thama̭ṃ sā॒syukthya̭ḥ || 3 || anṷ | eka̭ḥ | va॒dati̭ | yat | da॒dāti̭ | tat | rū॒pā | mi॒nan | tat'a̭pāḥ | eka̭ḥ | ī̭yate | vi॒śvā | eka̭sya | vi'nṷdaḥ | ti॒ti̭kṣate | yaḥ | tā | a॒kṛ॒ṇoḥ | pra॒thama̭m | saḥ | a॒si | u॒kthya̭ḥ ||3||
^ekaḥ adhvaryuḥ ^rūpā paścādīnāṃ rūpāṇi ^minan hiṃsan ^tadapāḥ tat viśasanā- hyam apaḥ karma yasya tādṛśaḥ san ^īyate devayajane sarvatra gacchati |

pra॒jābhya̭ḥ pu॒ṣṭiṃ vi॒bharja̭nta ā॒sate॒ rayi̭miva pṛ॒ṣṭhaṃ a॒bhava̭ntamā॒yatḙ | a॒si॒nva॒nda॒staiḥ pi॒tu॒ratti̭ bhojana॒ṃ yastā̭kṛ॒ṇoḥ pra॒thama̭ṃ sā॒syukthya̭ḥ || 4 || pra॒jābhya̭ḥ | pu॒ṣṭim | vi॒'bharja̭ntaḥ | ā॒satḙ | rayi̭m'iva | pṛ॒ṣṭham | pra॒'bhava̭ntam | ā॒yatḙ | a॒si॒nvan | da॒staiḥ | pi॒tuḥ | atti̭ | bhojana̭m | yaḥ | tā | a॒kṛ॒ṇoḥ | pra॒thama̭m | saḥ | a॒si | u॒kthya̭ḥ || 4 ||
he indra ᵥpuṣṭiṃ tvayā dattaṃ poṣakaṃ dhanaṃ svakīyābhyaḥ ᵥprajābhyaḥ ᵥvibhajanta: asyaitāvadasyai- tāvaditi ᵥvibhāgaṃ kurvanto gṛhamedhina: ᵥāsate svasvagṛheṣu nivasanti |
ᵥāyate gṛhaṃ pratyāgacchate'tithaye ᵥpṛṣṭhaṃ dhārakaṃ ᵥprabhavantaṃ bahubharaṇasamarthaṃ ᵥrayiṃ dhanaṃ yathā vibhajya prayacchanti tadvat |
ᵥasinvan setubandhādikaṃ karma kurvan loka: ᵥpitu: pālayityā diva: sakāśādāgataṃ ᵥbhojanam udakaṃ tatkāryā oṣadhī: ᵥdaṃṣṭrai: dantai: ᵥatti bhakṣayati |
yadvā asinvana anyāpriyamāṇo'bhi: pitu: pālakasya yajamānasya saṃbandhi bhojanaṃ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ daṃṣṭraidantarūpairjvālairatti |
adhākṛṇoḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃdaśe dive yo dhautīnāmahihanāriṇakpathaḥ |
taṃ tvā stomaibhirudabhirna vājinaṃ devaṃ devā ajanantasāsyukthyaḥ ||
adha | akṛṇoḥ | pṛthivīm | sam'daśe | dive | yaḥ | dhautīnām | ahi'han | ariṇak | pathaḥ | tam | tvā | stomaibhiḥ | udabhiḥ | na | vājinam | devam | devāḥ | ajanan | saḥ | asi | ukthyaḥ || 5 ||
he indra ᵥadha api ca tvaṃ ᵥdive dyotanāya sūryāya ᵥpṛthivīṃ calitāṃ satīṃ dṛḍhīkṛtya ᵥsaṃdaśe saṃdarśanīyām ᵥakṛṇo: akaro: ||
ᵥdṛśe viśve ca ’ iti ke'prayayāntatvena nipātita: ||
ᵥya: ca tvaṃ ᵥdhautīnāṃ calantīnāṃ nadīnāṃ ᵥpatha: mārgān ᵥariṇak vyarecaya:3 |
ᵥahihan aharhantasya meghasya vā hantarhe indra ᵥdevā: stotāra: ᵥtaṃ tādṛśaṃ ᵥdevaṃ tvāṃ ᵥstomebhi: stotrai: ᵥajanan avardhayan |
yo bhojanaṃ ca daryase ca vardhanamārdrādā śuṣkaṃ madhumadudohitha |
saḥ śevadhi ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasyaikaṃ īśiṣe sāsyukthyaḥ ||
yaḥ | bhojanam | ca | daryase | ca | vardhanam | ārdrāt | ā | śuṣkam | madhu'mat | dudohitha | saḥ | śeva'dhim | ni | dadhiṣe | vivasvati | viśvasya | ekaḥ | īśiṣe | saḥ | asi | ukthyaḥ ||6||
kiṃca ᵥvardhanaṃ vṛddhikaraṃ dhanaṃ balaṃ vā dayase |
tathā ᵥārdrāt kāṇḍāt ᵥśuṣkam anādraṃ vrīhyādikaṃ ᵥmadhumat madhurasasopetaṃ ᵥdudohitha dugdhavānasi ||
ᵥsa: tādṛśastvaṃ ᵥvivasvati te paricaraṇaṃ kurvāṇe yajamāne ᵥśevadhiṃ dhanasadanaṃ ᵥni ᵥdadhiṣe nidadhāsi |
ᵥviśvasya sarvasya jagata: ᵥeka: advitīya eva san ᵥīśiṣe svāmī bhavasi ||

yaḥ pu॒ṣpiṇī̭śca॒ prasa̭vaśca॒ dharmā̭dhi dāne॒ vya̭va॒nīra̭dhārayaḥ | yaścā̭sa॒mā a̭rja॒no di॒dyuto̭ di॒va u॒rurvā̭ a॒bhita̭ḥ sā॒syukthya̭ḥ || 7 || yaḥ | pu॒ṣpiṇī̭ | ca | pra'sa̭vaḥ | ca | dharmā̭ | adhi̭ | dānḙ | vi | a॒va॒nīḥ | a॒dhā̭rayaḥ | yaḥ | ca॒ | a॒sa॒māḥ | a॒rja̭naḥ | di॒dyuta̭ḥ | di॒vaḥ | u॒ruḥ | ū॒rvān | a॒bhita̭ḥ | saḥ | a॒si | u॒kthya̭ḥ || 7 ||
he indra yaḥ tvaṃ puṣpiṇīḥ puṣpavatīḥ ca prasavāḥ prasūtāḥ prasūyamānā vā avanīḥ avitrī- ropadhīḥ dāne adhi ||
tasmin kṣetre dharmā sakalalakṣaṇena karmaṇā ci adhārayaḥ nyadadhāḥ |
yaḥ ca tvaṃ divaḥ dyotamānasya sūryasya
he indra ᵛekasya ekākinaḥ śreṣṭhasya vā ᵛyasya te ᵛśrutau sukhanimitte tadarthaṃ ᵛjñātaṃ ᵛdaśa daśa śatāni harayo vāhanārthaṃ bhavanti |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ—‘ indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate yuktā hyasya harayaḥ śatā daśa ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 6. 47. 18) iti |
avi ca yaśca ᵛā ᵛadyaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvata upajīvyaḥ |
‘ na tasyeśe ya nādyādyairna nāyuḥ ’ iti hi śrutiḥ |
ᵛyaddha yaśca ᵛtvaṃ ᵛcodaṃ stotrāṇāṃ prerakaṃ yajamānam ᵛāvitha rakṣitavānasi |
kiṃca yasyavam ᵛarajjau rajjuvarjite bandhanāgāre ᵛdasyūna upakṣapayitṛn ᵛdabhītaye |
yadvā tadīyaṃ dhanaṃ stotṛn prāpayasīti yat tatpraśastamityarthaḥ |
jātu kadācit sarvadā sthirasya sahasvataḥ balavato yajñādeḥ karmaṇaḥ saṃbandhi vayaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ pra vindase iti samanvayaḥ |
aramayaḥ sarapastarāya kaṃ turvītaye ca vṛttyāṃ ca sutim |
nīcā santamudaneyaḥ parāvṛjaṃ prāndha śroṇaṃ śravayantasāsyukthyaḥ ||
aramayaḥ | sara'apasaḥ | tarāya | kam | turvītaye | ca | vṛttyāya | ca | sutim | nīcā | santam | ut | anayaḥ | parā'vṛjam | pra | andham | śroṇam | śravayan | saḥ | asi | ukthyaḥ || 12 ||

he indra 1sarapasaḥ | maraṇamapaḥ karma yāsāṃ tāḥ sarapasaḥ || śakandhāditvāt pararūpatvam || tā apaḥ 1kaṃ sukhena 1tarāya taraṇāya 1aramayaḥ akīḍayaḥ | kiṃca | 1turvītaye | turvītīnāṃ kaścidrājarpiḥ | tasmai 1vṛttyāya 1ca | vayāṃ nāma kaścit tasmai | nābhyāṃ 1sutiṃ saraṇaṃ prastharamayaḥ | tau hi jala- pūrṇāṃ mahānadīṃ dṛṣṭvā tartumasamarthāvāstām | tau ca tvayā tāritau | 1parāvṛjam | paritaḥ pāpāni vṛṇakti dahatīti parāvṛk kaścidapi | tamapnu magnaṃ tathā 1nīcā nīcaṃ 1santam 1udanayaḥ | 1ūrdhvaṃ nītavānasi | kiṃca 1anyaṃ santaṃ 1śroṇaṃ paṅguṃ santaṃ cakṣurdānādapaṅgukaraṇāccodanayaḥ | kiṃ kurvan | prakaryeṇa 2śravayan | ātmānaṃ kīrtimantaṃ kurvan | udanayaḥ iti samanvayaḥ | 1maḥ ityādi siddham ||
asmabhyaṃ tadvaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu tai vasuvyam |
indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūnbṛhaddema vidathai suvīrāḥ ||
asmabhyam | tat | vaso iti | dānāya | rādhaḥ | sam | arthayasva | bahu | te | vasuvyam | indra | yat | citram | śravasyā | anu | dyūn | bṛhat | vadema | vidathai | suvīrāḥ ||13||

1vaso sarvasya vāsaka vasumanyā he 1indra stotṛbhyaḥ 1asmabhyaṃ 1tat 1rādhaḥ dhanaṃ 1dānāya | upalakṣaṇametat | bhogāya ca 1samarthayasva dehi | asmān saṃgamayetyarthaḥ || 'artha yācane' curādirdanta ātmanepadī || 1te tatra tat 1bahu prabhūtaṃ 1vasavyam || vasveva vasavyam | vasvāditvāt svārthiko yat || tādṛśaṃ prabhūtaṃ dhanamasti khalu | 1citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ 1yan dhanam 1anu 1dyūn anvaham || 'kālā- dhvanoḥ0' iti dvitīyā || 1śravasyāḥ bhogyamiccheḥ || annarṇātiṇyarthatvāt 3akarmakatvam | yathā roditīti | satyam | dve atra karmaṇī uddeśyakarma ca vidheyakarma ca | vidheyakarmabhūtam | uddeśyakarmaṇā sakarmako
yathā māṇavakaṃ putrīyati (pā. sū. 3.1.8.2) iti bhāṣye udāhṛtam|
^suvīrā: kalyāṇaputrapautrā: santo vayaṃ ^tridathe asmin‌yajñe ^bṛhat prabhūtaṃ śastrādikaṃ vākyaṃ ^vadema ||
'adhvaryavo bharata' iti dvādaśacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ gārtsamadaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram|
'adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somamiti yājyā' (ādha. śrau. 6. 4) iti sūtritam ||
adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somamamrebhi: siñcatā madyamandha: | kāmī hi vīra: sardamasya pītiṃ juhota vṛṣṇe tadideṣa vaṣṭi || 1 || adhvaryava: | bharata | indrāya | somam | ā | amrebhi:
tasmai tadvaśāya somakāmāya tasmai indrāya etaṃ somaṃ bharata uttaravediṃ prati harata |
eṣaḥ indraḥ asya somasya pītiṃ pānam arhati ||
adhvaryavo yo dabhīkaṃ jaghāna yo gā udājadapa hi valaṃ vaḥ |
tasmā etamantarikṣe na vātamindraṃ somairaurṇuta jūrṇa vastraiḥ ||
adhvaryavaḥ | yaḥ | dabhīkam | jaghāna | yaḥ | gāḥ | ut'ājat | apa | hi | valam | varit vaḥ | tasmai | etam | antarikṣe | na | vātam | indram | somaiḥ | ā | ūrṇuta | jūḥ | na | vastraiḥ ||3||

he adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ indraḥ dabhīkam | savāṃn vidārayati bhiyaṃ karotīti dabhīko nāmāsuraḥ | tamasuraṃ jaghāna | yaḥ ca valāsureṇa niruddhāḥ gāḥ udājat niragamayat | tataśca tameva valam asuram apa vaḥ apāvṛṇot | hisitavānityarthaḥ || vṛṇoterluṅi '
ᵥaśubhaṃ kenāpyaśopaṇayaṃ ᵥśuṣṇam asuraṃ ᵥyaḥ' ca tamasuraṃ ᵥvyasam aṃsahīnaṃ kṛtvā jaghāna |
ᵥyaḥ ca ᵥvipruṃ tejasā jagadvyāpya vartamānameta- jñāmakamasuraṃ ᵥnamucim asuraṃ jaghāna ᵥyaḥ ca |
taittirīyake 'namucimasuraṃ nālabhata' iti prakṛtya 'phenena śira udavatayat' (tai. brā. 1. 7. 1. 5-6) ityantena vākyasaṃdarbhena namucibadhaḥ prapañcitaḥ |
tathā mantraśca- 'apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavatayaḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 14. 13) iti |
ᵥrudhrikām eta- jñāmakamasuraṃ ᵥyaḥ ca jaghāna |
ᵥtasmai ᵥindrāya ᵥandhasaḥ havirlakṣaṇānnannāni ᵥjuhota juhuta ||

adhvaryavo yaḥ śataṃ śambarasya puro bibhedāśmaneva pūrvoḥ | yo vṛrcinaḥ śatamindraḥ sahasraṃmapāvapaddharatā somamasmai || 6 || adhvaryavaḥ | yaḥ | śatam | śambarasya | puraḥ | bibheda | aśmanā'iva | pūrvoḥ | yaḥ | vṛrcinaḥ | śatam | indraḥ | sahasram | apa'avapata | bharata | somam | asmai ||6||
he ᵥadhvaryavaḥ ᵥyaḥ indraḥ ᵥśambarasya māyāvino'surasya ᵥpūrvīḥ purātanīḥ ᵥśataṃ ᵥpuraḥ purīḥ ᵥaśmaneva aśmasadṛśena vajreṇa ᵥbibheda |
tasyāsurasya ᵥśataṃ ᵥsahasram etatsaṃkhyākānaparimitānvīrān ᵥapavapat yugapadeva bhūmyāmāpātayat |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ- 'śataṃ varcinaḥ sahasraṃ ca sākaṃ hatho apratyasurasya vīrān' (ṛ. saṃ. 7. 99. 5 ) iti |
adhvaryavo yaḥ śatamā sahasraṃ bhūmyā upasthe'vapajjaghanvān |
adhvaryavaḥ | yaḥ | śatam | ā | sahasram | bhūmyā | upasthe | avapata | jaghanvān | kutsasya | āyoḥ | atithi'gvasya | vīrān | ni | avṛṇak | bharata | somam | asmai ||7||
he ᵥadhvaryavaḥ ᵥjaghanvān pūrvaṃ śatrūn hatavān ᵥyaḥ indraḥ ᵥśataṃ ᵥsahasram asurān ᵥbhūmyāḥ ᵥupasthe utsaṅge ᵥavapata ekaikena prakāreṇāpātayat |
eteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ ᵥvīrān abhigantun prati- dvandvinaḥ śuṣṇādīnasurān ᵥnyavṛṇak |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ- 'tvaṃ kutsaṃ śuṣṇahatve'thāvithānyayo'tithigvāya śambaram' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 51. 6 ) iti |

adhvaryavo yannaraḥ kāmayādhve śruṣṭī vahanto naśatha tadindrai | garbhastipūtaṃ bharata śrutāyendrāya somaṃ yajyavo juhota || 8 || adhvaryavaḥ | yat | naraḥ | kāmayādhve | śruṣṭī | vahantaḥ | naśatha | tat | indrai | garbhasta'pūtam | bharata | śrutāya | indrāya | somam | yajyavaḥ | juhota || 8 || naraḥ karmaṇāṃ netāro he adhvaryavaḥ yat abhilapitamatha kāmayādhve || kāmayaterlyāḍāgamaḥ || śruṣṭī kṣipram indre somaṃ vahantaḥ prāpayanto yūyaṃ tat abhilapitaṃ phalaṃ naśatha prāputa | śrutāya loke prasiddhāya indrāya garbhastipūtaṃ hastābhyāṃ mārjanadohanādibhiḥ2 śodhitaṃ somaṃ bharata uttaravediṃ prati harata | tataḥ yajyavaḥ yāgaṃ kurvāṇā he adhvaryavaḥ āhṛtaṃ somam indrāya juhota juhuta | agnau prakṣipata ||

adhvaryavaḥ kartanā śruṣṭimasmai vane nipūtaṃ vana unnayadhvam | juṣāṇo hastyamabhi vāvaśe va indrāya somaṃ madiraṃ juhota || 9 || adhvaryavaḥ | kartanā | śruṣṭima | asmai | vane | nipūtam | vane | ut | nayadhvam | juṣāṇaḥ | hastyam | abhi | vāvaśe | vaḥ | indrāya | somam | madiram | juhota ||9|| ha adhvaryavaḥ asmai indrāya somaṃ śruṣṭiṃ sumkaraṃ kartana kuruta || karauterloṭi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk | ‘tasanasanathanāśca’ iti tanavādeśaḥ | āmantritasyāvidyamānatvācca nighātaḥ || kiṃca vane saṃbhajanīye vane udake nipūtam āpyāyanena śodhitaṃ somam unnayadhvam uccai nayata | yadvā vane tadvikāre camase nipūtaṃ daśāpavitreṇa śodhitaṃ somaṃ vane camasa unna- yadhvam | juṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇaḥ sa indraḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ hastyaṃ hastābhyāmbhiputaṃ somam abhi vāvaśe kāmayate || ‘vaśa kāntau’ | yalugantavya laṭi vyatyayenātmanepadam | ‘lopasta ātmanepadeṣu’ iti talopaḥ || madiraṃ madakaramimaṃ somam indrāya juhota | indrohetenāgnau prakṣipata ||

adhvaryavaḥ payasodhyarthā goḥ somaṃbhirīṃ praṇatā bhojanamindram | vedāhamasya nibhṛtaṃ ma etaditmantaṃ bhūyo yajataściketa || 10 || adhvaryavaḥ | payasā | ūrdhvaḥ | yathā | goḥ | somabhiḥ | im | pṛṇata | bhojam | indram | veda | aham | asya | nibhṛtam | me | etat | ditsantam | bhūyaḥ | yajataḥ | ciketa ||10||
he ᵥadhvaryavaḥ ᵥyathā ᵥgoḥ ᵥudhaḥ ᵥpayasā pūrṇaṃ tadvan ᵥīm enaṃ ᵥbhojaṃ phalasya dātāraṃ rakṣitāraṃ ca ᵥindraṃ ᵥsomebhiḥ somaiḥ ᵥpṛṇata pūrayata |
ᵥme madīyasya ᵥasya somasya ᵥnibhṛtaṃ gūḍhaṃ sukha- sādhanasvabhāvam ᵥaham eva ᵥveda jānāmi |
iti pūrvaṃ na parasmai kathitaṃ tathāpi yuṣmabhyaṃ bravīmī- tyevam |
ᵥdisantaṃ somaṃ dānumicchantaṃ yajamānaṃ ᵥyajata: yajñasya indraḥ ᵥbhūyaḥ atiśayena ᵥciketa ||
pra ghā nvasya mahato mahāni satyā satyasya karaṇāni vocam |
pra | gha | nu | asya | mahataḥ | mahāni | satyā | satyasya | karaṇāni | vocam | trikadrukeṣu | apibat | sutasya | asya | made | ahim | indraḥ | jahāna || 1 ||
'mahataḥ balavataḥ 'satyasya satyasaṃkalpasya 'asya indrasya 'satyā satyāni yathā- rthāni 'mahāni mahānta 'karaṇāni asminsūkte vakṣyamāṇāni karmāṇi 'nu adya 'pra 'vocaṃ prakarṣeṇa bravīmi |
'sañjeva yathā yajñagṛhān 'mānaiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatkramaprācīyevaṃrūpaiḥ parimāṇaiḥ prākpravaṇān kurvanti tadvat sindhūn lokāntvānjūnvā mānaiḥ parimāṇaiḥ 'prācaḥ prājukhān 'vi 'mimāya |
tathā ca mantraḥ—'indro aramā~ aradadvajrabāhuḥ ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 3. 33. 6 ) iti |
tathā 'dīrghayātheḥ bahukālaṃ' gantavyaiḥ ' 'pathabhiḥ mārgaiḥ 'vṛthā 'asṛjat anāyāsena tāḥ nadīḥ sṛṣṭavān |
saṃ gobhiraśvairasṛjadrathebhiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
saḥ | pra'vohan | pari'gatya | dabhīteḥ | viśvam | adhāk | āyudham | iddhe | agnau | sam | gobhiḥ | aśvaiḥ | asṛjat | rathebhiḥ | somasya | tā | made | indraḥ | cakāra ||4||
prākkila cumuridhuniprabhṛtayo'surā dabhīteḥ puraṃ saṃrudhya parigṛhya tasmātpurābhinirguriti kathā |
prakarṣeṇa taṃ dabhītiṃ vahatastānasurān madhyamārgaṃ 'parigṛhya teṣāṃ 'viśvaṃ sarvam 'āyudham 'iddhe 'agnau dīpyamāne vahau 'adhāk adhākṣīt 'dahaliṅi ' mantra ghasa ' ityādinā clerluk ||
'atimūrtinā ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—' sa īṃ mahīṃ dhunimetoraramṇāt ' ( āśva. śrau. 9. 8 ) iti ||
ta utsnāya rayibhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
saḥ | īm | mahīṃ | dhunim | etoḥ | aramṇāt | saḥ | asnātn | apārayat | svasti | te | ut'snāya | rayibhiḥ | abhi | pra | tasthuḥ | somasya | tā | made | indraḥ | cakāra ||5||
dhunoti stotṛṇāṃ pāpānīti dhuniḥ paruṣṇī nadī |
'te maharṣayaḥ 'utsnāya tāṃ nadīmuttīrya yaṃ rayimapekṣya gacchanti taṃ 'rayim abhilakṣya 'pra 'tasthuḥ pratasthire |

sodaśruṃ sindhuṃriṇānmahitvā vajreṇānaṃ uṣasaḥ saṃ pipeṣa | ajavasau javinībhirvibṛśvantasormasya tā mada indraścakāra || 6 || saḥ | udaśrum | sindhum | ariṇāt | mahitvā | vajreṇa | anaḥ | uṣasaḥ | sam | pipeṣa | ajavasaḥ | javinībhiḥ | vibṛśvan | somasya | tā | madai | indraḥ | cakāra || 6 ||
etacca 'divaścidvā duhitaram' ( ṛ. saṃ. 4. 30. 9 ) ityatra spaṣṭaṃ vakṣyate |
^ajavasaḥ javahīnā durbalāḥ senāḥ ^javinībhiḥ javayuktābhiḥ senābhiḥ ^vibṛśvan viśeṣeṇa bhindan |

sa vidvā~ apagohaṃ kunīnāmāvirbhavudatiṣṭhatparāk | prati śroṇaḥ sthāścanargacchat somasya tā mada indraścakāra || 7 || saḥ | vidvān | apa'goham | kunīnām | āviḥ | bhavan | ut | atiṣṭhat | parā'vak | prati | śroṇaḥ | sthāt | vi | anak | accha | somasya | tā | madai | indraḥ | cakāra ||7||
purā kila kanyāścadhuhīnaṃ pādahīnaṃ parāvṛjaṃ jigyuṣmūrtiṃ dṛṣṭvābhidudruvuḥ |
tataḥ sa ṛṣirindraṃ stutvā cakṣuḥ pādaṃ ca lebhe |
^kanīnāṃ kanyakānām ^apagoham apagohanaṃ tirobhāvaṃ ^vidvān ^parāvṛk ṛṣiḥ ^āvirbhavan sarveṣāṃ pratyakṣo bhavan ^udatiṣṭhat |

bhinadvalamarirobhirgṛṇāno vi parvatasya dṛhitānvairt | riṇagrodhāṃsi kṛtrimāṇyeṣāṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra || 8 || bhinat | valam | aṅgiraḥ'bhiḥ | gṛṇānaḥ | vi | parvatasya | dṛhitāni | airat | riṇak | rodhāṃsi | kṛtrimāṇa | eṣām | somasya | tā | madai | indraḥ | cakāra ||8||
^aṅgirobhiḥ ^gṛṇānaḥ stūyamānaḥ sa indraḥ ^valaṃ valanāmaka masuraṃ ^bhinat abhinat |
tathā gavāṃ nirodhakasya ^parvatasya ^dṛhitāni śilābhirddhīkṛtāni dvārāṇi ^vi ^airat udghāṭitavān |
^eṣāṃ parvatānāṃ ^kṛtrimāṇa kriyā nirvṛttāni ^rodhāṃsi niruddhāni dvārāṇi ^riṇak udghāṭayat |
sūtritaṃ - 'svapnenābhyupyā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ceti sūktamukhīyā' (āśva. śrau. 9. 8) iti ||
svapnenābhyupyā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca jaghantha dasyuṃ pra dabhītimāvaḥ |
rambhī cidatraṃ vivide hiraṇyaṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
svapnena | abhi'urpya | cumurim | dhunim | ca | jaghantha | dasyum | pra | dabhītim | āvaḥ | rambhī | cit | atra | vivide | hiraṇyam | somasya | tā | made | indraḥ | cakāra || 9 ||
sa tvaṃ dasyuṃ sarvasyopakṣapayitāraṃ cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca etannāmānāvāsurau svapnena dīrgha- nidrayā abhyupya saṃyojya jaghantha hatavānasi |
tataḥ tābhyāṃ yudhyamānaṃ dabhītiṃ rājarṣi pra āvaḥ rakṣitavānasi |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ - 'tvaṃ ni dasyuṃ cu
he yajamānāḥ vyaḥ vyuṣmadarthaṃ vsatāṃ vmahatāṃ devānāṃ vśreṣṭhatamaya atiśayena śreṣṭhayendrāya tadartham |
vdīpyamāna vevāgnau vhaviḥ vpra vbhare saṃpādyāmi |
tataḥ paraṃ vsuṣṭutiṃ śaṃbhanāṃ stutiṃ karomi ||
bhara iti bhṛñ bharaṇe ' ñitvā- dubhayapadaṃ |

vajuryam vajaraṇīyaṃ vjarayantaṃ vsarvamapyajarayantam vukṣitaṃ somena siktaṃ vsanāt vsanātanaṃ vyuvānaṃ vnityataruṇaṃ vtādṛśam vindram vavame vasmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya vtasya vtarpaṇāyā vā vhavāmahe vāhvayāmaḥ ||

vyasmādindrāddhṛtaḥ kiṃ canemate viśvānyasminsaṃbhutādhi vīryāṃ | jaṭhare somaṃ tanvī saho maho haste vajraṃ bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum || 2 || yasmāt | indrāt | vṛhataḥ | kim | cana | īm | ṛte | viśvāni | asmin | sam'bhṛtā | adhi | vīryā | jaṭhare | somam | tanvi | sahaḥ | mahaḥ | haste | vajram | bharati | śīrṣaṇi | kratum ||2||
vvṛhataḥ vmahataḥ vyasmāna vindrāt vṛte vkim vapi vīm vidaṃ vjagat vcana vnāstītyarthaḥ ||
vuktārthe vmantraḥ - ' vnendrādṛte vpavate vdhāma vkiṃ vcana ' (ṛ. saṃ. 9. 69.6) iti |
vasmin vindre vviśvāni vsarvāṇi vvīryāṇi vsāmarthyāni vadhi vsaṃbhṛtā vadhikaṃ vsaṃbhṛtānyāste |
vyathendraḥ vjaṭhare vsvodare vsomam vabhisutaṃ vsomarasaṃ vbharati vbibharti |
kiṃca vtanvi vtanvāṃ vsvakīye vsarvasmin vśarīre vsahaḥ vbalaṃ vmahaḥ vtejaśca vbibharti |
vśīrṣaṇi vśirasi vkratuṃ vvijñānaṃ vbharati vbibharti ||

na kṣoṇībhyāṃ paribhvai ta indriyaṃ na samudraiḥ parvatairinra te rathaḥ | na te vajramanrśvoti kaścana yadāśubhiḥ pataṃsi yojanā puru || 3 || na | kṣoṇībhyām | pari'bhvai | te | indriyam | na | samudraiḥ | parvataiḥ | indra | te | rathaḥ | na | te | vajram | anu | aśnoti | kaḥ | cana | yat | āśu'bhiḥ | pataṃsi | yojanā | puru || 3 ||
vhe vindra vte vtava vindriyaṃ vbalaṃ vkṣoṇībhyāṃ vdyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ vna vparibhve vna vparibhavanīyam ||
kiṃca vte vrathaḥ vsamudraiḥ vparvataiḥ vca vna vparibhavanīyaḥ |
vte vvajram vāyudhaṃ vkaścana vpumān vna vanvaśnoti
‘yat yadā asuravadhārthaṃ digvijaya- kāle ’puha puruṇi bahūni ’yojanā yojanāni ’patasi gacchasi |
tadvā tatra balādi na paribhavanīya- miti samanvayaḥ ||
viśve ha̭smai yaja॒tāya̭ dhṛṣṇa॒ve kratuṃ bhara̭nti vṛṣa॒bhāya̭ saścate |
vṛṣā̭ yaja॒sva ha॒viṣā̭ vidu॒ṣṭara̭ḥ pibeṃndra॒ soma̭ṃ vṛṣa॒bheṇa̭ bhānu॒nā ||
viśve | hi | asmai | yajatāya | dhṛṣṇave | kratum | bharanti | vṛṣabhāya | saścate | vṛṣā | yajasva | haviṣā | viduḥstaraḥ | piba | indra | somam | vṛṣabhena | bhānunā || 4 ||

he yajamāna ’viśve sarve janāḥ ’yajatāya sarvairyajanīyāya ’dhṛṣṇave śatrūṇāṃ dharṣaṇaśīlāya ’vṛṣabhāya kāmānāṃ varṣitre ’saścate sajamānāya stutyādikamavatsu stotṛṣu etādṛśāyendrāya ’kratuṃ yajñādilakṣaṇaṃ karma ’bharanti ’hi haranti khalu |
vṛṣṇa̭ḥ ko॒śaḥ pa̭vate॒ madhva̭ ū॒rmirvṛ̭ṣa॒bhāya̭ pā॒tavḙ |
vṛṣa॒ṇādhva̭ryu vṛṣa॒bhāso̭ a॒drayo̭ vṛṣa॒ṇaṃ soma̭ṃ vṛṣa॒bhāya̭ su॒nvati̭ ||
vṛṣṇaḥ | kośaḥ | pavate | madhvaḥ | ūrmiḥ | vṛṣabha'annāya | vṛṣabhāya | pātave | vṛṣaṇā | adhvaryu iti | vṛṣabhārsāḥ | adrayaḥ | vṛṣaṇam | somam | vṛṣabhāya | sunvanti ||5||
he indra ’vṛṣṇaḥ phalasya varṣituḥ ’madhvaḥ madakarasya somasya ’kośaḥ rasaḥ ’ūrmiḥ anuṣṭhātṛṇāṃ pātṝṇāṃ ca prerakaḥ san ’pavate gacchati ||
’vṛṣabhānnāya balavardha- kāni annāni yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
tādṛśāya ’vṛṣabhāya kāmānāṃ varṣitre indrāya ’pātave pānārthaṃpavata iti samanvayaḥ |

kiṃca ’vṛṣaṇā somarasasecanasamarthau ’adhvaryu adhvaryupratiprasthātārau ’vṛṣabhāsaḥ varṣakāḥ ’adrayaḥ abhiṣavagrāvāṇaśca ’vṛṣaṇaṃ svargādiphalasya settāraṃ ’somaṃ ’vṛṣabhāya devānāṃ śreṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ ’sunvati sunvanti ||

vṛṣā te vajra̭ uta te vṛṣā ratho vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣaṇāyāyudhā | vṛṣṇo mada̭sya vṛṣabha tvamīśiṣa indra somasya vṛṣabhasya tṛṇuhi || 6 || vṛṣā | te | vajraḥ | uta | te | vṛṣā | rathaḥ | vṛṣaṇā | harī iti | vṛṣaṇā | āyudhā | vṛṣṇaḥ | madasya | vṛṣabha | tvam | īśiṣe | indra | somasya | vṛṣabhasya | tṛṇuhi || 6 || 'vṛṣabha kāmānāṃ varṣaka he indra 'te tava 'vajraḥ 'vṛṣā kāmavarṣaka | tathā 'te 'rathaḥ api 'vṛṣā | te 'harī etannāmakāvaśvau 'vṛṣaṇā varṣakau | tatra 'āyudhā vajravyatiriktānyāyudhānyapi 'vṛṣa- bhāṇi | 'vṛṣṇaḥ varṣakasya 'madasya madakarasya somasya 'tvam eva 'īśiṣe svāmī bhavasi | he 'indra 'vṛṣabhasya varṣakasya 'somasya somena 'tṛṇuhi tṛptaṃ bhava || 'tṛpa prīṇane' | svādiḥ | kṣudhādipu (pā. sū. 8. 4. 39) 'tṛnamana tṛpnoti' iti paṭhitam | tathāpi sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvādatra ṇatvapratiṣedho na bhavati ||

pra te nāva̭ na sarmane vaca̭syuvaṃ brahma̭ṇā yāmi sarvaneṣu dādhrpiḥ | kuvinno̭ asya vaca̭so nivodhi̭padindramuttamaṃ na vasunaḥ sicāmahe || 7 || pra | te | nāvam | na | samane | vacasyuvam | brahmaṇā | yāmi | sarvaneṣu | dādhrpiḥ | kuvit | naḥ | asya | vacasaḥ | ni | vodhi | pata | indram | uttamam | na | vasunaḥ | sicāmahe || 7 || 'dādhrpiḥ 'tvamamādācchatrūṇāṃ dharṣaka'haṃ 'samane saṃgrāme 'vacasyuvam || ami tanvādidvāṭuvaḍā- deśaḥ || stotramicchantaṃ 'nāvaṃ 'na nāvamivāpadyamānakaṃ 'te tvāṃ savaneṣu triṣu 'brahmaṇā stotreṇa 'pra 'yāmi prāpnomi' | kiṃca 'asya 'vacasaḥ stutilakṣaṇametadvākyaṃ 'kuvit bahu 'nivodhipat indro nitarāṃ budhyatām || 'budha avagamane' | leṭi 'sitrabahuḻam' iti sipa | kuvidyogādanighātaḥ | 'tiṅi codāttavati' iti gaternighātaḥ || vayaṃ ca 'uttamaṃ 'na jalamya nidhānabhūtaṃ kṛpamiva 'vasunaḥ nidhānabhūtam 'indraṃ 'sicāmahe somena sinmāmaḥ || 'sicir kṣaraṇe' | svaritat | āgamānuśāsanasyānityatvāt numabhāvaḥ ||

purā saibādhādabhyā va̭vṛtsva no dhenurna vatsaṃ yava̭sasya pipyuṣī | sakṛtsu tai sumatibhiḥ śatakrato saṃ patnībhirvṛṣaṇo nasīmahe || 8 || purā | sam | ā | bādhāt | abhi | ā | vavṛtsva | naḥ | dhenuḥ | na | vatsam | yavasasya | pipyuṣī | sakṛt | su | tai | sumatibhiḥ | śatakrato | sam | patnībhiḥ | vṛṣaṇaḥ | nasīmahe || 8 ||
he indra ᵛsaṃvādhāt śatrujanyāt saṃvādhāt ᵛpurā ᵛnaḥ asmān ᵛabhyā ᵛvavṛtasva āvartaya ᵛ|
yathā saṃvādho'smān na spṛśati tathā kurvityarthaḥ |
yathā ᵛyavasasya ghāsena ᵛpippupī āpyāyitā dhenurvaisaṃ kṣudhādyātparāvartayati tadvat |
he ᵛśatakrato vayaṃ ᵛsumatibhiḥ svadvipayaiḥ śobhanaiḥ stotraiḥ ᵛsakṛn sakṛdapi ᵛsu ᵛnasīmahi suṣṭhu vyāpyemahi |
sekkāro yuvāno yathā ᵛpatnībhiḥ vyāpyante tadvat ||
nunaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhṛgbhago no bṛhaddema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
nunam | sā | te | prati | varam | jaritre | duhīyat | indra | dakṣiṇā | maghonī | śikṣa | stotṛbhyaḥ | mā | ati | dhṛk | bhagaḥ | naḥ | bṛhat | vadema | vidathe | suvīrāḥ ||10||
‘atirātre paryāyāṇām’ iti khaṇḍe mūrcitaṃ - ‘tadasmai nadyamamaya pitra yasya jajñāna indrati yājyā’ ( ādha. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti ||
viśvā yadgotrā sahamā parīvṛtā made somasya daṃhitānyairayat ||
tat | asmai | nadyam | aṅgirasvat | arcata | śuṣmāḥ | yat | asya | ptana'rthā | ut'īrate | viśvā | yat | gotrā | sahasā | pari'vṛtā | made | somasya | daṃhitāni | airayat || 1 ||
he stotāraḥ ᵛnavyaṃ navataramanyevadaṣṭapṛṣṭhaṃ ᵛtat tādṛśaṃ stotram ᵛaṅgirasvat aṅgirasa iva ᵛasmai indrāya ᵛarcata vṛta |
ᵛyat yasmājjātamātramya ᵛasya indrasya ᵛśuṣmāḥ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakāṇi tejāṃsi ᵛpratnathā ||
ᵛyat yasmāt ᵛviśvā sarvān ᵛgotrā meghān |
gā udakāni trāyante rakṣantīti gotrā meghāḥ |
tān ᵛdaṃhitāni tena daḍhīkṛtān meghān ᵛsomasya ᵛmade harṣe saṃjāte sati ᵛsahasā balena ᵛairayat udghāṭayat |
yadvā viśvā sarvāṇi parīvṛtā valāsureṇa3krāntāni daṃhitāni parvatavile niruddhāni gotrā ||

sa bhūtu yo he prathamāya dhāryam ojo mimāno mahimānamātirat | śūro yo yutsu tanvaṃ parivyata śīrṣāṇi dyāṃ mahinā pratyamuñcata || 2 || saḥ | bhūtu | yaḥ | ha | prathamāya | dhāryase | ojaḥ | mimānaḥ | mahimānam | ā | atirat | śūraḥ | yaḥ | yutsu | tanvam | pari'vyata | śīrṣāṇi | dyām | mahinā | prati | amuñcata ||2||
^yaḥ indraḥ ^ojaḥ tejo balaṃ ^mimānaḥ kurvāṇaḥ san ^prathamāya prāthamakāya ^dhāyase |
^śūraḥ śatrūṇāṃ śātayitā ^yaḥ indraḥ ^yutsu yuddheṣu ^tanvaṃ svakīyaṃ śarīraṃ ^parivyata varmaṇā ^parivyatamakarot |
sa indraḥ ^mahinā svakīyena mahimnā ^śīrṣāṇi svaśirasi ^dyāṃ ^pratyamuñcata abhārayata ||

adhākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ vīryaṃ mahyadasyāgre brahmaṇā śuṣmairaiyaḥ | rathena haryaśvena viccyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhyak pṛthak || 3 || adha | akṛṇoḥ | prathamam | vīryam | mahat | yat | asya | agre | brahmaṇā | śuṣmaiḥ | airayaḥ | rathe'sthena | hari'aśvena | vi'cyutāḥ | pra | jīrayaḥ | sisrate | sadhyak | pṛthak || 3 ||
^adha api ca he indra tvaṃ ^prathamaṃ mukhyaṃ tat ^vīryaṃ sāmarthyam ^akṛṇoḥ akaroḥ |
^brahmaṇā stotreṇa stutisādhanabhūtena vedavākyena ^asya vīryasya stutarjanasya ^agre purataḥ ^yat ^śuṣmaṃ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakaṃ balam ^airayaḥ udgamayaḥ |

^jīrayaḥ jarayitāraḥ vādhakā asurāḥ ^rathena rathasthena ^haryaśvena tvayā ^viccyutāḥ : ^svasthānāccyutāḥ santaḥ ^sadhyak sadhīcīnāḥ parasparaṃ saṃgatāḥ ^pṛthak bhītyā viyuktāḥ ^santaḥ ^pra ^sidhate prakarṣeṇa dhāvanti ||
adisadhyo- rantodāttatvena nipātanāt ‘udāttasvaritayoḥ’ iti yaṇaḥ svaritatvam ||

adhā yo viśvā bhuvanābhi mujmaneśānakṛtapravayā abhyavardhata | ādrodasī jyotiṣā vahnirātanvīntamauṃsi dudhitā samavyayat || 4 || adha | yaḥ | viśvā | bhuvanā | abhi | mujmanā | īśāna'kṛta | pravayāḥ | abhi | avardhata | āt | rodasī iti | jyotiṣā | vahniḥ | ā | atanot | sīrvyan | tamāṃsi | dudhitā | sam | avyayat || 4 ||
atha api ca pravayāḥ pravṛddhāṅgaḥ purātano vā yaḥ indraḥ viśvā bhuvanā sarvān lokān majmanā balena abhibhūya īśānakṛt ātmānaṃ sarvesyādhipatiṃ kurvan |
yadvā anyādīn devān tattallokādhipatīn kurvan abhyavardhata sarvataḥ pravṛddho'bhavat |
āt an anantaraṃ vahniḥ jagatāṃ voḍhā sa indraḥ jyotipā svīyane tejasā rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ātanot vyāpnot |
kiṃca tamāṃmi tamorūpāṇi rakṣāṃsi duhitā duḥsthitāni durgatāni sīdyan vistārayan samavyayat āvṛṇon |
saḥ | prācīnān | parvatān | dṛṃhat | ojasā | adharācīnam | akṛṇot | apām | apaḥ | adhārayat | pṛthivīm | viśvadhāyasam | astabhnāt | māyayā | dhāma | avatsaraḥ || 5 ||
a॒mā॒juri̭va pi॒troḥ sa॒cā sa॒tī sa॒mānā॒da sadḙsa॒tvāmi̭ye॒ bhaga̭m |
kṛ॒dhi॒ pra॒ke॒tamu॒pa mā॒syā bha̭ra॒ daddi॒ bhāga̭ṃ ta॒nvo3i॒ yena̭ mā॒maha̭ḥ ||
