sevamānaḥ saḥ indraḥ gātuṃ parṇabhirupadatānāmaṅgirasāṃ mārgam iṣṇan prerayan brahma teṣāṃ stotraṃ kāmapradānena tūtot ||
‘ tu vṛddhau ’ ityasya laḍi bahulaṃ chandasi iti vikaraṇasya śluḥ ||
kiṃca stavān stotrabhiḥ stūyamānaḥ sūryeṇa svātmabhūtena upasaḥ muṣṇan apaharan |
aśnute svatejasā sarvaṃ jagadityaścaḥ kaści- dasuraḥ |
tasya pūrvyāṇi purātanāni purāṇāni balāni vā śiśrathat abhayayat śithilīcakāra ||

sa ha śruta indro nāma deva ūrdhvo bhuvanmanuṣe dustamaḥ | arva priyarmaśāsanasya sāhānchiro bharadāsasya svadhāvān || 6 || saḥ | ha | śrutaḥ | indraḥ | nāma | devaḥ | ūrdhvaḥ | bhuvat | manuṣe | dustamaḥ | arva | priyam | arśāsanasya | sahān | śiraḥ | bharat | dāsasya | svadhā'vān || 6 ||
devaḥ dyotamānaḥ śrutaḥ kīrtimān ata eva dustamaḥ sarvairatiśayena darśanīyaḥ saḥ indraḥ manuṣe manoratham ūrdhvaḥ bhuvat kāmapradāne pravṛtte unmukhaḥ bhavat ||
sāhān śatrubhibhavan svadhāvān balavānindraḥ arśāsanasya lokaṃ bādha- mānasya dāsasya etannāmakasyāsurasya priyaṃ śiraḥ ava bharat adhaḥ pātayat ||

sa vṛtrahendraḥ kṛṣṇayonīḥ puraṃdaro dāsīrairayad vi | arjanayanmanave kṣāmapaśca satrā śaṃsaṃ yajamānasya tūtot || 7 || saḥ | vṛtra'hā | indraḥ | kṛṣṇayonīḥ | puram'daraḥ | dāsīḥ | airayat | vi | arjanayat | manave | kṣām | apaḥ | ca | satrā | śaṃsam | yajamānasya | tūtot || 7 ||
vṛtrahā vṛtrasya hantā puraṃdaraḥ śambarapurāṃ dārayitā saḥ indraḥ kṛṣṇayonīḥ nikṛṣṭajātīḥ dāsīḥ upakṣapayitrīrāsurīḥ senāḥ vi airayat vyanudat |
kiṃca manave manorathaṃ kṣāṃ pṛthivīm apaḥ 1. ja-ṇa-ta-tha-na-tra-udaṅmukhaḥ |

ha adhvaryo indrāya somaṃ bhara saṃpādaya | kīdṛśāya | viśvajite sarvasya jetre | tadeva prapañcayati | dhanajite śatruvijayena tadīyadhanānāṃ jetre | svarjite svargasya jetre'dhipataye | satrājite satrā saṃtataṃ jayaśīlāya mahato jetre vā | nṛjite nṛṇāṃ nāyakānāṃ jetre | urvarājite | urvarā sarva- sasyākhyā bhūḥ | tasyā jetre | aśvajite gojite balenāpahṛtānāṃ gavāṃ jetre | abjite vṛtreṇāntā- nāmapāṃ jetre | yajanāya yajanīyāya taramā indrāya haryatam | 'harya gatikāntyoḥ' | 'bhṛmṛdṛśi' ityādinā karmaṇyatac || kamanīyaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ vā somaṃ bharati samanvayaḥ ||
tuvigraye vahne duṣṭarītve satrāsāhe nama indrāya vocata ||
abhibhuve | abhibhujyāya | vanṛte | apāḻhāya | sahamānāya | vedhase | tuvigraye | vahne | duṣṭarītve | satrāsahe | namaḥ | indrāya | vocata || 2 ||

abhibhuve sarvasyābhibhavitre abhibhujyāya asurāṇāṃ bhañjakāya vanvate | 'vana paṇa saṃbhaktau' | dhayayena upratyayaḥ || śatrūṇāṃ dhanānāṃ saṃbhajakāya || apāḻhāya | sahaḥ karmaṇi niṣṭhā | uttvābhāva- śchāndasaḥ || śatrubhiranabhibhūtāya | sahamānāya sarvasahāya vedhase sarvasya vidhātre | tuvigraye pūrṇaprīvāya || yadvā 'gṛ śabde' | auṇādikaḥ karmaṇi kipratyayaḥ || tuvibhirbahubhiḥ stotavyyāya | vahne sarvasya voḍhe duṣṭarītve anyairdustaratvāya durhisāya | satrāsahe sarvadābhibhavitre mahato'bhibhavitre vā evaṃvidhāya indrāya namaḥ namaḥ-śabdapūrvakaṃ stotraṃ vocata he stotāro yūyaṃ brūta || brūño luṅi 'bruvo vaciḥ' | 'asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ' ityaḍādeśaḥ | 'vaca um' ityum | guṇaḥ ||
satrāsāho janabhakṣo janasahyavano yuṣma anu joṣamukṣitaḥ |
vṛtracyaḥ sahurirvikṣvārita indrasya vocaṃ pra kṛtāni vīryā ||
satrāsahaḥ | janabhakṣaḥ | janasahyavanaḥ | vyavanaḥ | yuṣma | anu | joṣam | ukṣitaḥ | vṛtracyaḥ | sahuriḥ | vikṣu | āritaḥ | indrasya | vocam | pra | kṛtāni | vīryā || 3 ||
satrāsahaḥ bahūnāmabhibhavitrā janabhakṣaḥ janānāṃ yajamānānāṃ kāmapradānena saṃbhaktā taiḥ saṃbhajanīya iti vā |
janasahaḥ balināṃ janānāmabhibhavitrā vyavanaḥ śatrūṇāṃ ghyāvayitā svarathānāt |
yuṣma yoddhā joṣam anu prītimanu ukṣitaḥ siktaḥ somena |
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ- 'yo vai bhāginaṃ bhāgāmudate cayate vaiṃ sa yadi vaiṃ na cayate'tha putramatha pautraṃ cayate tvaivanam' (ai. brā. 2. 7) iti |
1. ka-ma-vardha saṃbhajanāya; kha-ga-ṇa-dhanānāṃ saṃbhajanasya; jha-vardha saṃbhajanaya; jha1-vadhabhajanāya; ṇa-ta-tha-na-vardha bhajanāya; va-vardha bhajanāya |
abhibhavitā śatrūṇāṃ vikṣu prajāsu ārita: pālakatvena prāpto bhavati |
tādṛśasya indrasya kṛtāni vṛtrahananādirūpāṇi vīryā sāmarthyāni pra vocaṃ prakarṣeṇa vadāmi |
anānudo vṛṣabho dordhato vṛdho gambhīra ṛṣvo asa̭maṣṭakāvyaḥ |
radhracodaḥ śrathano vīḻitaspathurindraḥ suyajña upasaḥ svarjanat |
anānudaḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | dordhataḥ | vṛdhaḥ | gambhīraḥ | ṛṣvaḥ | asa̭maṣṭakāvyaḥ | radhracodaḥ | śrathanaḥ | vīḻitaḥ | pṛthuḥ | indraḥ | suyajñaḥ | upasaḥ | svaḥ | janat ||4||
anānudaḥ | anu paścāddadātītyanudaḥ | ātaśraॉpasarge iti kartari kaḥ | sa nāsti yasya sa tathoktaḥ | prabhūtadhanadānena samānaḥ nāstītyarthaḥ | ata eva vṛṣabhaḥ
indra śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehi cittiṃ dakṣasya subhagatvamasme |
poṣaṃ rayīṇāmariṣṭiṃ tanūnāṃ svātmānaṃ vācaḥ sudinatvamahmām ||
indra | śreṣṭhāni | draviṇāni | dhehi | cittim | dakṣasya | subhagatvam | asme iti | poṣam | rayīṇām | ariṣṭima | tanūnām | svātmānam | vācaḥ | sudinatvam | ahrām ||6||
he indra śreṣṭhāni uttamāni draviṇāni dhanāni asmabhyaṃ dhehi nidhehi |
asme asmabhyaṃ subhagatvaṃ śobhanadhanavattvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ vā dhehi |
rayīṇāṃ tvayā dattānāṃ dhanānāṃ poṣaṃ samṛddhiṃ dhehi |
yadvā tāyata ebhiḥ kulamiti tanvaḥ putrāḥ |
yeṣu indrādayo devā ijyante tāni sudināni |
sūtritaṃ- ‘trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ pro pvasmai purorathamiti tṛcāvānicchandasau’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 2 ) iti ||
‘daśame'hani’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaya ityetamyāḥ sthāne trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiramiti’ ( āśva. śrau. 8.12 ) iti |
‘tasya viśeṣānvakṣāmaḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiramiti marutvatīyasya pratipatta’ ( āśva. śrau. 10. 10 ) iti ||
‘trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiramiti stotriyaḥ’ ( ai ā. 5.1 ) iti sūtritam ||
trikadrukeṣu māheṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛptasomāṃmapāvadveṣapṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśat |
sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuru sainai saśvadevo devaṃ matyamindraṃ matya indūḥ ||

trikadrukeṣu | mahiṣaḥ | yava'āśiram | tuviśuṣmaḥ | tṛpat | somam | apivat | viṣṇunā | sutam | yathā | avaśat | saḥ | īm | mamāda | mahi | karma | kartave | mahām | urum | saḥ | enam | saśvat | devaḥ | devam | satyam | indram | satyaḥ | indūḥ || 1 ||
tṛpyan indraḥ <sup>v</sup>trikadrukeṣu jyotirgaurāyuri tyetannāmakeṣvābhi- ṣavikevahaḥsu <sup>v</sup>sutam abhiṣutaṃ <sup>v</sup>yavāśiraṃ yavamayaiḥ saktubhirmiśritam ||
pītaḥ <sup>v</sup>saḥ somaḥ <sup>v</sup>mahā mahāntam <sup>v</sup>uraṃ tejasā vistīrṇam <sup>v</sup>īm enamindraṃ <sup>v</sup>mamāda amādayat |

<sup>v</sup>satyaḥ <sup>v</sup>induḥ savan <sup>v</sup>devaḥ dīpyamānaḥ <sup>v</sup>maḥ somaḥ <sup>v</sup>satyaṃ yathārthabhūtaṃ <sup>v</sup>devaṃ somaṃ kāmayamānam <sup>v</sup>indraṃ <sup>v</sup>saśrat |

adha॒ tviṣī̭mā~ a॒bhyo̭jasā kriviṃ yu॒dhābha̭vadā roda̭sī a॒pa॒ṇadasya॒ maja̭nā pra vā̭vṛdhe | adha̭ttā॒nyaṃ ja॒ṭharḙ pre॒mara̭icayata sainḙ sa॒śradḙvo de॒vaṃ su॒tyami̭ndraṃ sa॒tya i̭nduḥ || 2 || adha | tvirṣi'mān | abhi | ojasā | krivim | yudhā | abhavat | ā | rodasī iti | apaṇat | asya | majamā | pra | vavṛdhe | adhatta | anyam | jaṭhare | pra | īm | aricayata | saḥ | enam | saśrat | devaḥ | devam | satyam | indram | satyaḥ | induḥ || 2 ||

<sup>v</sup>adha atha somapānānantaraṃ <sup>v</sup>tviṣīmān dīptimānindraḥ <sup>v</sup>ojasā balena <sup>v</sup>kriviṃ nāmāsuraṃ <sup>v</sup>yudhā yuddhena <sup>v</sup>abhi <sup>v</sup>abhavat abhibhūtavān |
kiṃca sa indraḥ <sup>v</sup>rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>apaṇat svatajemā samantāt pūrayāmāsa |
tathā <sup>v</sup>asya pītasya somasya <sup>v</sup>majmanā balena <sup>v</sup>pra <sup>v</sup>vāvṛdhe prakarṣeṇa vardhate |
yadvā asya kriverasurasya majmanā māreṇa rodasī apūrayat |
<sup>v</sup>saḥ indraḥ somaṃ dvedhā vibhajya <sup>v</sup>anyaṃ bhāgaṃ svakīye <sup>v</sup>jaṭhare <sup>v</sup>adhatta |
tathā taittirīyakaṃ- ‘yatharvaipāmardha- mindraḥ prati tasmādindro devatānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhāktamaḥ’ ( tai. saṃ. 5. 4. 8. 3 ) iti ||

sāka̭ṃ jā॒taḥ kratṷnā sāka॒moja̭sā vavakṣiya॒ sāka̭ṃ vṛ॒ddho vī॒ryaiḥ | sā॒sa॒hirmṛdho̭ vi॒rcarṣa̭ṇiḥ | dā॒tā rādha̭ḥ su॒tavḙ kā॒myaṃ vamṷ sainḙ sa॒śradḙvo de॒vaṃ su॒tyami̭ndraṃ sa॒tya i̭nduḥ || 3 || sākam | jātaḥ | kratunā | sākam | ojasā | vavakṣiya | sākam | vṛddhaḥ | vīryaiḥ | susahiḥ | mṛdhaḥ | vi'carṣaṇiḥ | dātā | rādhaḥ | stuvate | kāmyam | vasu | saḥ | enam | saśrat | devaḥ | devam | satyam | indram | satyaḥ | induḥ || 3 ||
^kanunā karmaṇā prajñayā vā ^sākaṃ saha ^jātaḥ ^sākamojasā balena saha ^vavaścitha viśvaṃ vodumicchasi ||
vaheḥ sanantasya liṭi mantratvādām na bhavati ||
kiṃca tvaṃ ^vīryaiḥ śatruhananādi- lakṣaṇaiḥ parākramaiḥ ^sākaṃ saha ^vṛddhaḥ ^pravṛddhaḥ ^mṛdhaḥ hiṃsakān saṃgrāmānvā ^sāsahiḥ |
teṣāmabhibhavitrā ^vicarapaṇiḥ puṇyakṛtaḥ apuṇyakṛtaśca ^viśeṣeṇa draṣṭā ^stuvate stotraṃ kurvāṇāya yajamānāya ^rādhaḥ sādhakaṃ ^kāmyaṃ prārthanīyaṃ ^vasu dhanaṃ ^dātā san vavaścitheti samanvayaḥ |
tav tyannaryaṃ nṛto'pa indra prathamaṃ pūryya divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam |

tav | tyat | naryam | nṛto iti | arpaḥ | indra | prathamam | pūryyam | divi | pra'vācyam | kṛtam | yat | devasya | śavasā | pra | ariṇāḥ | asum | riṇan | apaḥ | bhuvat | viśvam | abhi | adevam | ojasā | vidāt | ūrjam | śata'kratuḥ | vidāt | ipam || 4 ||
^nṛto sarveṣāṃ nartayitaḥ he ^indra ^naryaṃ narāṇāṃ hitakaraṃ ^prathamaṃ pratatam^3 ||
^devasya vijigīporasurasya ^amuṃ prāṇaṃ ^riṇan hiṃsan ^tvaṃ ^apaḥ tena niruddhānyudakāni ^prāriṇāḥ prerayaḥ |
atreyamamukramaṇikā- ‘gaṇānāmekonā brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ ha bārhaspatyāstu dṛṣṭaliṅgāḥ pañcadaśyanye triṣṭubhau’ iti |
‘sṛṣṭodakam’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam— ‘gaṇānāṃ tvā prathaśca yasya’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 6) iti ||

gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnāmupamaśravastamam | jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ śṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam || 1 || gaṇānām | tvā | gaṇa'patim | havāmahe | kavim | kavīnām | upamaśravaḥ'tamam | jyeṣṭha'rājam | brahmaṇam | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | ā | naḥ | śṛṇvan | ūti'bhiḥ | sīda | sādanam || 1 ||
he vbrahmaṇaspate brahmaṇo'sya parivṛḍhasya karmaṇo vā pate pālayitaḥ vgaṇānāṃ devādigaṇānāṃ sambandhinaṃ vgaṇapatiṃ strīyānāṃ patim |
teṣāṃ madhye rājantaṃ vbrahmaṇaṃ mantrāṇāṃ svāminaṃ vtvā tvāṃ vhavāmahe asmin karmaṇyāhvayāmaḥ |
kiṃca vnaḥ asmākaṃ stutīḥ vśṛṇvan tvaṃ vūtibhiḥ pālanahetubhūtaiḥ vsādanam |

devāścitte amurye pracetaso bṛhaspati yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśaḥ | usāiva sūryo jyortipā maho viśvepābhirjanitā brahmaṇāmasi || 2 || devāḥ | cit | te | asūrya | pra'cetamaḥ | bṛhaspate | yajñiyam | bhāgam | ānaśaḥ | usāḥ'iva | sūryaḥ | jyortipā | mahaḥ | viśvepāḥ | it | janitā | brahmaṇām | asi ||2||
vamurye amurāṇāṃ hantaḥ he vbṛhaspate vpracetamaḥ prakṛṣṭajñānāḥ vte tvadīyāḥ vdevāścit devā avi vyajñiyaṃ yajñārhaṃ vbhāgam vānaśuḥ prāpnuvan |
prakṛṣṭajñānavataste tava sambandhino devā iti yojanīyam |
pracetasi tvayi sati devā yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśire |
vjyortipā tejasā vmahaḥ mahanīyaḥ vsūryaḥ vusāiva |
yathā kiraṇān janayati tathā vviśveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ vbrahmaṇa3 mantrāṇāṃ vjanitā janayitaiva vasi ||
2. ma-matveṣu (? vasatyeṣu ) paraṃ teja iti usāḥ |
ā trivādhyā parirāpastamāṃsi ca jyotiṣmantaṃ rathamṛtasya tiṣṭhasi |
ā | trivādhya | pari'rapaḥ | tamāṃsi | ca | jyotiṣmantam | ratham | ṛtasya | tiṣṭhasi | bṛhaspate | bhīmam | amitradambhanam | rakṣaḥ'hanam | gotra'bhidam | svaḥ'vidam || 3 ||
parivadato nindakān tamāṃsi ca trivādhya tejasā nirākṛtya jyotiṣmantaṃ jyotiṣā tadvantam ṛtasya yajñasya prāpakaṃ bhīmaṃ śatrūṇāṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ amitradambhanaṃ śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsakam |
rakṣohaṇaṃ rakṣāsāṃ hantāraṃ gotrabhidaṃ meghānāṃ bhettāraṃ svarvivaṃ svargasya lambhakaṃ ratham ā tiṣṭhasi adhitiṣṭhasi ||

trātāraṃ tvā tūnanāṃ havāmahe'vaspataradhivaktāramasmayum | bṛhaspate devanido ni barhaya mā durevā uttaraṃ sumnamunśan || 8 || trātāram | tvā | tūnanām | havāmahe | avaspataḥ | adhivaktāram | asmayum | bṛhaspate | devanidaḥ | ni | barhaya | mā | duḥevāḥ | ut'taram | sumnam | ut | naśan || 8 ||

yadvā avasā rakṣaṇenāpadravyaḥ pārayitaḥ he ^bṛhaspate ^tanūnām aṅgānāṃ putrādīnāṃ vā ^trātāraṃ pālayitāram ^adhivaktāram asmāsu pakṣapātena adhikaṃ vakttāram ^asmayuṃ haviṣpradānasmān kāmayamānaṃ ^tvā ^tvāṃ ^havāmahe asmin karmaṇyāhvayāmaḥ |
^durevāḥ duṣṭagamanā durbuddhayaḥ śatravaḥ ^uttaram utkṛṣṭataraṃ ^sumnaṃ sukhaṃ ^mā ^unnaśan mā vyāmuvantu ||

tvayā vayaṃ suvṛdhā brahmaṇaspate spārhā vasu manuṣyā dadīmahi | yā nau dūre talito yā arātayo'bhi santi jambhayā tā anuprasaḥ || 9 || tvayā | vayam | su'vṛdhā | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | spārhā | vasu | manuṣyā | ā | dadīmahi | yāḥ | naḥ | dūre | talitaḥ | yāḥ | arātayaḥ | abhi | santi | jambhaya | tāḥ | anaprasaḥ ||9||
he ^brahmaṇaspate ^suvṛdhā suṣṭhu vardhayitrā ^tvayā hetunā ^vayaṃ ^spārhā spṛhaṇīyāni ^vasu dhanāni ^manuṣyā ||
^dūre dūradeśe ^yāḥ ^arātayaḥ ^yāḥ ca ^talitaḥ antike'rātayaḥ ^naḥ asmān ^abhi ^santi abhi bhavanti ^anaprasaḥ karmahīnān ^tāḥ arātīstān śatrūn ^jambhaya nāśaya |

atra niruktaṃ- ‘tvayā vayaṃ suvardhayitrā brahmaṇaspate spṛhaṇīyāni vasūni manuṣyebhya ādadīmahi yāśca no dūre talito yāścāntike'- rātayo'dānakarmāṇo vādānaprajñā vā jambhaya tā anapraso'pra iti rūpanāma’ ( niru. 3. 16 ) iti ||

tvayā vayumuttamaṃ dhīmahe vayo bṛhaspate papriṇā sasminā yujā | mā nau duḥśaṃsā abhidipmurrīśat pra suśaṃsā matibhistāripāmahi || 10 || tvayā | vayam | ut'tamam | dhīmahe | vayaḥ | bṛhaspate | papriṇā | sasminā | yujā | mā | naḥ | duḥśaṃsaḥ | abhi'dipmuḥ | īśat | pra | su'śaṃsāḥ | mati'bhiḥ | tāripāmahi || 10 ||
kāmānāṃ pūrakeṇa vassinā śuddhena yujā sahāyena havyā hetunā uttamaṃ vathaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ vayaṃ dhāmahaṃ dhārayāmaḥ ||
duḥśaṃsaḥ duḥśaṃsanīyaḥ abhidipsuḥ abhidambhitumabhidhitumicchuḥ puruṣaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ mā īśata mā īśiṣṭa |
vayaṃ matibhiḥ stotraiḥ suśaṃsāḥ śobhanaśaṃsanopetāḥ santaḥ pra tāripāmahi prakarṣeṇa vardhamahi ||
anānudo vṛṣabho jagmirāhavaṃ niṣṭaptā śatruṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ |
asi satya ṛṇayā brahmaṇaspata ugrasya cidmitā vīḻuharṣiṇaḥ ||
ananudaḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | jārgamaḥ | ā'havam | niḥ'taptā | śatrum | pṛtanāsu | sāsahiḥ | asi | satyaḥ | ṛṇa'yāḥ | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | ugrasya | cit | damitā | vīḻu'harṣiṇaḥ ||11||
ata eva vṛṣabhaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣitā āhavam ||
‘ āṅi yuddhe ’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 73) ityupapratyayaḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca ||
śatruṃ jñātayitāraṃ niṣṭaptā nitarāṃ tasya tāpakaḥ ||
‘ tādau ca niti0 ’ iti gateḥ svaraḥ ||
etārhastvaṃ satyaḥ satyaparākramaḥ satyaprajño vā asi |
ṇyantasya kvipi ṇilope ‘ lopo vyorvali ’ iti valopaḥ ||
kiṃca ugrasya cit ojasvino'pi damitā upaśamayitā vīḻuharṣiṇaḥ dṛḍhaharṣasya kāmukasya nāstikasya cidmitāsi ||
adaivena manasā yo riṣyati śāsāmugro manyamāno jighāṃsati |
bṛhaspate mā praṇaktasya no vadho ni karma manyuṃ durevasya śardhataḥ ||
adaivena | manasā | yaḥ | riṣyati | śasām | ugraḥ | manyamānaḥ | jighāṃsati | bṛhaspate | mā | praṇak | tasya | naḥ | vadhaḥ | ni | karma | manyum | duḥ'evasya | śardhataḥ ||12||
yaḥ pumān adaivena devānamanyamānena yadvā āsuravṛttiviśiṣṭena manasā asmān riṣyati hinasti ||
yaśca ugraḥ pāpacittaḥ manyamānaḥ ātmānaṃ bahu manyamānaḥ pumān śasām ukthasya śaṃsitāram |
hanteḥ sani ‘ añjhanagamāṃ sani ’ iti dīrghaḥ ||

ᵛmā ᵛpragak || ' pṛcī saṃparke' | śmavikaraṇī | vyatyayenāmāgamaḥ | ' cādilope' ' iti na nighātaḥ | vyatyayenādyudāttaḥ || kiṃca 'durevasya duṣṭamanasya 'śardhataḥ balavataḥ | yadvā duṣṭābhisaṃdhervegaṃ kurvataḥ tasya 'manyuṃ krodhaṃ jñānaṃ vā 'ni 'karma svaprasādāgnirākurmaśca ||

bhareṣu havyo namasopasadyo gantā vājeṣu sanitā dhanaṃdhanam | viśvā idyo abhidipsvo mṛdho bṛhaspatirvi vavahā rathauiva || 13 || bhareṣu | havyaḥ | namasā | upasadyaḥ | gantā | vājeṣu | sanitā | dhanam'dhanam | viśvāḥ | it | aryaḥ | abhi'dipsvaḥ | mṛdhaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | vi | vavaha | rathān'iva ||13||
saḥ 'bṛhaspatiḥ 'bhareṣu saṃgrāmeṣu 'havyaḥ yoddhabhiḥ svarakṣaṇārtham' āhvātavyaḥ 'namasopasadyaḥ sarvainamasopasadanīyaḥ |
tathā 'aryaḥ svāmī bṛhaspatiḥ 'abhidipsvaḥ abhibhāvane- cchāvatīḥ 'viśvāḥ 'it sarvā eva 'mṛdhaḥ hiṃsikāḥ senāḥ 'rathāniva yuddhe vegena parakīyān rathāniva 'vi 'vavahaṃ viśeṣeṇa śithilīcakāra |

tejiṣṭhayā tapanī rakṣasastapa ye tvā nide dadhire dṛṣṭavīryam | āvistatkṛṣnu yadasatta ukthyaṃ bṛhaspate vi parirāpau ardaya || 14 || tejiṣṭhayā | tapanī | rakṣasaḥ | tapa | ye | tvā | nide | dadhire | dṛṣṭa'vīryam | āviḥ | tat | kṛṣnu | yat | asat | te | ukthyam | bṛhaspate | vi | pari'ḍarapaḥ | ardaya ||14||
he 'bṛhaspate 'tejiṣṭhayā atiśayena tigamayā 'tapanī tāpakāriṇyā hetyā 'rakṣasaḥ rākṣasān 'tapa tāpaya |
'ye rākṣasāḥ 'dṛṣṭavīryaṃ yuddheṣu dṛṣṭaparākramaṃ tvāṃ 'nide nindāyayā vipayaṃ 'dadhire kṛtavantaḥ tān tāpayeti samanvayaḥ |
'te tava 'ukthyaṃ sarvaiḥ praśaṃsanīyaṃ 'yat vīryaṃ 'asat pūrvamāsīt 'tat adhunā 'āviḥ 'kṛṣva prakaṭīkuru |
tena 'ca' vīryeṇa 'parirāpaḥ parivadataḥ nindakānasurān 'vi 'ardaya viśeṣeṇa bādhasva ||
'pradānānām' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhāttamściyā upa vācaḥ sacante ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ - 'bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhāditi paridhānīyā ' ( āśva. śrau. 6. 5 ) iti ||

bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhādyumadvibhāti kratuṃmajjanaiṣu | yahīdayacchvasa ṛtaprajāta tadasvāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram || 15 || bṛhaspate | ati | yat | aryaḥ | arhāt | yuda'mat | vi'bhāti | kratu'mat | janeṣu | yat | dīdayat | śarvasā | ṛta'prajāta | tat | asmāsu | draviṇam | dhehi | citram ||15||
vṛtaprajāta srayenotpanna haṃ vbṛhaspate vartha: śreṣṭho brāhmaṇa: sarvān kāmānanīya 'yat brahma- varcasaṃ teja: varhāt pūjayet |
vjanepu brāhmaṇepu vśuman dīsiyuktaṃ vṛtumata jñānopetaṃ yadbrahmavarcasaṃ vvibhāti viśeṣeṇa dīpyate |
vyat ca vśavasā balena svāśrayaṃ janaṃ vdīdayat |
vcitraṃ cāyanīyaṃ vtat brahmavarcasarūpaṃ vdraviṇam vasmāsu vdhehi nidhehi |
yadvā artha udvāro'pi tvayā dattaṃ.dhanam atīvāhārt ahadhīta |
yacca tvahattaṃ dhanaṃ janepu tava stotraṃ kurvāṇepu dīsiyuktaṃ karmasādhanaṃ ca vibhāti yacca dhanaṃ śavasā asmādisamṛddhayā dīdayat svāśrayaṃ dīpayati tādṛśaṃ dhanamasmāsu dhehi |

tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ— 'bṛhaspate ati yadayau arhādityetayā paridadhyāttejaskāmo brahmavarcasakāmo'tīva vān yāntrabrahmavarcasamarhati cumaditi śumadiva vai brahmavarcasaṃ vibhātīti vīva vai brahmavarcasaṃ bhāti yahīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāteti dīdāyeva vai brahmavarcasaṃ tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citramiti citramiva vai brahmavarcasaṃ brahmavarcasī brahmayaśasī bhavati ' (ai. prā. 4. 11 ) iti |
mā na: stenebhyo ye abhi druhaspade nirāmiṇau ripavo'nnepu jāgradhu: |
ā devānāmohate vi trayo hṛdi bṛhaspate na pura: sāmnau vidu: |
mā | na: | stenebhya: | ye | abhi | druha: | pade | nirāmiṇa: | ripava: | annepu | jagṛdhu: | ā | devānām | ohate | vi | traye: | hṛdi | bṛhaspate | na | pura: | sāmna: | vidu: || 16 ||
'ye caurā: vdruha: prāṇadrohasya vpade sthāne vnirāmiṇa: nitarāṃ ramaṇaśīlā: vripava: hiṃsakā: santa: vannepu parakīyeṣu vabhi vjāgradhu: abhikāṅkṣanti |
ye ca vdevānāṃ vvi vtraya: viśeṣeṇa varjanam |
vī vrī iti dhātu varjanaṃ vartate |
' ya evaṃ vidvān dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāti nanaṃ dakṣiṇā trīnāti ' ( tai. brā. 2 2 . 5. 1 ) ityekasya varjanārthe dṛṣṭavādaparasyāpi 2 varjanārthatvam |
tat vhadisvakīye hṛdaye vā vohate āhavanti |
devānāṃ yāgān stutośca na karavāmeti manyanta iti yāvat |
ye pumāṃsa: vsāmna: sāmamayāstvata: vpara: parastādanyaduṣkṛtaṃ sāma yadakṣogham |
kintu sarvasādhakaṃ 3 sāma tvāmeva viduṣo'smān stenebhyo mā dā: |
viśvebhyo hi tvā bhurvanebhyaspari tvatārjanutsāmna:sāmna: kavi: |
sa ṛṇacihnaṇayā brahmaṇaspatirdruho hantā maha ṛtasya dhartari |
viśvebhya: | hi | tvā | bhurvanebhya: | pari | tvaṣṭā | arjanat | sāmna:'sāmna: | kavi: | sa: | ṛṇa'cit | ṛṇa'syā: | brahmaṇa: | pati: | druha: | hantā | maha: | ṛtasya | dhartari || 17 ||
he brahmaṇaspate¹ tvaṣṭā prajāpatiḥ ²viśvebhyaḥ ³bhuvanebhyaḥ ⁴pari sarvebhyo bhūtajātebhya utkṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ ⁵ajanat ⁶hi arjījanat khalu |
yadvā kaviḥ krāntadarśī tvaṣṭā sāmnaḥsāmnaḥ sarvasyāpi sāmnaḥ māreṇa¹ tvān² ajījanat |
kiṃca ⁹saḥ ³brahmaṇaspatiḥ ⁴mahaḥ mahataḥ ⁵ṛtasya yajñasya ⁶dhartāra dhārake yajamāne ⁷ṛṇacit stotrakāmamṛṇamiva cinotīti ṛṇacit |
kiṃca ⁸ṛṇayāḥ pāparūpasya ṛṇasya yāvayitā pṛthakartā ca³ ⁹duhaḥ karmaṇe droghurasurasya ⁰hantā bhavati ||
tatvaṃ śriyaṃ vyajihīt parvato gātro golamudasṛjo yadāṅgiraḥ |
indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtaṃ bṛhaspate nirapāmaubjo arṇavam ||
tatvaṃ | śriye | vi | ajihīt | parvata: | gavām | gotram | ut | asṛja: | yat | aṅgira: | indreṇa | yujā | tamasā | pari | āvṛtam | bṛhaspate | niḥ | apām | aubja: | arṇavam || 18 ||
¹aṅgiraḥ āṅgirasa he ²bṛhaspate ³gavām āvārako valenādhiṣṭhitaḥ ⁴parvata: ⁵tava ⁶śriyai āśrayaṇārthaṃ ⁷vyajihīt vivṛtadvāratāmagacchat |

gavām samūhaṃ ¹udasṛjaḥ niragamayaḥ tadā² ³indreṇa ⁴yujā sahāyena yuktastvaṃ ⁵tamasā vṛtrāsureṇa ⁶parīvṛtaṃ parita ākrāntam ⁷apām ⁸arṇavaṃ sthānabhūtaṃ meghaṃ ⁹niḥ ⁰aubjaḥ nitarām adhomukhamakārṣīḥ ||
brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yuntā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva |
viśva tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadema vidathai suvīrāḥ ||
brahmaṇa: | pate | tvam | asya | yuntā | su | uktasya | bodhi | tanayam | ca | jinva | viśvam | tat | bhadram | yat | avanti | devā: | bṛhat | vadema | vidathe | suvīrā: || 19 ||
he ¹brahmaṇaspate brahmaṇaṃ stotrāṇāmadhipate ²asya jagataḥ ³yantā niyāmakaḥ ⁴tvaṃ ⁵sūktasya asmadīyamidaṃ brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ sūktaṃ ⁶bodhi budhyasva |
bhavādṛśāḥ ²devāḥ ³yadavanti rakṣanti ⁴tat tādṛśaṃ ⁵viśvaṃ sarvaṃ ⁶bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ bhavati |
ato vayaṃ ⁷vidathe asmin yajñe ⁸suvīrāḥ śobhanaputrapautrāḥ santaḥ ⁹bṛhat pra nūtamidaṃ stotraṃ ⁰vadema brūyāma ||
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa⁶ viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśe ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye dvitīyāṣṭake ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
1. ka-kha-ga-gha-ṇa-jha-jha-1-ṇa-1-ta-tha-na-ma-va-brahmaṇaspatiṃ maho mahato ṛtasya yajñasya dhartāra dhārake yajamāne |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
atrānukramyate—‘semāṃ poḻaśānyā triṣṭubdvādaśī ca saindrī ca’ iti |
‘brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ ha’ ityuktatvāt tulādiparibhāṣayā idamādīni trīṇi sūktāni brāhmaṇaspatyāni |
semāmviddhi prabhṛti ya īśiṣe'yā vidhem navayā mahā girā |
yathā no mīḍhvāntastarvate sakhā tava bṛhaspatiḥ sīṣadhaḥ sota noṃ matim ||
yaḥ 'brahmaṇaspatiḥ 'nanvāni namanīyāni rākṣasādīni 'ojasā balena 'vi 'anamat nitarāmanamayat prahvībhūtānyakarot |
'uta api ca sa brahmaṇaspatiḥ 'manyunā manunā krodhena vā ||
'manyurmanyaterdīptikarmaṇaḥ krodhakarmaṇo vadhakarmaṇo vā' ( niru. 10. 29 ) iti yāskaḥ ||
tathā 'vasumantaṃ gorūpadhanavantaṃ 'parvataṃ valanāmnā asureṇa biladvāre pidhānārthaṃ nihitaṃ śiloccayam 'ā 'ca 'abhimukhyena cet ||
samuccayārthatve tu 'cavāyoge prathamā ' iti pūrvasya avyāvayasya āyudāttatvaṃ syāt |
tat | devānām | deva'tamāya | katvam | aśnan | dṛḻhā | atradanta | vīḻitā | ut | gāḥ | ājat | abhinat | brahmaṇā | valam | agūhata | tamaḥ | vi | acakṣayat | svaḥ | iti svaḥ || 3 ||
tathā 'brahmaṇā ātmīyena mantreṇa 'valaṃ sarvasyāvārakam asuram 'abhinat mantra- sāmarthyenābhaitsīt |
tameva viśve papire khardaśau bahu sākaṃ sisicurutsamṛdriṇam ||
aśma'āsyam | avatam | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ | madhu'dhāram | abhi | yam | ojasā | atṛṇat | tam | eva | viśve | papire | svaḥ'dṛśaḥ | bahu | sākam | sisicaḥ | utsam | udriṇam ||4||
^brahmaṇaspatiḥ brahmaṇo mantrasya patiḥ pālayitā devaḥ ^asmāsyam aśmavat dṛḍharāsyam |
^madhudhāraṃ madhudāyitrī udakadhārā yasya tādṛśam ^avatam avasthāt tataṃ vistṛtaṃ ^yaṃ megham ^ojasā balena ^abhi ^atṛṇat |
tasya saṃbandhino draṣṭāro raśmayaḥ ^papire gharmakāle pibanti |
te ca raśmayo varṣāsu ^utsam utsecanavantam ^udriṇam udakavantaṃ meghaṃ ^sākaṃ saha yugapadeva ^bahu ^sisicyuḥ |
gharmakāle yapītaṃ tato'pi bahutaraṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ siñcantītyarthaḥ ||

sanā tā kā citrbhuvanā bhavītvā mādbhiḥ śaradbhirduro varanta vaḥ | aryatantā carato anyadanyadidyā cakāraṃ vayunā brahmaṇaspatiḥ || 5 || sanā | tā | kā | cit | bhuvanā | bhavītvā | mādbhiḥ | śaradbhiḥ | duraḥ | varanta | vaḥ | aryatantā | carataḥ | anyat'anyat | it | yā | cakāra | vayunā | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ || 5 ||
he ṛtvijyamānāḥ ^vaḥ yuṣmadarthaṃ ^sanā sanātanāni ^tā tāni ^kā ^cit kāni cit brahmaṇaspateḥ prajñānāni ^bhuvanā bhuvanānām |
‘svatavasmāsoṣāṃ ca ta iṣyate’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 48. 2) iti tattvam ||
tadanantaram ^ayatantā ayatamānau aprayatnau ubhau lokau cauśca pṛthivī ca ^anyadanyadit anyadanyadeva pṛthivī vṛṣṭijalaṃ divyamudakaṃ dyauḥ |
udakakāryaṃ havirlakṣaṇaṃ pārthivamajñam evaṃ parasparavyatihāreṇa ^carataḥ bhuñjate |

abhinakṣanto abhi ye tamānuśunidhiṃ paṇīnāṃ paramaṃ guhā hitam | te vidvāṃsaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punaryata u āyantadudīyurāviśam || 6 || abhinakṣantaḥ | abhi | ye | tam | ānuśuḥ | ni'dhim | paṇīnām | paramam | guhā | hitam | te | vidvāṃsaḥ | prati'cakṣya | anṛtā | punaḥ | yataḥ | ū~ iti | āyan | tat | ut | īyuḥ | ā'viśam || 6 ||

gosamūhe paṇibhirasurairapahṛte sati paṇīnāṃ sthānaṃ saramālyā devaśunyā jñātvā brahmaṇaspatinā sṛṣṭā aṅgirasastasthānaṃ prāpya gosamūhaṃ paṇibhinirmitā māyāśca dṛṣṭvā asuranivāsasthānaṃ svahastod- tenābhinā dagdhvā pratyāgacchan |
ᐡta ᐢnidhiṃ gosamūharūpaṃ nidhānaṃ dhanaṃ ᐣparamam utkṛṣṭaṃ ᐤpaṇīnām ||
paṇibhirguhāyāṃ nihitaṃ sthāpitam ᐥabhi ᐦānaśruḥ abhilakṣya ānaśire prāptavantaḥ |
ᐧvidvāṃsaḥ abhijñāḥ ᐨte aṅgirasaḥ ᐩanṛtā anṛtāni asuraiḥ kṛtā māyāḥ ᐪpraticakṣya dṛṣṭvā ᐫāviśam āveṣṭuṃ praveṣṭuṃ ᐬyata ᐭu yata eva sthānāt ᐮāyanū agacchan ᐯtat sthānaṃ ᐰpunaḥ ᐱudīyaḥ udagacchan |
ṛtāvānaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punarāt ā tasthuḥ kavayo mahaspathaḥ |
te bāhubhyāṃ dhamitamagnimaśmani nakiḥ po astyaraṇo jahurhi tam ||
ṛta'vānaḥ | prati'cakṣya | anṛtā | punaḥ | ā | ataḥ | ā | tasthuḥ | kavayaḥ | mahaḥ | pathaḥ | te | bāhu'bhyām | dhamitam | agnim | aśmani | nakiḥ | saḥ | asti | araṇaḥ | jahuḥ | hi | tam || 7 ||

tadvantaḥ ᐢkavayaḥ krāntadarśinaḥ sarvajñā aṅgirasaḥ ᐣanṛtā anṛtāni ᐤpraticakṣya pūrvoktaprakāreṇa dṛṣṭvā ᐥataḥ asmāt sthānāt ᐦpunaḥ ājigamivaḥ ᐧmahaspathaḥ mahato mārgān prati ᐨā ᐩtasthuḥ avatasthire |
avatiṣṭhamānāśca ᐪte ᐫbāhubhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ ᐬdhamitaṃ mathanotpāditaṃ prajvalitam ᐭagnim ᐮaśmani paṇīnāṃ nivāsabhūte śilocaye ᐯjahurhi dagdhuṃ tyaktavantaḥ khalu |
ᐰaraṇaḥ aramayitā dāhena duḥkhakārī ᐱsaḥ agniḥ pūrvaṃ tatra ᐲnakiḥ ᐳasti na vidyate |
ṛtajyena kṣipreṇa brahmaṇaspatyatra vaṣṭi pra tadaśnoti dhanvanā |
tasya sādhvīriṣavo yābhirasyati nṛcakṣaso dṛśye karṇayonayaḥ ||
ṛta'jyena | kṣipreṇa | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ | yatra | vāṣṭi | pra | tat | aśnoti | dhanvanā | tasya | sādhvīḥ | iṣavaḥ | yābhiḥ | asyati | nṛ'cakṣasaḥ | dṛśye | karṇa'yonayaḥ || 8 ||

ṛtaṃ satyameva jyā yasya tena ᐡkṣipreṇa iṣūṇāṃ kṣepakeṇa ᐢdhanvanā dharaṇabhūtena dhanuṣā ᐣbrahmaṇa- spatiḥ ᐤbrahmaṇo mantrasya pālayitā devaḥ ᐥyatra yasmin vipaye ᐦvaṣṭi kāmayate ᐧtat ᐨpra ᐩaśnoti prakarṣeṇa vyāpnoti ||
ᐪtasya dhanuṣaḥ ᐫsādhvīḥ sādhikāstāḥ ᐬiṣavaḥ bhavanti ᐭyābhiḥ iṣubhiḥ brahmaṇaspatiḥ ᐮasyati rākṣasādīn kṣipati |
sarvajñasya brahmaṇaspateḥ ᐰdṛśye darśanāya jñānāya jātāḥ ᐱkarṇayonayaḥ śrotrendriyeṇa grāhyā mantrabhūtāḥ ākarṇakṛtā vā bāṇāḥ |
1. ka-jha-ña-ṇa-ta-dha-ma-va-he brahmaṇaspate tvayā sṛṣṭāḥ brahmaṇaspatiḥ; kha-ga-pha-yaḥ brahmaṇaspatiḥ; na-he brahmaṇaspate tvayā sṛṣṭāḥ |
sa sa̭nyaḥ sa vi̭nyaḥ purohi̭taḥ sa suṣṭṷtaḥ sa yu॒dhi brahmaṇa॒spatiḥ |
cākṣmo yadvā॒jaṃ bhara̭te ma॒tī dhanādi॒tyūrya̭stapati ta॒pyatṷrvṛthā ||

saḥ | sa॒m'nyaḥ | saḥ | vi॒'nyaḥ | pu॒raḥ'hi̭taḥ | saḥ | su॒'stṷtaḥ | saḥ | yu॒dhi | brahmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tiḥ | cākṣ‌maḥ | yat | vā॒jam | bhara̭te | ma॒tī | dhanā̭ | āt | it | sū॒ryaḥ | ta॒pa॒ti | ta॒pyatṷḥ | vṛ॒thā || 9 ||
˅purohitaḥ devaiḥ purato'tra sthāpitaḥ ˅saḥ ˅brahmaṇaspatiḥ ˅sanyaḥ viśliṣṭānāṃ mantraiḥ saṃgamayitā bhavati |
sarvasya draṣṭā sarvasaho vā brahmaṇaspatiḥ ˅vājam annaṃ ˅matī mananīyaṃ praśastaṃ ˅dhanā dhanaṃ ca stotṛṇāmarthāya ˅bharate bibharti vṛddhyārā poṣayati |
brahmaṇaspatinā dattairdhaneśca yajñasya siddhatvāt svayaṃ kevalaṃ havīṃṣi bhuñjāna eva vartate ityarthaḥ ||
vibhu prabhu prathamaṃ medhanāva̭to bṛhaspateḥ suvi॒datrā̭ṇi rā॒dhyā |
i॒mā sātā̭ni ve॒nyasya̭ vā॒jino॒ yena॒ janā̭ u॒bhayḙ bhu॒ñjate॒ viśa̭ḥ ||
vi॒bhu | pra॒bhu | pra॒tha॒mam | me॒dha॒nā'va̭taḥ | bṛhaspatḙḥ | su॒vi॒datrā̭ṇi | rā॒dhyā | i॒mā | sātā̭ni | ve॒nyasya̭ | vā॒jina̭ḥ | yena̭ | janā̭: | u॒bhayḙ | bhu॒ñjatḙ | viśa̭ḥ || 10 ||
˅vibhu vibhūti vyāptāni ˅prabhu prabhūni prauḍhāni ˅prathamaṃ prathamāni mukhyāni evaṃbhūtāni ˅medhanāvataḥ varṇavato vṛṣṭipradasya ˅bṛhaspateḥ bṛhato mantrasya pālayituḥ saṃbandhini ˅suvidatrāṇi ||
˅yena anena ˅ubhaye ubhayavidhāḥ ˅janāḥ stotāro yajamānāśca devā manuṣyāśca vā ˅viśaḥ niviṣṭāḥ santaḥ ˅bhuñjate bhogān labhante |
yo'va̭re vṛ॒janḙ vi॒śvathā̭ vi॒bhurmahā̭mu॒ raṇa̭ḥ śa॒rdhamā̭ va॒vakṣi̭tha |
sa de॒vo de॒vānpra̭ti॒ papra̭the pṛ॒thu vi॒śvedu॒ tā pari̭bhūrbrahmaṇa॒spati̭ḥ ||

yaḥ | a॒va॒re | vṛ॒janḙ | vi॒śva'thā̭ | vi॒bhuḥ | ma॒hām | ū~ iti̭ | ra॒ṇaḥ | śa॒rdhamā̭ | va॒vakṣi̭tha | saḥ | de॒vaḥ | de॒vān | pra॒ti | pa॒pra॒the | pṛ॒thu | vi॒śvā | it | ū~ iti̭ | tā | pa॒ri'bhūḥ | brahmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tiḥ || 11 ||
vviśvathā sarvaprakāreṇa vvibhuḥ vyāsaḥ vraṇaḥ ramayitā stotavyo vā vyaḥ vbrahmaṇaspatiḥ vacare nikṛṣṭe vvrajane varjanahetubhūte bale vartamānam |
ubhayavidhaṃ stotāraṃ vśavasā ātmīyena balena vvavakṣita voḍhumicchati |
vsaḥ vdevaḥ dānādiguṇayuktaḥ vdevān vprati sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ pratinidhiḥ san vpṛthu vprapathe atyantaṃ prathate |
yasmādevaṃ tasmān vviśvedu sarvāṇyeva vtā tāni sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni vparibhūḥ paribhavan abhibhavan vartate iti śeṣaḥ ||
viśvaṃ satyaṃ maghavānā yuvoridārśvana pra minanti vrataṃ vām |
viśvam | satyam | maghavānā | yuvaḥ | it | ārṣaḥ | cana | pra | minanti | vratam | vām | accha | indrābrahmaṇaspatī iti | haviḥ | naḥ | annam | yujā'iva | vājinā | jigātama ||12||
tadvantau indrābrahmaṇaspatī vyuvorit yuvayoraiva vviśvaṃ sarvaṃ stotraṃ vsatyaṃ yathārtham |
stutyā yadyat guṇajātaṃ pratipādyate tatsarvaṃ yuvayorvidyamānameva natvāropita- mityarthaḥ |
etadupalakṣitāni sarvāṇyapi bhūtāni vvāṃ yuvayoḥ vvrataṃ karma vna vpra vminanti na hiṃsanti ||
he vindrābrahmaṇaspatī vnaḥ asmākaṃ vhaviḥ vaccha ābhimukhyena vjigāta gacchatam |
yujā rathe niyuktau vājinau vejanavantau aśvau vannaṃ ghāsaṃ prati yathā svayameva śīghraṃ gacchataḥ tadvat śīghramāgacchatamityarthaḥ ||
utāśiṣprā anu śṛṇvanti vahyaḥ sabheyo vipro bharate matī dhanā |
vīḻudveṣā anu vaśaṃ ṛṇmādadiḥ sa ha vājī saṃmithe brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
uta | āśiṣprāḥ | anu | śṛṇvanti | vahyaḥ | sabheyaḥ | vipraḥ | bharate | matī | dhanā | vīḻudveṣāḥ | anu | vaśam | ṛṇam | ā'dadiḥ | saḥ | ha | vājī | sam | it | the | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ || 13 ||
vuta api ca vāśiṣprāḥ āśutarāḥ śīghragāminaḥ | vvayaḥ | aśnāmaitat | voḍhāro brahmaṇasteraśvāḥ vanu vśṛṇvanti | asmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ stotramanukrameṇa śṛṇvanti | yadvā brahmaṇaspatinā
vvipra: medhāvī adhvaryurhotā vā vmatī mayā mananīyena stotreṇa ||
vdhanā havilakṣaṇāni dhanāni tasmai brahmaṇaspataye vbharate bibharti |
yadvā stotreṇa dhanāni bharate bibharti poṣayati |
bīḻūn dṛḍhān rākṣasādīn dveṣṭīti tādṛśo brahmaṇaspati: vvaśā vaśāyā: ||
vṛṇam asmābhiryajñabhi: pradeyamavadānātmakam anukrameṇa vādadi: ādātā bhavatīti śeṣa: |
avadānasya ṛṇatvaṃ ca taittirīye ‘tribhirṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhya: ’ (tai. saṃ. 6. 3. 10. 5) ityādinā spaṣṭamājñātam |
vaśā vaśasya kāmasyābhilāpasya ānuguṇyamādātā bhavatīti yojyam |

brahmaṇaspatairabhavadyathāvaśaṃ satyo munyurmahi karmā kariṣyataḥ | yo gā udājatsa dive vi cābhajanmahiva rīti: śarvasāsatpṛthak || 14 || brahmaṇa: | pate: | abhavat | yathā'vaśam | satya: | manyu: | mahi | karma | kariṣyataḥ | ya: | gā: | ut'ājat | sa: | dive | vi | ca | abhajat | mahī'iva | rīti: | śarvasā | asat | pṛthak || 14 ||
vmahi mahat vkarma vkariṣyataḥ vbrahmaṇaspate: vmanyu: mananasādhano mantra: krodho vā vyathāvaśaṃ yathākāmaṃ vsatya: avitatha: vabhavat |
vya: brahmaṇaspati: paṇibhirapahatā: vgā: vudājat udagamayat |
vsa: brahmaṇaspati: vdive dyulokāya tatratyebhyo devebhya ityartha: |
vvi vabhajat ca tā gā vibhaktāścākarot |
yathā gaṅgādīnāṃ sroto vibhaktaṃ sat nimnadeśā- bhimukhaṃ prasarati tathā vśavasā ātmīyena balena tattadevagṛhaṃ vpṛthak vibhibhram vasat agacchat ||

brahmaṇaspate suyamasya viśvahā rāya: syāma rathyo3 vayasvata: | vīreṣu vīrā~ upa pṛṇdhi nastvaṃ yadīśāno brahmaṇo verṣi me havam || 15 || brahmaṇa: | pate | su'yamasya | viśvahā | rāya: | syāma | rathya: | vayasvata: | vīreṣu | vīrān | upa | pṛṇdhi | na: | tvam | yat | īśāna: | brahmaṇa: | verṣi | me | havam || 15 ||
he vbrahmaṇaspate mantrādhipate vsuyamasya suṣṭhu niyantavyasya vvayasvata: annayuktasya vrāya: dhanasya vviśvahā viśveṣu sarveṣvaha:su vrathya: adhipataya: vsyāma bhūyāsma |
api ca ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥvīreṣu vīryājāteṣvasmadīyeṣu putreṣu ᵥvīrān putrān ᵥtvam ᵥupa ᵥpṛṇdhi saṃpṛktān kuru utpādaya |
havirlakṣaṇe- nānnena saha ᵥme ᵥhavaṃ madīyaṃ stutilakṣaṇamāhvānaṃ ᵥvepi kāmayase |
brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva |
viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhaddema vidathe suvīrāḥ |
brahmaṇaḥ | pate | tvam | asya | yantā | su'uktasya | bodhi | tanayam | ca | jinva | viśvam | tat | bhadram | yat | avanti | devāḥ | bṛhat | vadema | vidathe | suvīrāḥ || 16 ||
he ᵥbrahmaṇaspate ᵥyantā sarvasya jagato niyantā ᵥtvamasya ᵥsūktasya idaṃ sūktam |
‘ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ’ iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī |
buddhā ᵥtanayaṃ putraṃ ᵥca asmabhyaṃ ᵥjinva preraya |
ᵥyat ᵥbhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ ᵥdevāḥ sarve ᵥavanti rakṣanti ᵥviśvaṃ sarvaṃ ᵥtat bhadraṃ ca jinveti śeṣaḥ |
vayaṃ ca ᵥsuvīrāḥ śobhanairviraiḥ putrapautrādibhirupetaḥ santaḥ ᵥbṛhat prauḍhaṃ stotraṃ ᵥvidathe |
vidanti yajñavyatayā asmin devān jānantīti vidatho yajñaḥ |
‘ indhānaḥ ’ iti pañcacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ gāyatramadaṃ jāgataṃ brāhmaṇaspatyam |
tathā cānukrāntam— ‘ indhānaḥ pañca jāgataṃ tu ’ iti |
indhāno agniṃ vanavadanuṣyataḥ kṛtabrahmā śṛṇuvadrātahavya ita |
jātena jñātamati sa pra sarsṛte yaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ |
indhānaḥ | agnim | vanavat | vanuṣyataḥ | kṛta'brahmā | śṛṇuvat | rāta'havyaḥ | ita | jātena | jñātam | ati | saḥ | pra | sarsṛte | yam | 'yama | yujam | kṛṇute | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ || 1 ||
ᵥagnim ᵥindhānaḥ brahmaṇaspateryāgārthamagniṃ prajvalayan ᵥyajamānaḥ ᵥvanuṣyataḥ hiṃsiyato hiṃsāṃ kurvato vā śatrūn ᵥvanavat vanuyāt hiṃsyāt |
brahma stotraṃ kṛtaṃ yena sa tathoktaḥ |
tathā yajamānaḥ ᵥjātena putreṇa ᵥjātaṃ janitamutpāditaṃ ᵥsvasya pautram ᵥati ᵥpra ᵥsarsṛte atītya bhṛśaṃ prasarati |
ᵥyaṃ yajamānaṃ ᵥbrahmaṇaspatiḥ stotrahaviṣoḥ svīkaraṇena ᵥyujaṃ sakhāyaṃ ᵥkṛṇute kurute ᵥsaḥ samāna eva bhavatītyarthaḥ |
to॒kaṃ ca॒ tasya॒ tana̭yaṃ ca॒ vardha̭ye॒ yaṃ yaṃ yu॒jaṃ kṛ̭ṇute॒ brahmaṇa॒spati̭: ||

vīrḙbhiḥ | vī॒rān | va॒na॒vat | va॒nu॒ṣyataḥ | go॒bhiḥ | ra॒yim | pa॒pra॒that | vo॒dhati | ta॒mnā | to॒kam | ca | ta॒sya | ta॒na॒yam | ca | vardha̭te | yam'ya̭m | yu॒jam | kṛ॒ṇute | brahmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tiḥ || 2 ||
sa yajamānaḥ vīrebhiḥ vīraiḥ ātmīyaiḥ putraiḥ vanuṣyataḥ hiṃsataḥ vīrān śatruputrān vanavat vanuyāt hiṃsyāt |
api ca gobhiḥ sahitaṃ dhanaṃ paprathat prathayati vistārayati ||
tathā tmanā ātmanaiva bodhati sarvaṃ jānāti |
kiṃca tasya yajamānasya tokaṃ putraḥ tanayam vibhaktyavyayaḥ ||
yadvā tokaṃ tanayaṃ putraṃ pautraṃ ca brahmaṇaspatirvardhayati ||
si॒ndhurna kṣoda̭ḥ śi॒mīvā~ ṛ॒ghāya̭to vṛ॒ṣeva̭ va॒dhī̭ra॒bhi va̭ṣṭyo॒jasā̭ |
a॒gneri̭va pra॒si॒tirnāha̭ varte॒ve yaṃ yaṃ yu॒jaṃ kṛ̭ṇute॒ brahmaṇa॒spati̭: ||

si॒ndhuḥ | na | kṣoda̭ḥ | śi॒mī'vān | ṛ॒ghāya̭taḥ | vṛ॒ṣā'i̭va | va॒dhī̭n | a॒bhi | va॒ṣṭi | o॒jasā̭ | a॒gneḥ'i̭va | pra॒si॒tiḥ | na | aha̭ | vartḙve | yam'ya̭m | yu॒jam | kṛ॒ṇute | brahmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tiḥ || 3 ||
sindhuḥ syandanaśīlā nadī kṣodaḥ na kṣudhamānaṃ kūlaṃ yathā bhinatti tathā śimīvān śimīti karmanāma |
brahmaṇaspateḥ paricaraṇātmanā karmaṇā yukto yajamānaḥ ṛghāyataḥ hiṃsataḥ śatrūn ojasā balena abhi vaṣṭi hantumabhitaḥ kāmayate |
vṛṣeva vadhīn vadhayo niṣpiṣṭamuṣkā nirvīryā balīvardāḥ |
tān yathā vṛṣā secanasamarthaḥ savīryo vṛṣo'bhibhavati tadvacchatrūnabhibhavatītyarthaḥ |
yathā agnerjvālā pratihataprasarā evamapi na varteve vārayituṃ nivartayituṃ vā naiva śakyate ||
tasmā̭ arṣanti di॒vyā a̭sa॒ścata॒ḥ sa sa॒tvabhi̭: pratha॒mo goṣṷ gacchati |
a॒ni॒bhṛ॒ṣṭāvi̭pi॒hantyo̭ja॒sā yaṃ yaṃ yu॒jaṃ kṛ̭ṇute॒ brahmaṇa॒spati̭: ||

tasmai̭ | a॒rṣa॒nti | di॒vyāḥ | a॒sa॒ścata̭ḥ | saḥ | sa॒tva'bhi̭ḥ | pra॒tha॒maḥ | goṣṷ | ga॒ccha॒ti | a॒ni॒bhṛ॒ṣṭa'vi̭piḥ | ha॒nti | o॒jasā̭ | yam'ya̭m | yu॒jam | kṛ॒ṇute | brahmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tiḥ || 4 ||
^tasmai yajamānāya ^divyā: divi bhavā vṛṣṭilakṣaṇā āpa: ^asaśrataḥ asajyamānā aniruddhā: saraya: ^arpanti gacchanti prāpnuvanti ||
satvāna: sādhakā:^ paricārakāstai: sahita: ^prathama: anyebhyo yajamānebhya: pūrvabhāvī san ^goṣu ^gacchati |
anibhṛṣṭā pairairbādhitā tavipī balaṃ yasya tādṛśa:^ san ^ojasā balena ^hanti śatrūn ||

tasmā idviśrvaṃ dhunayanta sindhavo'cchidrā śarma dadhire puruṇi | devānau sumne subhaga: sa edhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspati: || 5 || tasmai | it | viśve | dhunayanta | sindhava: | acchidrā | śarma | dadhire | puruṇi | devānam | sumne | su'bhaga: | sa: | edhate | yam'yam | yujam | kṛṇute | brahmaṇa: | pati: || 5 ||
^tasmā ^it tasmai eva yajamānāya ^viśve ^sindhava: sarvā: syandanaśīlā nadya: ^dhunayanta calayanti |
tathā ^acchidrā acchidrāṇi chidrarahitāni saṃtatāni ^puruṇi bahūni ^śarma śarmāṇi sukhāni ^dadhire tasmā eva dhāryante |
^subhaga: śobhanadhana: ^devānāṃ ^sumne devai: pratte sukhe vartamāna: san ^edhate vardhate |
‘ṛju: ’ iti caturṛcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ gṛtsamadasyārṣaṃ jāgataṃ brāhmaṇaspatyam |

ṛjuricchaṃso vanavadanuṣyato devayandevayantambhyasat | suprāvīrivanavatṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ yajvedaryajyorvi bhajāti bhojanam || 1 || ṛju: | it | śaṃsa: | vanavat | vanuṣyata: | deva'yan | it | adeva'yantam | abhi | asat | su'pra'avī: | it | vanavat | pṛt'su | dustaram | yajvā | it | arya'jyo: | vi | bhajāti | bhojanam || 1 ||
stotrāṇāṃ prasādhaka eva ^śaṃsa: brahmaṇaspate: stotā ^vanuṣyataḥ hiṃsataḥ śatrūn ^vanavat vanuyāt hiṃsyāt ||
tathā ^devayant devaṃ dānādiguṇayuktaṃ brahmaṇaspatimātmana icchanneva ^adevayantaṃ tadviparītaṃ puruṣam ^abhyasat abhibhavet ||
suṣṭhu prakarṣeṇa brahmaṇaspatestarpayitaiva ^pṛtsu pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu ^dustaraṃ tarītumaśakyaṃ ^vanavat
tathā ᐞyajet brahmaṇaspatirhaviṣā iṣṭavāneva ᐞyajyayoḥ ayajvanaḥ ᐞbhojanaṃ bhogasādhanaṃ ᐞtri ᐞbhajāti viśeṣeṇa bhajeta' ityarthaḥ ||

yaja̭sva vīra॒ pra vi̭hi manāya॒to bha॒draṃ ma̭ne॒: kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūryḙ | ha॒viṣkṛ̭ṇuṣva subha॒go yathā̭sasi॒ brahma̭ṇa॒spate॒ra ā vṛ̭ṇīmahe || 2 || yaja̭sva | vīra̭ | pra | vi̭hi | ma॒nāya॒taḥ | bha॒dram | ma॒naḥ | kṛ॒ṇu॒ṣva | vṛ॒tra॒tūryḙ | ha॒viḥ | kṛ॒ṇu॒ṣva | su॒bha॒gaḥ | yathā̭ | a॒sa॒si॒ | bra॒hmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒teḥ | arva̭: | ā | vṛ॒ṇī॒mahe॒ || 2 ||
he ᐞvīra viśeṣeṇa stutīnāṃ preraka sakhe ᐞyajasva brahmaṇaspatiṃ stutyā pūjaya |
ᐞmanāyataḥ mana iva śīghraṃ pravartamānān hiṃsakān |
yadvā abhimanyamānān śatrūn prati ᐞpra ᐞvihi prakarṣeṇa yuddhārthaṃ gaccha ||
ᐞvṛtratūrye vṛtrāṇāmāvārakāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsāhetubhūte saṃgrāme ᐞbhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ dhāṣṭryapi taṃ ᐞmanaḥ ᐞkṛṇuṣva kuruṣva |
tathā brahmaṇaspataye ᐞhaviḥ cahapuroḍāśādikaṃ ᐞkṛṇuṣva kuruṣva |
ᐞyathā tvaṃ ᐞsubhagaḥ śobhanadhanaḥ ᐞamasi bhaveḥ ||
api ca vayaṃ ᐞbrahmaṇaspateḥ ᐞavaḥ rakṣaṇam ᐞā abhimukhyena ᐞvṛṇīmahe prārthayāmahe ||

sa i॒jjanai̭na sa vi॒śā sa ja̭nma॒nā sa pu॒trairvā॒jaṃ bha̭rate॒ dhanā̭ nṛ॒bhi: | de॒vānā̭ṃ yaḥ pi॒tara̭māvi॒vāsa̭ti śra॒ddhāma̭nā ha॒viṣā॒ brahma̭ṇa॒spati̭m || 3 || saḥ | it | ja॒nena̭ | saḥ | vi॒śā | saḥ | ja॒nma॒nā | saḥ | pu॒traiḥ | vā॒jam | bha॒ratḙ | dhanā̭ | nṛ॒bhiḥ | de॒vānā̭m | yaḥ | pi॒tara̭m | ā॒vi॒vā॒sa॒ti॒ | śra॒ddhā'ma̭nāḥ | ha॒viṣā̭ | bra॒hmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tim || 3 ||
ᐞyaḥ yajamānaḥ ᐞśraddhāmanāḥ śraddhā manasi yasya tādṛśaḥ san ᐞdevānāṃ ᐞpitaraṃ pālayitāraṃ ᐞbrahmaṇaspatiṃ ᐞhaviṣā carupuroḍāśādinā ᐞāvivāsati paricarati |
ᐞsa ᐞit sa eva yajamānaḥ ᐞjanena jātena sarveṇa lokena ᐞvājam annaṃ ᐞbharate bibharti saṃbharati vā |
ᐞsaḥ eva ᐞviśā prajayā ātmīyena bandhujanena vājaṃ bharate |
ᐞsa eva ᐞputraiḥ ātmīyairapatyaiḥ vājaṃ bharate |
tathā ᐞnṛbhiḥ netṛbhiranyaiḥ paricārakaiḥ ᐞdhanā dhanāni bharate bibharti saṃpādayati vā |
brahmaṇaspatimiṣṭavato yajamānasya sarvato janā annadhanayoḥ sādhakā bhavantīti yāvat ||

yo a̭smai ha॒vyairghṛ॒tava̭dbhi॒radhra̭ta॒ taṃ prā॒cā na̭yati॒ brahma̭ṇa॒spati̭: | u॒ru॒ṣya॒tīmaṃha̭so ra॒kṣati॒ riṣa̭ i॒horvi̭da॒smā u॒ruca॒krida̭dbhutaḥ || 4 || yaḥ | a॒smai | ha॒vyaiḥ | ghṛ॒tava̭t'bhiḥ | a॒dhra̭ta | tam | prā॒cā | na॒ya॒ti॒ | bra॒hmaṇa̭ḥ | pa॒tiḥ | u॒ru॒ṣya॒ti | ī॒m | aṃha̭saḥ | ra॒kṣati॒ | riṣa̭ḥ | i॒ha | aṃha̭ḥ | ci॒t | a॒smai | u॒ru'ca॒kriḥ | a॒dbhutaḥ ||4||
imaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ ghṛtavadbhiḥ upastaraṇāmighāraṇātmakenājyenopetaiḥ havyaiḥ havirbhiḥ avibhan paricarati |
taṃ yajamānaṃ brahmaṇaspatiḥ prācā prācīnena ṛjunā mārgeṇa pra nayati prakṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ prāpayati |
api ca īm enam aṃhasaḥ pāpān uruṣyati rakṣati |
ācāryabhūto mahān brahmaṇaspatiḥ urucakriḥ uroḥ vistīrṇasya upakārasya kartā bhavati ||
'imā giraḥ' iti saptadaśarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ gṛtsamadaputrasya kūrmasya āpaṃ gṛtsamadasyaiva vā traiṣṭubhādityadevatākam |
tathā cānukrāntam-'imā girastvasū karmā gārbhamado hi vādityam' iti |
ādityadevatāke paśau puroḍāśabhya 'imā giraḥ' ityepā'nu- vākyā |
'agnīṣomau' iti khaṇḍe mūtritam-'imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtastṛta ādityama uravo gabhīrāḥ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||

imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtastṛḥ sunādrāja̭bhyo juhvā juhomi | śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nastuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ || 1 || imāḥ | giraḥ | ādityebhyaḥ | ghṛta'stṛḥ | sunāt | rāja'bhyaḥ | juhvā | juhomi | śṛṇotu | mitraḥ | aryamā | bhagaḥ | naḥ | tuvijātaḥ | varuṇaḥ | dakṣaḥ | aṃśaḥ || 1 ||
ādityebhyaḥ aditaḥ putrebhyaḥ rājabhyaḥ rājamānebhya īśvarebhya vā mitrādibhyaḥ ghṛtastṛḥ ghṛtaprastrāviṇīghṛtaṃ kṣarantīḥ imā giraḥ stutilakṣaṇā vācaḥ sanāt sarvadā juhvā |
yadvā juhrasthānīyena ghṛtaṃ kṣaranti vāgrūpāṇi havīṃṣi juhomi ādityānudiśya tyajāmi |
mantrāṇāṃ payogatādikṣaraṇahetutvaṃ ca 'yacco'dhīte payasaḥ kṛtyā asya' (tai. ā. 2. 10) ityādinā taittirīye spaṣṭamnātam |
naḥ asmadīyāstā giro mitrādayaḥ pratyekaṃ śṛṇotu |
te ca taittirīye 'aṣṭau putrāso aditaḥ' ityupakramya spaṣṭamanukrāntāḥ- 'mitraśca varuṇa dhātā cārdhamā ca aṃśuśca bhagaśca indraśca vivasvāṃścaiyete' (tai. ā. 1. 13. 3) iti |
pūrvokta eva paśau 'imaṃ stomam' ityeṣā vapāyā6 yājyā6 |
sūtritaṃ ca-'imaṃ stomaṃ sakratavo me adya tinno bhūmīrdhārayan trīṃrata dhūna' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||
6. kṣa-1-ta-tha- na-ma-va-vapāyā yāgasya yājyā; ṇa- vapāyāgasya yājyā |

imaṃ stomaṃ saṛtavo me adya mitro aryamā varuṇo jupanta | ādityāsaḥ śucayo dhārapūtā avṛjinā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ || 2 || imam | stomam | sa'ṛtavaḥ | me | adya | mitraḥ | aryamā | varuṇaḥ | jupanta || ādityāsaḥ | śucayaḥ | dhāra'pūtāḥ | avṛjināḥ | anavadyāḥ | ariṣṭāḥ || 2 ||
vimaṃ vme' asmadīyaṃ vstomaṃ stotraṃ vsaṛtavaḥ samānakarmāṇaḥ samānaprajñā vā mitrādayaḥ |

ta ādityāsa uravau gabhīrā adabdhāso dipsanto bhūryakṣāḥ | antaḥ paśyanti vṛjinota sādhu sarvaṃ rājabhyaḥ paramā cidanti || 3 || te | ādityāsaḥ | uravaḥ | gabhīrāḥ | adabdhāsaḥ | dipsantaḥ | bhūri'akṣāḥ | antariti | paśyanti | vṛjinā | uta | sādhu | sarvam | rāja'bhyaḥ | paramā | cit | anti ||3||
vadabdhāsaḥ śatrubhirahiṃsitāḥ santaḥ vdipsantaḥ śatrūn dambhuṃ2 hiṃsitumicchantaḥ ||
asmān icchāsani 'sanīvantartha' iti iḍabhāvapakṣe 'dambha iccha' iti ikāraḥ |
tathā vbhūryakṣāḥ bhūriṇi bahūni akṣīṇi cakṣūṃṣi yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ |
evaṃbhūtā ādityāḥ vantaḥ madhye prāṇināṃ hṛdi prerakatayā vartamānāḥ santaḥ vvṛjinā vṛjināni pāpāni vuta api ca vsādhu sādhūni puṇyāni ca prāṇibhiḥ kṛtāni vpaśyanti jānanti |
vparamā vcit paramāṇi dūradeśāvasthitānyapi vsarvaṃ sarvāṇi dṛśyamānāni vrājabhyaḥ rājābhīśvarāṇāmādi- sthānām vanti antike samīpe vartante iti śeṣaḥ ||
sāmidhenye ṛtau dīkṣaṇīyāyāmādityayāgasya 'dhārayantaḥ' ityādike dve yājyānuvākye |
tathā ca 'dīkṣaṇīyāyām' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam---'dhārayanta ādityāsojagatsthā iti dve3 ete eva bhuvaddbhuvau bhuvanapatiyo vā' (āśva. śrau. 4. 2) iti |

dhārayanta ādityaso jagatasthā devā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopā: | dīrghādhiyo rakṣamāṇā asuryamṛtāvānaścayamānā ṛṇāni || 4 || dhārayantaḥ | ādityasa: | jagat | sthā: | devā: | viśvasya | bhuvanasya | gopā: | dīrgha'dhiya: | rakṣamāṇā: | asuryam | ṛta'vāna: | cayamānā: | ṛṇāni || 4 ||

etadubhayavidhaṃ bhūtajātaṃ ^dhārayantaḥ avasthāpayantaḥ ^devā: dānādiguṇayuktā: ^viśvasya ^bhuvanasya sarvasya lokasya ^gopā: gopayitāro rakṣakā: ^dīrghādhiya: dīrghāni dhiya: karmāṇi jñānāni vā yeṣāṃ tādṛśā: ||
apāṃ taddhetutvaṃ ca chāndogye spaṣṭamāmnātam—'āpomaya: prāṇa:' (chā. u. 6. 5. 4) iti |

vidyāmādityā avaso vo asya yadaryamanbhaya ā cinmayobhu | yuṣmākaṃ mitrāvaruṇā praṇītau pari śvaśraiva duritāni vṛjyām || 5 || vidyām | ādityā: | avasa: | va: | asya | yat | aryaman | bhaye | ā | cit | maya:'bhu | yuṣmākam | mitrāvaruṇā | pra'nītau | pari | śvaśra'iva | du:'itāni | vṛjyām || 5 ||
he ^aryaman he mitrāvaruṇau ^yuṣmākaṃ ^praṇītau asmadviṣaye prakṛpte nayane sati ^śvaśraiva śvaśrūṇīva sthātumayogyāni gartevanti sthalānīva ^duritāni ^pari ^vṛjyāṃ parityajeyam ||

sugo hi vo aryamanmitra panthā anukṣaro varuṇa sādhurāsti | tenādityā adhi vocatā no yacchatā no duṣparihantu śarma || 6 || suga: | hi | va: | aryaman | mitra | panthā: | anukṣara: | varuṇa | sādhu: | asti | tena | ādityā: | adhi | vocata | na: | yacchata | na: | du:'parihantu | śarma || 6 ||
he ᵥarthaman ᵥmitra ᵥvaruṇa ᵥva: yuṣmākaṃ ᵥsuga: sukhena gantavya: |
ᵥevaṃguṇaviśiṣṭa: ᵥpanthā: mārga: ᵥasti vidyate khalu |
ata: ᵥtena pathā asmān śobhanaṃ nayeteti śeṣa: |
he ᵥādityā: ᵥna: asmākam ᵥadhi ᵥvocata adhivacanaṃ pakṣapātena vacanaṃ kuruta |
api ca ᵥna: asmabhyaṃ ᵥduṣparihantu parihantuṃ vināśa- yitumaśakyaṃ ᵥśarma sukhaṃ ᵥyacchata datta |
pipartu no aditī rājaputrāti dveṣāyryamā sugebhi: |
bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya śamoṃrpa syāma puruvīrā ariṣṭā: |

trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta hiraṇyayāḥ śucayo dhārapūtāḥ | asvaprajo animiṣā adabdhā uruśaṃsā ṛjave martyāya || 9 || trī | rocanā | divyā | dhārayanta | hiraṇyayāḥ | śucayaḥ | dhāra'pūtāḥ | asvaprajaḥ | animiṣāḥ | adabdhāḥ | uruśaṃsāḥ | ṛjave | martyāya || 9 ||
ᵥtrī ᵥrocanā trīṇi rocanāni rocamānānyādīni tejāṃsi ᵥdivyā divyāniva divi bhavāni ᵥdhārayanta ādityā avasthāpayan |
ᵥṛjave ṛjīkāya stotrāṇāṃ ᵥmartyāya manuṣyāya bhogasiddhayarthamiti yāvat |
ᵥśucayaḥ dīpyamānāḥ ᵥdhārapūtāḥ udakadhārayā kṣālitā iva nirmalāḥ |
ᵥadabdhāḥ asurādibhirahiṃsitāḥ ᵥuruśaṃsāḥ urubhirbahubhiḥ śaṃsanīyāḥ stotavyāḥ |

tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā ye ca devā asura ye ca martāḥ | śataṃ no rāsva śaradau vicakṣe'śyāmāyūṃṣi sudhitāni pūrvī || 10 || tvam | viśveṣām | varuṇa | asi | rājā | ye | ca | devāḥ | asura | ye | ca | martāḥ | śatam | naḥ | rāsva | śaradaḥ | | vi'cakṣe | aśyām | āyūṃṣi | su'dhitāni | pūrvī || 10 ||
he ᵥasura śatrūṇāṃ kṣepaka ᵥvaruṇa tvaṃ ᵥviśveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ ᵥrājā ᵥasi |
ᵥye ᵥca ᵥdevāḥ devajanāḥ ᵥye ᵥca ᵥmartāḥ maraṇadharmāṇo manuṣyāḥ teṣāmityarthaḥ |
atastvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥśataṃ ᵥśaradaḥ śatasaṃkhyākān saṃvatsarān ᵥvicakṣe viśeṣeṇa darśanāya ᵥrāsva prayaccha ||
vayaṃ ca ᵥpūrvā pūrvadevaiḥ ᵥsudhitāni suṣṭhu hitāni śatasaṃvatsaralakṣaṇāni ᵥāyūṃṣi ᵥaśyāma vyāpnuyāma ||
ādityadevatāke paśau 'na dakṣiṇā ' ityeṣā havipo yājyā |
'tisro bhūmīrdhārayantīrhaṃta ghnūn na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti ||

na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā na prācīnamādityā nota paścā | pākyā cidvasavo dhīryā cidyuṣmānīto abhayaṃ jyotiraśyāma || 11 || na | dakṣiṇā | vi | cikite | na | savyā | na | prācīnam | ādityāḥ | na | uta | paścā | pākyā | cit | vasavaḥ | dhīryā | cit | yuṣmā'nītaḥ | abhayam | jyotiḥ | aśyām || 11 ||
he ᵥādityāḥ ᵥdakṣiṇā dakṣiṇo bhāgaḥ ᵥna ᵥvi ᵥcikite mayā na vijñāyate |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥpaścā paścāt pṛṣṭhabhāgo'pi ᵥna jñāyate |
‘paśca paścā ca chandasi’ (pā. sū. 5. 3. 33) iti nipātyate ||
ᵥdhīryā ᵥcit dhīre netavyatvena bhavo dhīryaḥ kātaraḥ ||
haṃ ᵥvamavaḥ vāsavināra ādityāḥ ᵥyuṣmānītaḥ yuṣmābhirnītaḥ śobhanena mārgeṇa prāptaḥ san ᵥabhayaṃ bhayarahitaṃ ᵥjyotiḥ sauraṃ tejaḥ āntaraṃ vā jñānātmakam ᵥaśyāṃ prāpnuyām ||

yo rāja̭bhya ṛ॒tuni̭bhyo॒ dadā̭śa॒ yaṃ va̭rdhayanti pu॒ṣṭya̭śca nityāḥ | sa re॒vānyā̭ti॒ pratha॒mo rathḙna va॒sudā̭vā॒ vida̭theṣu॒ praśa̭staḥ || 12 || yaḥ | rāja̭bhyaḥ | ṛ॒tuni̭bhyaḥ | dadā̭śa | yam | va̭rdhayanti | pu॒ṣṭya̭ḥ | ca | nityāḥ | saḥ | re॒vān | yā̭ti | pratha॒maḥ | rathḙna | va॒sudā̭vā | vida̭theṣu | pra'śa̭staḥ || 12 ||
ᵥyaḥ: yajamānaḥ ᵥrājabhyaḥ rājamānebhyaḥ ᵥṛtanibhyaḥ ṛtasya yajñasya² satyasya vā netṛbhya ādityebhyaḥ ᵥdadāśa carupuroḍāśādikaṃ dadāti |
ᵥyaṃ yajamānaṃ ᵥpuṣṭyaḥ poṣakāḥ ᵥnityāḥ śāśvatā ādityāḥ ca ᵥvardhayanti |

ᵥsaḥ yajamānaḥ ᵥrevān dhanavān ᵥprathamaḥ prathitaḥ prakhyātaḥ ᵥvasudāvā vasūnāṃ dhanānāṃ dātā san ᵥpraśastaḥ sarvaiḥ praśasyamānaḥ ᵥvidadhepu vedhepu labdhavyeṣu gṛheṣu ᵥrathena vāhanena ᵥyāti gacchati ||

śuci̭rapaḥ suyava̭sā a॒dabdha u॒pa kṣeti̭ vṛ॒ddharva̭yāḥ suvī̭raḥ | naki̭ṣṭaṃ ma॒ntyanti̭to na du॒rādya ā̭di॒tyānā̭ṃ bha॒vati̭ praṇī॒tau || 13 || śuci̭ḥ | apa̭ḥ | su'yava̭sā | a॒dabdhaḥ | upa̭ | kṣeti̭ | vṛ॒ddha'va̭yāḥ | su'vī̭raḥ | naki̭ḥ | tam | ghnanti̭ | anti̭taḥ | na | du॒rāt | yaḥ | ā̭di॒tyānā̭m | bha॒vati̭ | pra'nī̭tau || 13 ||

sa yajamānaḥ ᵥśuciḥ dīpyamānaḥ śuddho vā ᵥadabdhaḥ sapatnairbādhitaḥ ᵥvṛddharvayāḥ prabhūtannaḥ ᵥsuvīraḥ śobhanaputraśca san ᵥsūyavasā śobhanasyāna ᵥapaḥ vṛṣṭilakṣaṇānyūdakāni ᵥupa ᵥkṣeti upanivasati |
tathā ᵥnakiḥ na ca ᵥtaṃ ᵥghnanti hiṃsanti ᵥantito ᵥna antikāt samīpadeśācca ᵥdūrāt viprakṛṣṭācca deśādāgatā bādhakāḥ ||
antikamya tasi ᵥ ‘kādilopaḥ ᵥ’ iti lopaḥ ||
ᵥyaḥ yajamānaḥ ᵥādityānām aditaḥ putrāṇāṃ mitrādīnāṃ ᵥpraṇītau prakṛṣṭe nayane prāpaṇe ᵥbhavati vartate sa iti pūrvatra saṃbandhaḥ ||
1. kṣa-ma-vijñāyate | 2. ka-jha-jña-ṇa-tha-na-ma-va- 'yajñasya' nāsti | 3. ṇa-ta-tha-ma-yam | 4. kha-ga-ta-tha-ma-tasilādilopaḥ | ka. 2-15
adi̭te mitra varu॒ṇota mṛ̭ḻa॒ yadvo̭ va॒yaṃ ca̭kṛ॒mā ka॒ccidāga̭: |
u॒rvya॒śyā̭ma॒bhaya̭ṃ jyo॒tiri̭ndra॒ mā no̭ dī॒rghā a॒bhi na̭śa॒ntami̭srāḥ ||

adi̭te | mi॒tra | varṷṇa | u॒ta | mṛ॒ḻa | yat | vaḥ | va॒yam | ca॒kṛ॒ma | kat | ci॒t | ā॒gaḥ | | u॒ru | a॒śyā̭ma | a॒bhaya̭m | jyo॒tiḥ | i॒ndra | mā | naḥ | dī॒rghāḥ | a॒bhi | na॒śa॒n | tami̭srāḥ || 14 ||
ˇuta api ca ha ˇadite ˇmitra ˇvaruṇa ||
'āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' iti pūrvapūrvasya āmantritasya avidyamānatvāt sarveṣāṃ pāṣṭhikam 'āmantritasya' ityādyudāttatvam ||
yūyaṃ pratyekaṃ ˇmṛḻa asmākamupari dayāṃ kuru |
yā vo māyā abhidruhe yajatrāḥ pāśā ādityā ripave vivṛttāḥ |
aśvīva tāṃ ati yeṣaṃ rathenāriṣṭā urāvā śarmansyāma ||
yāḥ | vaḥ | māyāḥ | abhi'druhe | yajatrāḥ | pāśāḥ | ādityāḥ | ripave | vi'vṛttāḥ | aśvī'iva | tān | ati | yeṣam | rathena | ariṣṭāḥ | urau | ā | śarman | syāma || 16 ||

he yajatrāḥ yaṣṭavyāḥ | ādityāḥ | vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ yāḥ māyāḥ | abhidruhe abhito' drohaṃ' kurvaṃta rākṣasādye nirmitāḥ ye ca pāśāḥ | ripave śatrave vivṛttāḥ | 'vṛtī hiṃsāgranthnayoḥ' || prasāritā ityarthaḥ | tān pāśān māyāśca rathena ati yeṣam atītya prayateyam | atitareyamityarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | aśvīva | yathā śobhanāśvaḥ kaścit puruṣaḥ 2 dustarān mārgān śīghramatikrāmati tadvat || 'yeṣu prayatne' | bhau
idaṃ kaveradityasya svarājo viśvāni sāntvyamastu mahnā |
ati yo mandro yajathāya devaḥ sukīrtiṃ bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūraiḥ ||
idam | kaveḥ | ādityasya | sva'rājaḥ | viśvāni | santi | abhi | astu | mahnā | ati | yaḥ | mandraḥ | yajathāya | devaḥ | su'kīrtim | bhikṣe | varuṇasya | bhūraiḥ || 1 ||
^v kaveḥ krāntadarśinaḥ ^v ādityasya aditaḥ putrasya ^v svarājaḥ svayameva rājamānasya īśvarasya vā ^v varuṇasya ^v idaṃ haviḥ stotraṃ vā yajamānaḥ karotīti śeṣaḥ |
sa ca ^v viśvāni sarvāṇi ^v santi dvitīya- bhāvavikārabhāji bhūtātāni ^v mahnā mahinā varuṇaprasādāt labdhena ^v abhyastu abhabhavatu |
^v yaḥ ^v devaḥ dyotamāno varuṇaḥ ^v yajathāya yaṣṭre gurupāya ^v ati atiśayena ^v mandraḥ stutyo harṣayitā vā bhavati tasya ^v bhūraiḥ bhartuvaruṇasya ^v sukīr
evaṃbhūtā he 'devāḥ 'yūyaṃ 'naḥ asmān kṛtāparādhān 'yujyāya satyāya 'abhi 'kṣamadhvam asmābhiḥ kṛtamaparādhaṃ sahadhvam ||

pra sīmādityo asṛjadghṛtā kṛtaṃ sindhavo varuṇasya yanti | na śrāmyanti na vi muñcantyete vayo na paptū raghuyā parijman || 4 || pra | sīm | ādityaḥ | asṛjat | vi'dhṛtā | kṛtam | sindhavaḥ | varuṇasya | yanti | na | śrāmyanti | na | vi | muñcanti | ete | vayaḥ | na | paptuḥ | raghuyā | pari'jman ||4||
'vidhṛtā seturiva jalasya vidhāyitā 'ādityaḥ aditaḥ putro varuṇaḥ 'ṛtaṃ dhāraṇahetubhūtaṃ satyaṃ yadvā nadīnāmupādānabhūtamudakaṃ 'sīṃ sarvataḥ 'pra 'asṛjat prakarṣeṇa sṛṣṭavān ||
vayaḥ pakṣiṇa iva 'raghuyā raghavaḥ 2 śīghragāminaḥ 'parijman parijmani bhūyāṃ 'paptuḥ patanti |
raghuyā ityatra 'supāṃ suluk' iti jaso yājādeśaḥ ||

vi macchathāya raśanāmivārga ṛdhyāma te varuṇa khāmṛtasya | mā tantuśchedi vayato dhiyaṃ me mā mātrā śāryapasaḥ pura ṛtoḥ || 5 || vi | mat | śrathaya | raśanām'iva | ārgaḥ | ṛdhyāma | te | varuṇa | khāma | ṛtasya | mā | tantuḥ | chedi | vayataḥ | dhiyam | me | mā | mātrā | śāri | apasaḥ | purā | ṛtoḥ ||5||
he varuṇa 'mat matkāśāt 'raśanāmiva rajjumiva 'āgaḥ vihitānanuṣṭhānajanitaṃ 3 pāpaṃ 'vi 'śrathaya śithilīkuru |
api ca 'dhiyaṃ karma 'vayataḥ saṃtanvataḥ 'me mama 'tantuḥ karmasaṃtatiḥ 'mā 'chedi chinno mā bhūt |
tathā 'ṛtoḥ samāptikālāt 'purā pūrvam 'apasaḥ karmaṇaḥ 'mātrā śarīraṃ prācyodīcyāllakṣaṇaṃ 'mā 'śāri śīrṇaṃ vikalaṃ 'mā bhūt ||
apo su myakṣa varuṇa bhiyasaṃ matsamrāḻatāvo'nu mā gubhāya |
dāmaiva vatsāddhi mumugdhyahau nahi tvadāre nimiṣaścaneśai ||
apo iti | su | myakṣa | varuṇa | bhiyasam | mat | samrāṭ | ṛta'vaḥ | anu | mā | gubhāya | dāma'iva | vatsāt | vi | mumugdhi | ahaḥ | nahi | tvat | are | ni'miṣaḥ | cana | īśai ||6||
he varuṇa 'bhiyasaṃ bhayaṃ 'mat mattaḥ 'su suṣṭhu 'apo 'myakṣa apagamaya |
he 'samrāṭ samyagrājamāna he 'ṛtāvaḥ satyavan yajñavan vā varuṇa 'mā mām 'anu 'gubhāya anugṛhāṇa ||
api ca 'dāmaiva 'vatsāt yathā dogdhā vāsasakāśāt bandhanaṃ rajjuṃ vimuñcati tathā 'ahaḥ pāpaṃ tvatkāśāt 'vi 'mumugdhi vimuñca ||
mā nau vadhairvaruṇa ye taṃ iṣṭāvenaḥ kṛṇvanta masura śrīṇanti |
mā jyotipaḥ pravasathāni ganma vi pū mṛdhaḥ śiśratho jīvasai naḥ ||
mā | naḥ | vadhaiḥ | varuṇa | ye | te | iṣṭau | enaḥ | kṛṇvantam | asura | śrīṇanti | mā | jyotipaḥ | pra'vasathāni | ganma | vi | su | mṛdhaḥ | śiśrathaḥ | jīvasai | naḥ || 7 ||
he varuṇa 'naḥ asmān 'vadhaiḥ hananasādhanairāyudhaiḥ 'mā hiṃsīriti śeṣaḥ |
he 'asura pāpakṛtāṃ niramitaḥ 'te tvadīye 'iṣṭau yajñe 'enaḥ vihitānanuṣṭhānena' janitaṃ pāpaṃ 'kṛṇvantaṃ kurvantaṃ puruṣaṃ 'ye vadhāḥ 'śrīṇanti himananti naḥ iti pūrvatra saṃbandhaḥ ||
api ca 'jyotipaḥ gṛhe vartamānādagneḥ sauraprakāśān vā 'pravasathāni pravāsān 'mā 'ganma mā gacchāma |
sarvadā gṛhe vartamānaḥ sūrya paśyan cirakālaṃ jīveyamityarthaḥ ||
tathā 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'jīvase jīvanāya 'mṛdhaḥ hiṃsakān suṣṭhu 'vi 'śiśrathaḥ viśleṣaya |
namaḥ purā te varuṇota nunamutāparaṃ tuvijāta bravāma |
tve hi kaṃ parvate na śritānyapracyutāni dūlabha vratāni ||
namaḥ | purā | te | varuṇa | uta | nunam | uta | aparam | tuvi'jāta | bravāma | tve | iti | hi | kam | parvate | na | śritāni | apra'cyutāni | duḥ'dabha | vratāni || 8 ||
he varuṇa purā pūrvasmin kāle te tubhyaṃ namaḥ namaskārapratipādakaṃ nama iti śabdamavādiṣma |
uta api ca nūnam adyāpi bravāma |
uta api ca he tuvijāta bahuṣu pradeśeṣu prādurbhūta varuṇa aparam āgāmītyapi kāle namaḥśabdaṃ bravāma uccārayāma |
'duro dāśanāśdhyādabhepu' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 109. 5) iti rephasyotvam uttarapadādeḥ hutvaṃ ca |
hi yasmāt śva tvayi parvate na śiloccaye iva apracyutāni anyaiḥ pracyāvayitumaśakyāni vratāni karmāṇi vidharaṇāni śritāni āśritāni |
para ṛṇā sāvīrdha matkṛtāni māhaṃ rājannyakṛtena bhojam |
avyuṣṭā inu bhūyasīrupāsa ā nau jīvānvaruṇa tāmu śādhi ||
parā | ṛṇā | sāvīḥ | ardha | mata'kṛtāni | mā | aham | rājan | anya'kṛtena | bhojam | avi'uṣṭāḥ | it | nu | bhūyasīḥ | uṣasaḥ | ā | naḥ | jīvān | varuṇa | tāsu | śādhi ||9||
he varuṇa ṛṇā ṛṇāni pitrādibhiḥ kṛtānyasmābhirdeyāni parā sāvīḥ parā suva |
adha adhunā matkṛtāni mayā niṣpāditāni ṛṇāni parā suva |
api ca he rājan svāmin varuṇa aham anyakṛtena anyarjitena dhanena mā bhojaṃ bhogaṃ mā labheyam |
bhūyasīḥ bhūyabhyo bahutarāḥ upamaḥ avyuṣṭāḥ it |
apararātrepthāya ṛṇāni cintayato jāgrato mama vyuṣṭā apyavyuṣṭakalpā āsan |
he varuṇa tāmu upaḥsu naḥ asmān jīvān jīvanavataḥ ā śādhi ā samantāt anuśiṣṭhān kuru |
yo mai rājannyujyoṃ vā sakhā vā svamaṃ bhayaṃ bhīrave mahyamāha |
steno vā yo dipsati no vṛko vā tvaṃ tasmādvaruṇa pāhismān ||
yaḥ | me | rājan | yujyaḥ | vā | sakhā | vā | svame | bhayam | bhīrave | mahyam | āha | stenaḥ | vā | yaḥ | dipsati | naḥ | vṛkaḥ | vā | tvam | tasmāt | varuṇa | pāhi | asmān || 10 ||
he rājan varuṇa me madīyaḥ yujyaḥ yojanasamarthaḥ pitrādiḥ vā sakhā samānasthāno'nyo bāndhavaḥ vā svame dṛṣṭaṃ tvadvipayaṃ bhayaṃ bhīrave bhayaśīlāya mahyaṃ yaḥ āha brūte |
tathā stenaḥ coraḥ vā vṛkaḥ araṇyaśvā vā yaḥ naḥ asmān dipsati jighāṃsati ||
he varuṇa tvaṃ tasmāt sarvasmān asmān pāhi rakṣa ||
māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridātra ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ |
mā rāyo rājantsuyamādava syāṃ bṛhaddema vidathai suvīrāḥ ||
mā | aham | maghonaḥ | varuṇa | priyasya | bhūridātraḥ | ā | vidam | śūnam | āpeḥ | mā | rayaḥ | rājan | suyamāt | ava | sthām | bṛhat | dema | vidathai | suvīrāḥ ||11||
he varuṇa priyasya bhūridātraḥ bhūridhanasya dātṛdhanavata āhbayasya purataḥ putrāderridyam ahaṃ mā ā vidam āvedayāni jñāpayāni |
he rājan suṣṭhu niyāmakatvāt ava sthām avayutya sthitaḥ 9 mā bhūvam |
śobhanaputrāḥ 9 yajñe gṛhe vā vartamānāḥ prauḍhaṃ stotramuccārayāma ||
‘dhṛtavratāḥ’ iti saptacaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ gṛtsamadasya kūrmasya gṛtsamadasya dhā1 āpaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vaiśvadevam |
dhṛtavratā ādityā irpirā āre matkarta rahasūribhāgaḥ |
śṛṇvato vo varuṇa mitra devā bhadrasya vidvā~ avase huve vaḥ ||
dhṛtavratāḥ | ādityāḥ | irpirāḥ | āre | mat | karta | rahasūḥ'iva | ārgaḥ | śṛṇvataḥ | vaḥ | varuṇa | mitra | devāḥ | bhadrasya | vidvān | avase | huve | vaḥ ||1||
he dhṛtavratāḥ dhṛtakarmāṇaḥ ādityāḥ aditaḥ putrāḥ irpirāḥ gamanaśīlāḥ sarvairabhyepaṇīyāḥ prārthanīyā vā he viśve devāḥ mat āre matto dūradeśe āgaḥ vihitānanuṣṭhānādijanitaṃ pāpaṃ karta kuruta |
sā yathā garbhaṃ pātayitvā dūradeśe parityajati tadvat |
he varuṇa mitra devāḥ vaḥ yuṣmadīyasya bhadrasya yuṣmābhiḥ karaṇīyaṃ śreyaḥ vidvān jānannahaṃ śṛṇvataḥ maskṛtāni stotrāṇi śrotreṇa jānataḥ vaḥ yuṣmān avase rakṣaṇārthaṃ huve āhbayāmi ||
yūyaṃ devāḥ pramatiryamojo yūyaṃ dvepāṃsi sanutaryuyota |
abhiṣktāro ābhi ca kṣamadhvamadyā ca no mṛḻayatāparaṃ ca ||
yūyam | devāḥ | pra'matiḥ | yūyam | ojaḥ | yūyam | dvepāṃsi | sanutaḥ | yuyota | abhi'kṣatāraḥ | ābhi | ca | kṣamadhvam | adya | ca | naḥ | mṛḻayata | aparam | ca ||2||
he ᵛdevāḥ ᵛpramatiḥ prakṛṣṭā matiryasya pitrādestādṛśā api ᵛyūyam eva |
tathā ᵛojaḥ bala- mapi ᵛyūyam eva |
api ca ᵛyūyaṃ ᵛdvepāṃsi dveṣṭṛn rakṣaḥpiśācādīni |
ᵛabhiṣattāraḥ abhitaḥ śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsitāraḥ yūyam ᵛabhi ᵛca ᵛkṣamadhvam abhibhavata ca śatrūn |
ᵛadya asmin dine ᵛnaḥ asmān ᵛmṛḻayata sukhayata |
ᵛaparaṃ ᵛca aparamapi kālam āgāminyapi kāle asmān mṛḻayata ||
kimu nu vaḥ: kṛṇavāmapāreṇa kiṃ sanena vasavu āpyena |
yūyaṃ nau mitrāvaruṇādite ca svastimindrāmaruto dadhāta ||

pra va॒ eko̭ mimaya॒ bhūryā̭go॒ yanmā̭ pi॒teva̭ ki॒tava̭ṃ śaśāsa | āre॒ pāśā̭ āre॒ aghā̭ni de॒vā mā mā̭dhi pu॒tre vi॒rmiva̭ grabhīe || 5 || pra | vaḥ | ekaḥ | mimaya | bhūrya | ārgaḥ | yat | mā | pitā'iva | kitavam | śaśāsa | āre | pāśāḥ | āre | aghāni | devāḥ | mā | mā | adhi | putre | vim'iva | grabhīṣṭa ||5||
he devāḥ 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ madhye aham 'ekaḥ san 'bhūri bahulam 'āgaḥ pāpaṃ 'pra 'mimaya ahaṃ prakarṣeṇa ahisipam |
'yat yasmāt māṃ 'piteva 'kitavaṃ yathā apathapravṛttaṃ putraṃ pitā anuśāsti tathā 'śaśāsa anuśiṣṭaṃ cakrudve ||
api ca he 'devāḥ yuṣmadīyāḥ 'pāśāḥ 'āre asmatto dūradeśe santu |
putre paśyati sati pitaraṃ santaṃ 'vimiva pakṣiṇamiva vyādhaḥ mā grabhīṣṭa mā gṛhṇīdhvam ||

arvā॒ñco a॒dyā bha̭vatā॒ yaja̭trā ā vo॒ hārdi̭ bharya॒māno॒ vyayḙyam | ādha̭vaṃ no de॒vā ni॒juro̭ vṛ॒kasya॒ ādha̭vaṃ kṛ॒tādva॒padaṷ yaja̭trāḥ || 6 || arvāñcaḥ | adya | bhavata | yajatrāḥ | ā | vaḥ | hārdi | bharyamānaḥ | vyayeyam | ādharvam | naḥ | devāḥ | ni'juraḥ | vṛkasya | ādharvam | kṛtāt | ava'padaḥ | yajatrāḥ ||6||
'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ 'hārdi hṛdayasthitaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ 'bharyamānaḥ bibhyadaham 'ā 'vyayeyam ābhimukhyena prāpnuyām ||
he 'devāḥ 'vṛkasya taskarasya araṇyaśuno vā saṃbandhanaḥ 'nijuraḥ nihananān ||

māhaṃ ma॒ghono̭ varu॒ṇa pri॒yasya̭ bhūri॒dātra॒ ā vi̭daṃ śūna॒māpḙ | mā rā॒yo rā̭ja॒ntsuya̭mādava॒ sthāṃ bṛha̭ddema vi॒dathḙ su॒vīrā̭ḥ || 7 || mā | aham | maghonaḥ | varuṇa | priyasya | bhūri'dātraḥ | ā | vidam | śūnam | āpe | mā | rāyaḥ | rājan | su'yamāt | ava | sthām | bṛhat | vadema | vidathe | suvīrāḥ ||7||
tathā cānukrāntam—‘ṛtamekādaśa jagatyantaṃ pañcaindrāsomī sarasvatī tvamiti sārasvato'rdharco yo no bṛhaspatistaṃ vo'nyā’ mārutī’ iti |
ṛtaṃ devāya kṛṇvate savitrā indrāyāhime na ra̭manta āpaḥ |
ṛtam | devāya | kṛṇvate | savitre | indrāya | ahi'agne | na | ra̭mante | āpaḥ | ahaḥ'ahaḥ | yāti | aktuḥ | apām | kiyāti | ā | prathamaḥ | sargaḥ | āsām ||1||
vṛtam udakaṃ vṛṣṭilakṣaṇaṃ vkṛṇvate kurvate vdevāya dyotanāya vsavitre sarvasya prerakāya vahi'agne ahiṃ vṛtraṃ hatavate vindrāya yāgārtham vāpaḥ vna vramante |
api tu tāsām vapām vaktuḥ secakaḥ srota: vaharahaḥ pratyahaṃ vyāti gacchati |
vāsāṃ vprathamaḥ vsargaḥ prāthamikaṃ janma vkiyātyā kiyati kāle niṣpannam |
yāvati kāle tā ajāyanta sa kālaḥ kiyān |
yo vṛtrāya sinamrābhariṣyattaṃ janitrī viduṣa uvāca |
patho radantīranu joṣamasmai divedive dhunayo yantyartham ||
yaḥ | vṛtrāya | sinam | atra | abhariṣyat | pra | tam | janitrī | viduṣe | uvāca | pathaḥ | radantīḥ | anu | joṣam | asmai | divedive | dhunayaḥ | yanti | artham ||2||
vyaḥ puruṣaḥ vvṛtrāya asurāya vsinam annam vatra pākasthāne āhartum vabhariṣyat saṃpāditavān vtaṃ puruṣaṃ vjanitrī janayitrī indrasya mātā aditiḥ vviduṣe abhijñāyendāya vpra vuvāca proktavatī |
pravacanasya hananāthattvāt taṃ vṛtraṃ hatavāniti śeṣaḥ |
api ca vasmai asyendrasya vanu vjoṣam anukāmam |
icchāmanusṛtya vpathaḥ mārgān vradantīḥ vilikhantyaḥ vdhunayaḥ nadyaḥ vdivedive pratidivasam vartham ataivyaṃ gantavyaṃ samudraṃ prati vyanti gacchanti ||
ūrdhvo hasthādadhyantarikṣe'rdhā vṛtrāya pra vadhaṃ jabhāra |
ūrdhvaḥ | hi | asthāt | adhi | antarikṣe | ardhaḥ | vṛtrāya | pra | vadham | jabhāra | miham | vasānaḥ | upa | hi | īm | ardudrot | tigma'āyudhaḥ | ajayat | śatruma | indraḥ ||3||
yasmādayaṃ vṛtraḥ vantarikṣe vūrdhvaḥ san sarvamāvṛtya vadhi vasthāt adhiṣṭhito'bhūt |
vadha ataḥ kāraṇāt vvṛtrāya vṛtraṃ prati vvadhaṃ hananasādhanaṃ vajramindraḥ vpra vjabhāra prikṣepa ||
saḥ vhi khalu’ vṛtraḥ vmihaṃ vṛṣṭeḥ settāraṃ meghaṃ vvasānaḥ ācchādayan vīm ena- mindram vupa vadudrot upāgamat ||
vtigmāyudhaḥ tīkṣṇāyudhaḥ vindraḥ vśatruṃ śātayitāraṃ taṃ vṛtram vajayat jitavān ||
bṛhaspate tapuṣāśvaiva vidhya vṛkaddaraso asurasya vīrān |
yathā jaghantha dhupatā purā cidevā jahi śatrumasmākemindra ||
bṛhaspate | tapuṣā | aśvā'iva | vidhya | vṛka'ddarasaḥ | asurasya | vīrān | yathā | jaghantha | dhupatā | purā | cit | eva | jahi | śatrum | asmākam | indra ||4||
he vbṛhaspate bṛhatāṃ parivṛḍhānāṃ pālayitarindra vtapuṣā tāpakena dīsena vajreṇa vaśveva aśanyaiva vvṛkaddarasaḥ saṃvṛtadvārasya vasurasya vvīrān putrān |
he vindra vpurā vcit purāpi vdhupatā dharṣakena vajreṇa vyathā vjaghantha tvaṃ hatavān veva evameva vasmākaṃ vśatruṃ vjahi nāśaya ||
avaṃ kṣipa divo aśmānamuccā yen śatruṃ mandasāno nijūtrīḥ |
tokasya sātau tarnayasya bhūraissā ardhaṃ kṛṇutādindra gonām ||
ava | kṣipa | divaḥ | aśmānam | uccā | yena | śatrum | mandasānaḥ | ni'jūtrīḥ | tokasya | sātau | tarnayasya | bhūraiḥ | asmān | ardham | kṛṇutāt | indra | gonām ||5||
he indra vdivaḥ nabhasaḥ sakāśāt vaśmānam aśmavatkaṭhinaṃ vajram vuccā uccairvartamānatvam vava vkṣipa asmadīyān śatrunudiśya avastāt prakṣipa |
vyena vajreṇa vmandasānaḥ stotṛbhiḥ stūyamānaḥ san vśatruṃ vnijūtrīḥ nyahiṃsīḥ ||
tathā vtokasya putrasya vbhūraiḥ bhartavyasya vtanayasya pautrasya vsātau saṃbhajane ||
tathā he vindra vgonāṃ gavāṃ saṃbhajanāthaṃ ca vasmān asmākam ||
1. ka-jha-ṇa-ṇa-ta-ma-va-sa khalu | 2. ga-ca-kṣipa | 3. ca-jha-ṇa-ṇa-levyāḍāgamaḥ | 4. kha- ga-ca-jha-ṇa-ṇa-tha-na-’ putrasya ’ nāsti |
pra hi kratuṃ bṛhathaṃ vaṃnutho radhasya stho yajamānasya codau |
pra | hi | kratum | bṛhathaḥ | yam | vanuthaḥ | radhasya | sthaḥ | yajamānasya | codau | indrāsomā | yuvam | asmān | aviṣṭam | asmin | bhayasthe | kṛṇutam | ū~ iti | lokam || 6 ||
he indrāsomoṃ 1 yaṃ vairīṇaṃ 2 vanuthaḥ hiṃsathaḥ |
taṃ 4 kratuṃ dvepasya kartāraṃ 5 pra 6 hi 7 bṛhathaḥ prakarṣeṇocchathaḥ |
tathā 8 radhasya rādhasasya 9 yajamānasya 10 codau śatrūṇāṃ prerakau 11 sthaḥ bhavataḥ |
tathā he indrāsomau 12 yuvaṃ yuvām 13 asmān 14 aviṣṭam avatam |
sarasvati tvamasmā~ aviddhi marutvatī dhṛṣatī jeṣi śatrūn |
tyaṃ cicchardhantaṃ taviṣīyamāṇamindro hanti vṛṣabhaṃ śaṇḍikānām ||
sarasvati | tvam | asmān | aviddhi | marutvatī | dhṛṣatī | jeṣi | śatrūn | tyam | cit | śardhantam | taviṣīyamāṇam | indraḥ | hanti | vṛṣabham | śaṇḍikānām ||8||
he sarasvati maraṇavati devi tvamasmān stotṛn aviddhi rakṣa ||
madhyamasthānā hi vāk sarasvatī marutaśca madhyamasthānasthāḥ |
atastadvatī matī dhṛṣatī dharṣayantī śatrūn śātayitnū vairiṇaḥ jeṣi jaya ||
kiṃca ayam indraḥ tyaṃ cit tamapyasuraṃ hanti hatavān ||
yo naḥ sanutya uta vā jighatnurbhīruyāya taṃ tiṃgitenaṃ vidhya |
bṛhaspate āyudhairjeṣi śatrūndṛhe rīrṣantaṃ pari dhehi rājan ||
yaḥ | naḥ | sanutyaḥ | uta | vā | jighatnuḥ | abhidruhāya | tam | tiṃgitena | vidhya | bṛhaspate | āyudhaiḥ | jeṣi | śatrūn | duhe | riṣantam | pari | dhehi | rājan || 9 ||
he bṛhaspate yo naḥ asmākaṃ sanutyaḥ |
uta vā api vā yaḥ jighatnuḥ jighāṃsurbhavati |
tam abhidruhāya saṃvīkṣya tiṃgitena tīkṣṇenāyudhena vidhya tāḍaya |
tathā asmadīyān śatrūn āyudhaiḥ āyodhana- sādhanaiḥ iṣvādibhiḥ jeṣi jaya |
tathā he rājan rājamāna bṛhaspate duhe dogdhe śatrave riṣantaṃ hiṃsantaṃ vajraṃ pari dhehi parito dhāraya prakṣipyetyarthaḥ ||
asmākaibhiḥ satvābhiḥ śūra śūrairvīryā kṛdhi yāni te katvāni |
jyogbhuvannanudhūpitāso hatvī teṣāmā bharā no vasūni ||
asmākaibhiḥ | satvābhiḥ | śūra | śūraiḥ | vīryā | kṛdhi | yāni | te | katvāni | jyog | abhūvan | anudhūpitāsaḥ | hatvī | teṣām | ā | bhara | naḥ | vasūni ||10||
he śūra śauryavannindra asmākaibhiḥ āsmākīnaiḥ satvābhiḥ pareṣāṃ sādakaiḥ śūraiḥ śauryopetairdhaiḥ tāni vīryā vīryāṇi vīrakarmāṇi kṛdhi kuru yāni te tvayā katvāni karaṇīyāni ||
ᵛjyok cirakālam ᵛanubhūpitāsaḥ bhūpāyamānahṛdayā madīyāḥ śatravaḥ ᵛabhūvan āsan |
'teṣāṃ śatrūṇāṃ ᵛvasūni dhanāni ᵛnaḥ asmabhyam ᵛā ᵛbhara āhara ||
taṃ vaḥ śardha mārutaṃ sumnayurgiropa bruve narmasā dainyaṃ janam |
yathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ naśāmahā apatyasācaṃ śrutyai divedive ||
tam | vaḥ | śardham | mārutam | sumna'yuḥ | girā | upa | bruve | narmasā | dainyam | janam | yathā | rayim | sarva'vīram | naśāmahe | apatya'sācam | śrutyam | divedive || 11 ||

he marutaḥ ᵛvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ᵛśardhaṃ balaṃ ᵛmārutaṃ marutsamuhyarūpaṃ ᵛdainyaṃ devendreṇa saṃbaddhaṃ ᵛjanaṃ prādurbhūtam evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ balaṃ ᵛnamasā namaskāreṇa havivā vā ᵛgirā stotreṇa ᵛupa ᵛbruve staumi |

ᵛyathā yena prakāreṇa vayaṃ ᵛsarvavīraṃ sarvavīraiḥ viśeṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ prerakaṃbheṭrpetama ᵛapatyasācam apatyaiḥ apanahetubhūtaiḥ putrādibhirupetaṃ ᵛśrutyaṃ śravaṇīyaṃ praśasyabhṛtaṃ ᵛrayiṃ ᵛdivedive pratidivasaṃ ᵛnaśāmahai vyāpnuvāma ||
' asmākam ' iti saptamaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ gṛtsamadasyārṣaṃ vaidhadevam |
tathā cānukrāntam— ' asmākaṃ sapta vaiśvadevaṃ triṣṭubantam ' iti |
pra yadyo na psansvarmanaspari śrusvayo harṣīvanto vanarṣadaḥ ||
asmākam | mitrāvaruṇā | avatam | ratham | ādityaiḥ | rudraiḥ | vasubhiḥ | sacā'bhuvā | pra | yat | vayaḥ | na | psan | vasmanaḥ | pari | śrusvayaḥ | harṣīvantaḥ | vana'sadaḥ || 1 ||

ᵛmitrāvaruṇā he mitrāvaruṇau ᵛādityaiḥ dhātryamādibhirdvādaśabhiḥ ᵛrudraiḥ ekādaśasaṃkhyākaiḥ ᵛvasubhiḥ dharo ᵛdhruvaḥ ᵛityādibhiraṣṭasaṃkhyākaiḥ evaṃ tribhirdevagaṇaiḥ ᵛsacābhuvā saha bhavantau saha vartamānau yuvām ᵛasmākaṃ ᵛratham ajñalābhāya pravṛttam ᵛavatam |
ᵛvayo ᵛna pakṣiṇa iva ᵛpra ᵛpsan prapatanti prakarṣeṇa gacchanti ||

ardha smā na॒ urda̭vatā sajopa॒so ra॒thaṃ de॒vāso॒ abhi॒ viśva॒ vā॒jayṷm | yadā॒śvaḥ pa॒dyābhi̭sti॒traṃto ra॒jaḥ pṛ̭thi॒vyāḥ sā॒nau ja̭ṅghananta pā॒ṇibhi̭ḥ || 2 || ardha | sma | naḥ | ut | avata | sa'jopasaḥ | ratham | devāsaḥ | abhi | viśva | vāja'yum | yat | āśvaḥ | padyābhiḥ | tiraṃtaḥ | rajaḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | sānau | jaṅghananta | pāṇibhiḥ ||2||
haṃ sajopasaḥ samānaṃ prīyamāṇāḥ devāsaḥ devāḥ adha adhunā naḥ asmākaṃ vājayuṃ vāja- mannaṃ kāmayamānaṃ gativiśeṣayuktaṃ vā rathaṃ viśva prajāsu janapadeṣu abhi abhimukham udavata udagamayata |
yat yadā asmin rathe yuktāḥ āśvaḥ vyāpanaśīlā aśvāḥ padyābhiḥ pādasādhyābhirgatibhiḥ rajaḥ rañjakaṃ mārgaṃ tiraṃtaḥ tarantaḥ ||
tarateḥ śatari bahulaṃ chandasi iti śapaḥ |
pṛthivyāḥ prathitāyā bhūmeḥ sānau samucchrite pradeśe pāṇibhiḥ pāṇyapalakṣitaiḥ pādaiḥ jaṅghananta atyarthaṃ gacchanti ||

uta sma na॒ indro̭ vi॒śvaca̭rṣaṇi॒rdi॒vaḥ śardhḙna mā॒rutḙna su॒kratṷḥ | anu॒ nu svā॒tyava॒kābhi̭rū॒tibhi॒ rthaṃ ma̭he sa॒naye॒ vā̭jasā॒tayḙ || 3 || uta | sma | naḥ | indraḥ | viśva'carṣaṇiḥ | divaḥ | śardhena | mārutena | su'kratuḥ | anu | nu | svāti | avakābhiḥ | ūtibhiḥ | ratham | mahe | sanaye | vāja'sātaye || 3 ||
uta api ca viśvacarṣaṇiḥ viśvasya sarvasya draṣṭā yadvā viśve carṣaṇyaḥ manuṣyāḥ yasya paricārakāḥ |
athavā viśve sarve lokāścarṣaṇīyo draṣṭavyā yena ||
bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām iti pūrva- padāntodāttatvam ||

mārutena marutsamūharūpeṇa śardhena balena saha sukratuḥ śobhanakarmā śobhanaprajño vā syaḥ saḥ indraḥ avakābhiḥ hiṃsakarahitābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ rakṣābhiḥ sahitaḥ san divaḥ dyulokāt āgatya nu atha naḥ asmākaṃ ratham anu sthāti ānuguṇyenadhitiṣṭhatu ||

uta sya de॒vo bhṷva॒nasya॒ sakṣa̭ṇista॒ṣṭā grā॒bhiḥ sa॒joṣā̭ jūjuva॒dratha̭m | i॒ḻā bha॒go bṛha̭ddi॒vo ro̭dasī॒ pūṣā̭ pu॒raṃdhi̭raśvi॒nāva॒dhā pa॒tī || 4 || uta | sya | devaḥ | bhuvanasya | sakṣaṇiḥ | tvaṣṭā | grābhiḥ | sa'joṣāḥ | jūjuvat | ratham | iḻā | bhagaḥ | bṛhat'divā | uta | rodasī iti | pūṣā | puraṃdhiḥ | aśvinau | ardha | patī iti || 4 ||
vuta api ca vsya: sa: vdeva: dānādiguṇayukta: vbhuvanasya bhūtajātasya vsakṣaṇa: sacanīya: sevya: vprābhi: devapatnībhi: |
evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭa: vraśvā asmadīyaṃ vrathaṃ vjujuvat prerayatu ||
tathā viḻā tisṛṇāṃ devīnām ādyā2 iḍāḻyā devī ca rathaṃ prerayatu |
vuta api ca vrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vpuraṃdhi: bahudhī: |
vpatī sūryābhā bhartārau vaśvinau ca ete sarve'smadīyaṃ rathaṃ prerayantvityartha: ||
uta tye devī subhage mithudṛśopāsānaktā jagatāmapījuvā |
stupe yadvai pṛthivi navyasā vaca: sthātuśca vayastrivayā upastireṃ ||
uta | tye iti | devī iti | subhage iti su'bhage | mithu'dṛśā | upasānaktā | jagatām | api'juvā | stupe | yat | vām | pṛthivi | navyasā | vaca: | sthātu: | ca | vaya: | trivayā: | upa'stireṃ ||5||

vuta api ca vhye te prasiddhe vdevī devyau devanaśīle vsubhage śobhanadhane vmithudṛśā mitha: parasparaṃ paśyantyau evaṃbhūte vupāsānaktā upāśca rātriśca vjagato jaṅgamānām vapījuvā3 prerayitavyau bhavata: |
he vpṛthivi vyāṃ yuvāṃ tvāṃ divaṃ ca vnavyasā navīyasā bhavatareṇa praśastayena vvaca: vacasā ||
tadānīṃ vsthātu: sthāvarasya vrīhāde: saṃbandha vvaya: annaṃ carupuroḍāśādilakṣaṇaṃ vtrivayā: |
oṣadhipaśusomā- tmakāni4 havirlakṣaṇānyannāni yasya tādṛśo'ham vupastireṃ upastṛṇe |
trita ṛbhukṣā: savitā cano dadhe'pāṃ napādāśuhemā dhiyā śarbhi ||
uta | va: | śaṃsam | uśijām'iva | imasi | ahi: | budhnya: | aja: | eka'pāt | uta | trita: | ṛbhukṣā: | savitā | cana: | dadhe | apām | napāt | āśu'hemā | dhiyā | śarbhi ||6||
vuta api ca he devā: vuśijāmiva |
aramanta: stutiṃ kāmayamānānāṃ vva: yuṣmākaṃ vśaṃsaṃ stutiṃ saṃprati vimasi imasi kāmayāmahe |

1. ṇa-tha-ca- ‘caḍhi’ nāsti | 2. ṇa-tha-sāyā; ma-sayo | 3. kha-ga-jha-1-ṇa-va-apijuvā | 4. ma-sthāvarasya carasya | 5. kha-ga-ṇa-oṣadhayaśca | 6. kha-ga-jha-1-ṇa-ṇa1-va-stṛha | 7. kha-ga-ṇa1- pūraṇam; tha-va-padapūraṇam | 8. kha-ga-jha-1-ṇa1- masi | ṛ. 2-17
tritaḥ tīrṇatamaḥ ṛbhukṣāḥ urukṣayaḥ urunivāsaḥ ṛbhūṇāṃ nivāsayitā vā indraśca savitā sarvasya prasavitā canaḥ annaṃ dadha vidhadhātu|
hi gatau ityasmāt anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante iti manin|
advaya oṣadhivanaspatayo jāyante oṣadhivanaspati- bhyaścāyamagnirjāyate ityeteṣāṃ pautratvam|
yadvā dhiyā karmaṇā asmadīyena paricaraṇalakṣaṇena śami śaṃ sukhaṃ tannimittaṃ
^dyāvāpṛthivī he dyāvāpṛthivyau ^ṛtāyata: ṛtaṃ yajñamātmana icchata: ^siṣāsata: yuvāṃ saṃbhaktu- micchata: ^asya^ vacasa: ||
stotu: asya ^me mama ^avitrī avitryau pālayitryau ^bhūtaṃ bhavatama|
^yayo: dyāvāpṛthivyo: ^āyu: annaṃ ^prataraṃ prakṛṣṭataram utpadyate iti kṣepa:|
^idam idānīṃ ^te dyāvāpṛthivyau ^upastute tatra tatra sthitai: stotṛbhi: snute ^vāṃ yuvāṃ ^vasyu: dhanakāmo'haṃ ^maha: mahata: ||
mā no guhā ripa āyorahandabhnā na ābhyo riradho ducchunābhya: |
mā no vi yau: sukhayā viddhi tasya na: sumrāyatā manasā taccairmahe ||
mā | na: | guhā | ripa: | āyo: | ahan | dabhan | mā | na: | ābhya: | riradha: | ducchunābhya: | mā | na: | vi | yau: | sukhayā | viddhi | tasya | na: | sumrāyatā | manasā | tat | tvā | īmahe ||2||
he indra tvaṣṭarvā ^āyo: manuṣyasya śatrubhūtasya ^guhā: gopyā: jñātumaśakyā: ^ripa: hiṃsā- rūpā māyā: ^na: asmān ^ahan |
api ca ^na: asmākaṃ ^sabhyā satyāni sakhitvāni ^mā ^vi ^yau: tvayā viyuktāni mā kārṣī: |
api tu ^bha: asmākaṃ ^tasya tatsakhitvaṃ ^sumrāyatā sukhamasmāka- micchatā ^manasā ^viddhi jānīhi ||
‘kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam’ iti karmaṇa: saṃpradānatvāta caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī ||
aheḻatā manasā śruṣṭimā vaha duhānāṃ dhenuṃ pipyuṣīmasaśratam |
padyābhirāśuṃ varcasā ca vājinaṃ tvāṃ hinomi puruhūta viśvahā ||
aheḻatā | manasā | śruṣṭim | ā | vaha | duhānām | dhenum | pipyuṣīm | asaśratam | padyābhi: | āśum | varcasā | ca | vājinam | tvām | hinomi | puru'hūta | viśvahā ||3||
he indra tvaṣṭarvā ^aheḻatā akrudhyatā ^manasā ^śruṣṭiṃ sukhakarīṃ ^duhānāṃ dogdhrīṃ ^pipyuṣīṃ pravṛddhāṃ pīnām ||
^asaśratam asaktā- vayavām evaṃbhūtāṃ ^dhenuṃ gām ^ā ^vaha ābhimukhyena prāpaya |
api ca he ^puruhūta bahubhirāhūtaindra tvaṣṭā ^padyābhi: pādagatibhi: ^āśuṃ vyāpanaśīlaṃ ^vacasā vācā ^ca ^vājinaṃ vegavantaṃ ^tvāṃ ^viśvahā sarvaivaha:su ^hinomi stutibhi: prerayāmi ||
2. ka-a-jña-ta-tha-ma-tra-śatrusenābhya: no'smān; kha-ga- ‘śatrusenābhya:’ nāsti; jha-1-na- asmān; ṇa-no'smān |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘rākāmahaṃ sinīvāli kuhūmahamiti dve yājyānuvākye’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 10) iti |
rākāmahaṃ suhavāṃ suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā |
rākām | aham | su'havām | su'stutī | huve | śṛṇotu | naḥ | su'bhagā | bodhatu | tmanā | sīvyatu | apaḥ | sūcyā | acchidyamānayā | dadātu | vīram | śata'dāyam | ukthyam ||4||
tāṃ devīṃ suhavāṃ svāhānāma āhvānaprayojanakāriṇīṃ suṣṭutā śobhanayā stutyā ahaṃ huve āhvayāmi ||
suṣṭunśabdāt tṛtīyekavacanasya ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti parvasavarṇa īkāraḥ ||
sā ca subhagā śobhanadhanā naḥ asmākamāhvānaṃ śṛṇotu |
śrutvā ca tmanā ātmanā svayameva bodhatu asmadabhiprāyaṃ budhyatām |
buddhvā ca apaḥ karma putrotpādanalakṣaṇaṃ sūcyā sūcīsthānīyāyā acchidyamānayā avicchinnayā anugrahabuddhyā sīvyatu saṃtanonu |
yathā vastrādikaṃ sūcyā syūtaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhati evamidaṃ karotu |
kṛtvā ca vīraṃ vikrāntaṃ śatadāyaṃ bahudhanaṃ bahupradaṃ vā ukthyaṃ praśasyaṃ putraṃ dadātu ||
yāstai rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhirdadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni |
tābhinoṃ adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrapoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā ||
yāḥ | te | rāke | su'matayaḥ | su'peśasaḥ | yābhiḥ | dadāsi | dāśuṣe | vasūni | tābhiḥ | naḥ | adya | su'manāḥ | upa'āgahi | sahasra'poṣam | su'bhage | rarāṇā || 5 ||
he rāke devi supeśasaḥ śobhanarūpāḥ te tava yāḥ sumatayaḥ śobhanāḥ buddhayaḥ yābhiḥ dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya vasūni dhanāni dadāsi prayacchasi |
adya idānīṃ tābhiḥ matibhiḥ sahitā tvaṃ sumanāḥ śobhanamanasā bhūtvā upāgahi upāgaccha ||
he subhage śobhanadhane sahasrapoṣaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākasya dhanasya puṣṭiṃ rarāṇā dadatī ||

sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmi khasā | juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ || 6 || sinīvāli | pṛthu'ṣṭuke | yā | devānām | asi | svasā | juṣasva | havyam | ā'hutam | pra'jām | devi | didiḍḍhi | naḥ || 6 ||

he ᵥsinīvāli ᵥpṛthuṣṭuke pṛthujaghane pṛthusaṃhate vā ᵥyā ᵥtvaṃ ᵥdevānāṃ ᵥsvasā ᵥasi svayaṃsāriṇī' bhaginī vā bhavasi sā tvam ᵥāhutam ābhimukhyenāgnau prakṣiptaṃ ᵥhavyam asmadīyaṃ haviḥ ᵥjuṣasva sevasva |
kiṃ ca haṃ ᵥdevi sinīvāli ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥprajāṃ putrādikāṃ ᵥdidiḍḍhi upacinu atisarjaye vā |

yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ supūrmā bahusūvarī | tasyai viṣpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana || 7 || yā | su'bāhuḥ | su'aṅguriḥ | su'pūrmā | bahu'sūvarī | tasyai | viṣpatnyai | haviḥ | sinīvālyai | juhotana || 7 ||
ᵥyā sinīvālī ᵥsubāhuḥ śobhanabāhuḥ ᵥsvaṅguriḥ śobhanāṅguliḥ ᵥsupūrmā suṣṭhu pramavitrī ||
yā guhūyā sinīvālīṃ yā rākā yā sarasvatīṃ | indrāṇīmah ūtaye varuṇāṇīṃ svastaye || 8 || yā | guhūḥ | yā | sinīvālī | yā | rākā | yā | sarasvatī | indrāṇīm | ahe | ūtaye | varuṇāṇīm | svastaye || 8 ||
atra ᵥguhūśabdena rākāsinīvālyoḥ sāhacaryāt kuhurucyate ᵥyā ᵥguhūḥ ᵥkuhaḥ ᵥtām ᵥahe āhvayāmi ᵥevamuttaratrāpi ᵥyojyam' |
ᵥindrāṇīm indrasya patnīm ᵥūtaye rakṣaṇārthamahe āhvayāmi |
yā sinīvālī yā rākā yā sarasvatī sāḥ (tāḥ) etāḥ ahe; tha-āhvayāmi |
sinīvālī yā rākā yā sarasvatī tāḥ etāḥ ahe |
tathā varuṇāṃnī varuṇasya patnī svastaye avimāśāya āhvayāmi ||
tatra ‘ā te pitaḥ’ iti pañcadaśacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ gṛtsamadasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ raudram|
anukrāntaṃ ca—‘ā te paśnonā raudram’ iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘kadrudrāyemā rudrāya te pitarimā rudrāya sthiradhanvana iti sarvarudra- yajñeṣu diśāmupasthānam’ (āśva. gṛ. 4. 8. 23) iti|
rudradevatye paśau ‘ā te pitaḥ’ iti haviṣo'nuvākyā|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā te pitarmarutāṃ sunmametu pra babhrave vṛṣabhāya ścitīca iti tiṣṭhaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti|
ā tḙ pi॒tarma॒rutā॒ṃ sunma̭me॒tu mā na॒ḥ sūrya̭sya sa॒ṃdṛśo̭ yu॒yothā̭ḥ |
a॒bhi no̭ vī॒ro a̭rva॒ti kṣḙma॒t pra jā̭yemahi॒ rudra॒ pra॒jābhi̭ḥ ||
ā | tḙ | pi॒taḥ | ma॒rutā̭m | sunma̭m | e॒tu | mā | na॒ḥ | sūrya̭sya | sam'dṛśa̭ḥ | yu॒yothā̭ḥ | a॒bhi | na॒ḥ | vī॒raḥ | a॒rva॒ti | kṣḙmat | pra | jā॒ye॒ma॒hi॒ | rudra̭ | pra॒'jābhi̭ḥ || 1 ||
he marutāṃ pitaḥ marutsaṃjñānāṃ devānāmutpādaka rudra ||
te tvadīyamasabhyaṃ dātavyaṃ sunmaṃ sukham ‘ā etu āgacchatu|
rudrasya ca marutāṃ pitṛtvam ‘idaṃ pitre marutām’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 114. 6) ityatrākhyāyikā mukhenāvādima|
tathā tvaṃ naḥ asmān sūryasya saṃdṛśaḥ saṃdarśanāt mā yuyothāḥ mā pṛthakārṣīḥ ||
