yadyṷñjate॒ marṷto॒ rukma̭vakṣaso॒'śvā ra̭the॒ṣu bha॒ga ā sudā̭nava: | dhe॒nuṃ śi॒śve khasa̭repu॒ pinva̭te॒ janā̭ya॒ śata̭haviṣe ma॒hīmi॒ṣam || 8 || yat | yu॒ñjatḙ | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | ru॒kma'va̭kṣasa: | a॒śvām | ra॒the॒ṣu | bha॒ga: | ā | su॒dā̭nava: | dhe॒num | śi॒śve | svasa̭reṣu | pi॒nva̭te | ja॒nā̭ya | śa॒ta'ha̭viṣe | ma॒hīm | i॒ṣam || 8 ||
tadānīmeva ^rātahavipe dattahaviṣkāya yajamānāya ^mahīṃ mahatīm ^ipam ^tatkāraṇabhūtamudakaṃ vā ^svasarepu svakīyeṣu gṛheṣu ^pinvate siñcanti kiranti |
yathā dhenuḥ prasūtastanī satī svakīyāya vatsāya kṣīraṃ prayacchati tadvat |

yo nau maruto vṛkatāti martyā ripurdhve vasavo rakṣatā ripaḥ | vartayat tarpuṣā cakriyābhi tamarva rudrā aśaso hantanā vadhaḥ || 9 || yaḥ | naḥ | marutaḥ | vṛka'tāti | martyaḥ | ripuḥ | dhve | vasavaḥ | rakṣata | ripaḥ | vartayat | tarpuṣā | cakriyā | abhi | tam | ava | rudrāḥ | aśasaḥ | hantana | vadhariti ||9||
‘ vṛkayethābhyāṃ tiltātilau ca chandasi ’ ( pā. sū. 5. 4. 41 ) iti svārthikastātilapratyayaḥ |
asmākaṃ ^śatrubhūtaṃ martya ^tapuṣā tāpayitvā ^cakriyā ṛgvākyayā śaktyā ^abhi ^vartayata abhito nivartayata |
tādṛśasya rākṣasādeḥ ^vadhaḥ hananasādhanamāyudham ^ava ^hantana avayudhya asaktaḥ pṛthakkṛtya nāśayata |

citraṃ tadvau maruto yāmaṃ cekite pṛśyā yadūrpyāpayau duhuḥ | yadvā nide narvamānasya rudrāstritaṃ jarāṃya juratāmadābhyāḥ || 10 || citram | tat | vaḥ | marutaḥ | yāmaṃ | cekite | pṛśyāḥ | yat | ūdhaḥ | api | āpayaḥ | duhuḥ | yat | vā | nide | narvamānasya | rudriyāḥ | tritam | jarāṃya | juratām | adābhyāḥ ||10||
^yat yadā khalu ^pṛśyāḥ mādhyamikāyā vācaḥ saṃbandhanam ^ūdhaḥ uddhataṃ megham ^āpayaḥ prāpayitāro marutaḥ ^duhuḥ duhanti |
^yadvā yadā ca ^naghamānasya stuvataḥ tritasya ^nide nindakāya śatrave hiṃsāṃ kṛtavanta iti śeṣaḥ |
tadānīṃ he ^adābhyāḥ ahiṃsyāḥ ^rudriyāḥ rudrasya putrāḥ marutaḥ ^tritam ṛṣi ^juratāṃ hiṃsatāṃ śatrūṇāṃ ^jarāya jaraṇāya vināśāya abhūta iti śeṣaḥ |
tanvaṷ maho murutaṃ e॒vayānvi̭ṣṇo॒reṣa̭sya॒ prabhṛ̭the ha̭vāmahe |
tān | vṛḥ | mahaḥ | murutaḥ | e॒vayān | viṣṇoḥ | eṣa̭sya | pra'bhṛthe | ha̭vāmahe | hira̭ṇyavarṇān | ka॒kuhān | yata'sucaḥ | brahmaṇya̭ntaḥ | śaṃsya̭m | rādhaḥ | ī̭mahe || 11 ||

haṃ murutaḥ ᵥevayānḥ evaṃ gantavyaṃ stotraṃ yajñaṃ vā gantṛn ᵥmahaḥ mahato mahānubhāvān ᵥtān ᵥvaḥ yuṣmān ᵥviṣṇoḥ vyāpakasya mahacamasādiṣu sarvatra vyāpya vartamānasya ᵥeṣasya eṣaṇīyasya prārthanīyasya somasya ᵥprabhṛthe prabharaṇe abhipravādibhiḥ prakarṣeṇa saṃpādane sati ᵥhavāmahe āhvayāmahe |
āhvaya ca ᵥhiraṇyavarṇān hitaramaṇīyavarṇān vā ᵥkakuhān śreṣṭhān stutyān vā evaṃbhūtāstān ᵥyata-sucaḥ yāgāya udyatasucaḥ ᵥbrahmaṇyantaḥ |
tadicchanto vayaṃ ᵥśaṃsyaṃ praśaṃsanīyaṃ ᵥrādhaḥ dhanam ᵥīmahe yācāmahe ||
te da̭rśa॒vāḥ pratha॒mā ya॒jñamūha̭ire te nau hinvantūpa॒so vyṷṣṭiṣu |
u॒ṣā na rāmī̭ru॒ṇairaurṇute ma॒ho jyo̭ti॒ṣā śuca̭tā goa̭rṇasā ||
te | da̭rśa॒vāḥ | pratha॒māḥ | ya॒jñam | ūha̭ire | te | naḥ | hinvantu | upa̭saḥ | vi'ṷṣṭiṣu | u॒ṣāḥ | na | rāmīḥ | a॒ruṇeḥ | arpa | ūrṇute | mahaḥ | jyo̭ti॒ṣā | śuca̭tā | go'a̭rṇasā || 12 ||
ye daśabhirmāsaiḥ siddhiṃ gatā aṅgirasastadrūpā bhūtvā ᵥprathamāḥ ādityebhyaḥ prathamabhāvinaḥ santaḥ ᵥyajñamūhiri ahavan |
ādityānāmaṅgirasāṃ ca svargagamanaṃ prati spardhamānānāṃ madhye pūrvamevāṅgiraso yāgānuṣṭhāya svargaṃ prāptāḥ |
tathā ca śrūyate—‘ādityāścaivehāsannaṅgirasaśca te'gre'gni-mābhyajayanta ’ (ai. brā. 1. 16 ) iti |
tādṛśāḥ ᵥte ᵥupaso ᵥvyuṣṭiṣu vivāseṣu prabhāteṣu satsu ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥhinvantu prerayantu |
ᵥrāmīḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā rātrīḥ ᵥupā ᵥna yathopāḥ ᵥaruṇeḥ ārocamānaiḥ svatejobhiḥ ᵥaporṇute apavṛṇotyapasārayati |
tathā ᵥmahaḥ mahatā ᵥśucatā dīpyamānena ᵥgoarṇasā gacchadudakena ᵥjyotiṣā sūryākhyena tamo nivārayanti |
sūryamaṇḍala-māvṛṇvato vṛtrādīn hatvā sarvaṃ jagat prakāśayantītyarthaḥ ||
te kṣo̭ṇībhi॒rarṷṇebhi॒rañji̭bhī॒ rudrā̭ ṛ॒tasya॒ sada̭neṣu vāvṛdhuḥ |
ni॒megha̭mānā a॒tyena॒ṃ pāra̭sā su॒ścandra॒ṃ varṇa̭ṃ dadhire su॒peśa̭sam ||
te | kṣo̭ṇībhiḥ | a॒ruṇebhiḥ | a॒ñji̭bhīḥ | rudrāḥ | ṛ॒tasya | sada̭neṣu | vāvṛdhuḥ | ni॒megha̭mānāḥ | a॒tyena̭m | pāra̭sā | su'ca̭ndram | varṇa̭m | dadhire | su'peśa̭sam || 13 ||
ārocamānai: aruṇavarṇai: ^vā rūpābhinyaaṃkairalaṃkāraiśca samanvitā: santaḥ ^ṛtasya udakasya ^sadaneṣu nivāsabhūteṣu meghepu ^vāgvadhu: vardhante |
api ca ^athena satatagāminā śīghraṃ vyāmuvatā ^pājamā ātmīyena balena ^nimeghamānā: nitarāṃ meghādukaṃ cintayantaḥ ^te ^suśrandraṃ śobhanāhlādanaṃ ^supeśasam |
tāṃ īyāno mahi varūthamataya upa ghedenā narmasā gṛṇīmasi |
tān | īyāna: | mahi | varūtham | ūtaye | upa | gha | it | enā | narmasā | gṛṇīmasi | trita: | na | yān | pañca | hotṛn | abhiṣṭaye | ā'vavartat | arvarān | cakriyā | avase || 14 ||
^tān marutaḥ ^mahi mahat ^varūthaṃ varaṇīyaṃ praśastaṃ dhanaṃ tat marutaḥ ^ūtaye rakṣaṇārtham ^īyāna: īyānā yācamānā vayam ||
^enā anena ^namasā namaskāreṇa stotreṇa vā ^upa ^it upetya ^gṛṇīmasi stuma: ||
^gha iti pādapūraṇa: ^enā ityatra ‘ supāṃ suluk’ iti tṛtīyāyā ājādeśa: |

^trita: ṛṣiśca ^yān etān marutaḥ ^pañca ^hotṛn adhyātmaprāṇāpānādipañcabhūtātmanā vartamānān ata eva homaniṣpādakān ^avarān mukhyān ^ ^abhiṣṭaye abhilapitasiddhayarthaṃ ^cakriyā nābhicakraṇa ^avase avituṃ saṃgantum ^āvavartat svasmā- ñjiṃjimapitūn prāṇān svāsmābhimukhamāvartayat |
yadvā cakriyā ṛṣṭyākhyena āyudhena yuktān avase stutyādibhi: tarpayitum āvartayat |
yayo radhaṃ pārayatātyaṃho yayo nido muścartha vanditāram |
arvācī sā maruto yā ve ūtiro pu vāśvevaṃ sumatirjigātu ||
yayo | radham | pārayatha | ati | aha: | yayā | nida: | muñcatha | vanditāram | arvācī | sā | marutaḥ | yā | va: | ūti: | o iti | su | vāśva'iva | sumati: | jigātu || 15 ||
he marutaḥ ^yayā ūtyā ^radham ārādhakaṃ yajamānam ^aṃha: pāpam ^ati ^pārayatha ati- kramayatha |
^yayā ūtyā ^vanditāraṃ stotāraṃ ^nida: ninditu: śatro: sakāśāt ^muñcatha mocayatha |
tathā ^sumati: yuṣmadīyā śobhanā mati: anugrahātmikā buddhiśca ^vāśveva hambhāravaṃ kurvatī dhenuriva varasaṃ ^su suṣṭhu ^o ^jigātu eva gacchatu |
‘upem’ iti pañcadaśacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ gāsmamadaṃ traiṣṭubham apāṃnapāddevatākam |
upema॒sṛkṣi॒ vāja̭yurvaca॒syāṃ ca॒noṃ da̭dhīta॒ nādyo॒ giro̭ me |
upa̭ | ī॒m | a॒sṛkṣi̭ | vāja̭'yuḥ | va॒ca॒syām | ca॒naḥ | da॒dhīta̭ | nādya̭ḥ | gira̭ḥ | me | a॒pām | na॒pāt | ā॒śu॒'hemā̭ | kuvi̭t | saḥ | su॒'peśa̭saḥ | ka॒ra॒ti॒ | joṣi̭ṣat | hi || 1 ||
vvājayuḥ vājamannamātmana icchannaham vīm enāṃ vvacasyāṃ vacasaḥ stotrasyecchām vupa vasṛkṣi upāsājāmi utpādayāmi |
saḥ ca vnādyaḥ nadīnāṃ śabdakāriṇīnāṃ meghasthānāṃmapāṃ saṃbandhī vāśuhemā āśu śīghraṃ gantā ||
‘hi gatau’ ityasmāt ‘anye- bhyo'pi dṛśyante’ iti manin ||
adya oṣadhivanaspatayo jāyante oṣadhivanaspatibhya epo'gnirjāyeta iti tatpautratvam |
bahulaṃ vcanaḥ annaṃ vdadhīta dadhātu vidadhātu |
api cāsmān vsupeśasaḥ śobhanarūpān śobhanālaṃkārān vā vkarati karotu ||
vhi yasmāt ayaṃ devaḥ vjoṣiṣat stotrāṇi sevate tasmādasmānevamanugṛhṇātvityarthaḥ ||
i॒maṃ sva̭smai॒ hṛda॒ ā sṷta॒ṣṭaṃ ma̭ntra॒ṃ vocḙma॒ kuvi̭dasya॒ veda̭t |
a॒pāṃ na̭pā॒dasa̭urya̭sya ma॒hnā vi॒śvānyṷryo॒ bhuva̭nā jajāna ||
i॒mam | sva̭ | a॒smai | hṛda̭ḥ | ā | su॒'taṣṭa̭m | ma॒ntram | vocḙma | kuvi̭t | a॒sya | veda̭t | a॒pām | na॒pāt | a॒surya̭sya | ma॒hnā | vi॒śvāni̭ | a॒ryaḥ | bhuva̭nā | ja॒jāna॒ || 2 ||
vasmai apāṃnapātsaṃjñakāya devāya vhṛdaḥ hṛdayāt vsutaṣṭaṃ suṣṭhu nirmitam vimaṃ vmantraṃ suṣṭhu vā ābhimukhyena vvocema bravāma |
vasya asmābhiruktamimaṃ mantraṃ vkuvit vvedat bahulaṃ jānātu ||
tasya svabhūtasya balasya vmahnā mahinā mahattvena vviśvāni sarvāṇi vbhuvanā bhuvanāni vṛṣṭyudakāni vṛṣṭyutpādanena bhūtajātāni vā vjajāna janayāmāsa ||
apolaptrīye vasatīvarīsamīpe ekadhanāsu' prāptāsu ' samanyā yanti ' ityepā'nuvaktavyā |
sūtritaṃ ca — ' samanyā yantyupa yantyanyā' iti tīrthadeśe ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 1) iti |
sārasvate ca śastre yadyapsu śamyā nipatettadānīm apolaptrīyaśvaraḥ kāryaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca — ' samanyā yantyu- payantyanyā hyathātaḥ samānaṃ sarveṣām ' (āśva. śrau. 12. 6) iti ||
samanyā yantyupa yantyanyāḥ samānamūrvaṃ nadyaḥ pṛṇanti |
tamu śuciṃ śucayo dīdivāṃsamapāṃ napātaṃ pari tasthurāpaḥ ||
sam | anyāḥ | yanti | upa | yanti | anyāḥ | samānam | ūrvam | nadyaḥ | pṛṇanti | tam | ū~ iti | śucim | śucayaḥ | dīdivāṃsam | apāṃ | napātam | pari | tasthuḥ | āpaḥ || 3 ||
tāḥ sarvā āpaḥ 'samānaṃ saha 'nadyaḥ nadībhūtāḥ 'ūrvaṃ samudramadhye vartamānaṃ vaḍavānalaṃ 'pṛṇanti prīṇayanti' |
epa hi vaidyutāgnirūpeṇa meghe vartamānaḥ asamānajījanaditi buddhyā vaḍavānala- rūpeṇa vartamānaṃ taṃ paryupāsate ityarthaḥ |
yadvā anyā ekadhanākhyā āpaḥ saṃyanti cātvālotkarayormadhye vasatīvarībhiḥ saṃgacchante |
etāśca militvā yajñaṃ sādhayantyaḥ tassādyavṛdbhidvārā' nadyo bhūtvā ūrvaṃ pṛṇanti ityādi samānam |
evaṃ hi 'āpo vā aspardhanta vayaṃ pūrvaṃ yajñaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ' (ai. brā. 2. 20) ityādi kaṃ brāhmaṇaviniyoga- śrānugṛhyate ||
tamasmairā yuvatayo yuvānaṃ mṛjyamānāḥ pari yantyāpaḥ |
sa śukebhiḥ śikebhī revadasme dīdāryānidhmo ghṛtanirṇigpsu ||
tam | asmairāḥ | yuvatayaḥ | yuvānam | mṛjyamānāḥ | pari | yanti | āpaḥ | saḥ | śukebhiḥ | śikebhiḥ | revat | asmai iti | dīdārya | anidhmaḥ | ghṛta'nirṇig | apsu ||4||
'tam apāṃ napatamabhima 'asmairāḥ asamayamānā darparahitāḥ 'yuvatayo 'yuvānaṃ yuvarājamiva 'mṛjyamānāḥ aryarthamalaṃkurvāṇāḥ 'āpaḥ ||

dīsarūpaḥ ^saḥ apāṃ napādagniḥ ^apsu meghāntargatāsu samudragatāsu vā madhye ^anindhaḥ indhanarahita eva san ^asme asmākaṃ ^revat dhanayuktamannaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ^śukebhiḥ śubhaiḥ ^nirmalaiḥ ^śikabhiḥ tejobhiḥ ^dīdāya dīpyate ||
kṛtāiva hi presareṃ apsu sa pīyūṣaṃ dhayati pūrvasūnām ||
asmai | tisraḥ | anyadhyāyā | nārīḥ | devārya | devīḥ | didhiṣanti | annam | kṛtāḥ'iva | upa | hi | pra'sare | apa'su | saḥ | pīyūṣam | dhayati | pūrva'sūnām || 5 ||
^yasmādevaṃ ^tasmāt ^pūrvasūnāṃ pūrva brahmaṇaḥ sakāśādupannānāmāṃ ^pīyūṣaṃ sārabhūtaṃ somākhyamamṛtaṃ ^saḥ apāṃ ^napādgniḥ ^dhayati pibati |
aśvasyātra jarnimāsya ca svardṛho ripaḥ saṃpracaḥ pāhi sūrīn |
āmāmu purṣu puro apramṛṣyaṃ narātayo vi naśannānṛtāni ||
aśvasya | atra | jarnima | asya | ca | svaḥ | druhaḥ | ripaḥ | sam'pṛcaḥ | pāhi | sūrīn | āmāsu | purṣu | puraḥ | apra'mṛṣyam | na | arātayaḥ | vi | naśan | anṛtāni ||6||
ayaṃ hi meghamadhye vartamāno vṛṣṭidvāreṇa sarvaṃ jagajjanayati |
^āmāsu apari- ^pakkāsu ^purṣu pūrayitavyāsvapsu ^paraḥ parastāt vartamānam ^apramṛṣyam apradhṛṣyamāṇaṃ devam ^arātayaḥ ^adātāraḥ puruṣāḥ ^na ^vi ^naśan na prāpnuvanti |
sva ā damḙ sudu॒ghā yasya̭ dhenuḥ sva॒dhāṃ pī̭pāya su॒bhva̭ma॒tti |
sva | ā | damḙ | su॒du॒ghā | yasya̭ | dhenuḥ | sva॒dhām | pī̭pāya | su॒bhva̭m | a॒nnam | a॒tti | saḥ | a॒pām | na॒pāt | ū॒rjeya̭n | a॒psu | a॒ntaḥ | va॒su॒deyā̭ya | vi॒dhatḙ | vi | bhā̭ti ||7||
yaḥ ᵛapāṃ napāt ᵛsve ᵛdame svakīye gṛhe'ntarikṣalakṣaṇe ᵛā sīdati |
ᵛyasya ca ᵛdhenuḥ mādhya- mikā vāk ᵛsudughā sukhena dogdhavyā bhavati |
sa devaḥ ᵛsvadhāṃ vṛṣṭyudakaṃ ᵛpīpāya vardhayati ||
ᵛsubhu suṣṭhu bhūta̭ vṛṣṭeḥ sakāśādannaṃ havirlakṣaṇam ᵛannaṃ ca ᵛatti bhakṣayati |
ᵛsaḥ apāṃnapātsaṃjñako devaḥ ᵛūrjayan balaṃ kurvan ᵛapsvantaḥ meghasthāsvapsu madhye ᵛvidhate paricarate yajamānāya ᵛvasudeyāya dhanadānāya ᵛvi ᵛbhāti viśeṣeṇa dīpyate ||
yo a॒psvā śu॒cinā̭ dai॒vyena̭ ṛ॒tāvā̭rja॒sa u॒rviyā॒ vibhā̭ti |
va॒yā i॒danyā̭ bhu॒vanā̭nya॒sya pra jā̭yante vī॒rudha̭śca pra॒jābhi̭ḥ ||
yaḥ | a॒psu | ā | śu॒cinā̭ | dai॒vyena̭ | ṛ॒ta'vā̭ | a॒rja॒saḥ | u॒rviyā̭ | vi | bhā̭ti | va॒yāḥ | i॒t | a॒nyā̭ | bhu॒vanā̭ni | a॒sya | pra | jā॒ya॒nte | vī॒rudha̭ḥ | ca | pra॒jābhi̭ḥ ||8||
tadvān satyavān vā ᵛajasaḥ nidhyaḥ ekarūpeṇa sadā vartamānaḥ ᵛurviyā uruvistīrṇaḥ ᵛapsu meghasthāsu madhye ᵛśucinā śodhakena ᵛdaivyena devasambandhinā tejasā ᵛā samantāt ᵛvibhāti viśeṣeṇa prakāśate |
ᵛasya apāṃnapātaḥ ᵛanyā anyāni ᵛbhuvanāni sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni ᵛvayā ᵛit śākhā eva |
ᵛvīrudhaḥ oṣadhayaḥ ᵛprajābhiḥ svakīyābhiḥ¹ puṣpaphalādibhiḥ saha asmādeva ᵛpra jāyante |
pūrvokte³ sārasvatasatrasyāponaptrīye carau ‘apāṃ napādā hi’ ityepā'nuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘apāṃ naptre carumapāṃ napādā hyasthādupastham’ (āśva. śrau. 12. 6) iti ||
a॒pāṃ na̭pā॒dā hya̭sthā॒dupa̭sthaṃ ji॒hvānā̭mūrdhvo vi॒dyuta॒ṃ vasā̭naḥ |
tasya॒ jyeṣṭha̭ṃ mahi॒māna̭ṃ vaha̭ntīrhi॒raṇya̭varṇāḥ pari̭ yanti ya॒hvāḥ ||
a॒pām | na॒pāt | ā | hi | a॒sthāt | upa̭'stham | ji॒hvānā̭m | ū॒rdhvaḥ | vi॒dyuta̭m | vasā̭naḥ | tasya̭ | jyeṣṭha̭m | mahi॒māna̭m | vaha̭ntīḥ | hi॒raṇya̭'varṇāḥ | pari̭ | ya॒nti | ya॒hvāḥ || 9 ||
apāṃnapārasaṃjñako'gniḥ ᵛupastham apāmupasthānamantarikṣam ᵛā ᵛsthāt āsthitavān ārūḍhavān khalu |
kiṃ kurvan ? ᵛjihvānāṃ kuṭilagatīnāmapāṃ madhye ᵛūrdhvaḥ svayamūdhvaṃ jvalan ᵛvidyutaṃ vidyotamānaṃ meghaṃ ᵛvasānaḥ ācchādayan |
ᵛtasya varṣiturapāṃnapātaḥ ᵛjyeṣṭhaṃ praśastatamaṃ ᵛmahimānaṃ māhātmyaṃ ᵛvahantīḥ vahantyaḥ sarvatra prāpayantyaḥ ᵛyahīḥ yadyaḥ mahyaḥ ᵛhiraṇyavarṇāḥ |
hiraṇyavarṇairmalarūpā nadyaḥ ᵛpari ᵛyanti parito gacchanti |
apāṃnaptrā mahatī vṛṣṭirasmākaṃ pravahanāyotpāditā iti kṛtajñatayā tadīyaṃ māhātmyaṃ sarvatra prakaṭayantya iva nadyaḥ pravahantītyarthaḥ ||
hiraṇya'rūpaḥ | saḥ | hiraṇya'saṃdṛk | apām | napāt | saḥ | it | oṃ iti | hiraṇya'varṇaḥ | hiraṇyayāt | pari | yonaiḥ | ni'sadya | hiraṇya'dāḥ | dadati | annam | asmai || 10 ||
ᵛevaṃbhūtaḥ san ᵛhiraṇyayāt suvarṇamayāt ᵛyoneḥ sthānāt ᵛpari upari ᵛniṣadya upaviśya rājate iti śeṣaḥ |
ᵛasmai īdṛgvidhāya apāṃ napāte ᵛhiraṇyadāḥ dakṣiṇārūpasya suvarṇasya dātāro yajamānāḥ ᵛannaṃ havirlakṣaṇaṃ ᵛdadati prayacchanti ||
tadsyānīṃkamuta cāru nāmāpīcyaṃ vardhate naptuḥ apām |
tat | asya | anīkam | uta | cāru | nāma | apīcyam | vardhate | naptuḥ | apām | yam | indhate | yuvatayaḥ | sam | itthā | hiraṇyavarṇam | ghṛtam | annam | asya || 11 ||
ᵛasya ᵛapāṃ ᵛnaptuḥ devasya ᵛanīkaṃ raśmisamūhrūpaṃ śarīraṃ ᵛcāru śobhanam |
ᵛuta api ca asya ᵛnāma saṃjñā ca cāru śobhanam |
na pātayati na vināśayatīti napāditi tadvyutpatteḥ |
ᵛyuvatayaḥ saṃgamasvabhāvā āpaḥ ᵛhiraṇyavarṇaṃ hiraṇyasamānatejasaṃ ᵛyam apāṃnapātam ᵛitthā amutrāntarikṣe ᵛsam ᵛindhate samyak dīpayanti |
ᵛasya ca devasya ᵛghṛtaṃ kṣaraṇaśīlamudakam ᵛannaṃ bhakṣyam |

asmai̭ ba॒hūnā̭mava॒māya॒ sakhyḙ ya॒jñairvidhḙma॒ nama̭sā ha॒virbhi̭ḥ | saṃ sā॒nu mā̭rji॒ma di॒dhi॒ṣā॒mi bi॒lmairdhā॒mya॒gnai̭ḥ || 12 || asmai̭ | ba॒hūnā̭m | a॒va॒māya̭ | sakhyḙ | ya॒jñai̭ḥ | vi॒dhe॒ma | nama̭sā | ha॒vi̭ḥ-bhi̭ḥ | sam | sā॒nu | mā॒rji॒ma | di॒dhi॒ṣā॒mi | bi॒lmai̭ḥ | da॒dhā॒mi | a॒gnai̭ḥ | pari̭ | va॒nde | ṛk-bhi̭ḥ ||12||
^asmai purovartine ^bahūnāṃ devānām ^avamāya ācāya ^sakhye asmābhiḥ samānakhyānāya^ apāṃ napāte ^yajñaiḥ yāgasādhanaiḥ ^havirbhiḥ carupuroḍāśādibhiḥ ^namasā namaskāreṇa ca ^vidhema pari- carema |
asyāpāṃnapātaḥ ^sānu samucchritapradeśa ^saṃ ^mārjima samyak śodhayāmi alaṃkaromi vā |
^dadhāmi dhārayāmi cainaṃ gārhapa- tyādirūpeṇa sthitam ^agnaiḥ havirlakṣaṇe |

sa īṃ vṛṣā̭ja॒nyattā̭su॒ garbha॒ṃ sa īṃ śi॒śurdha̭yati॒ taṃ ri̭hanti | so a॒pāṃ na॒pādna̭bhimlāta॒varṇo'nyasyai̭ve॒ha ta॒nvā॒ vi vḙṣa || 13 || saḥ | īm | vṛṣā̭ | a॒ja॒nya॒t | tāsṷ | garbha̭m | saḥ | īm | śi॒śuḥ | dha॒yati̭ | tam | ri̭hanti̭ | saḥ | a॒pām | na॒pāt | a॒na॒bhimlāta̭-varṇaḥ | a॒nyasyai̭ | i॒va | i॒ha | ta॒nvā̭ | vi | vḙṣa || 13 ||
^sa ^īṃ so'yamapāṃnapātsaṃjñako devaḥ ^vṛpā sektā bhūtvā ^tāsu meghadhāravapsu ^garbham ^ajanayat svātmānameva garbharūpeṇa varṣaṇārthaṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ |
garbho bhūtvā ca ^sa ^īṃ so'yaṃ mādhyamikaḥ^ vaidyuto'bhristāsāṃ ^śiśuḥ putraḥ san ^dhayati meghasthāstāḥ pibati |
^saḥ ayam ^apāṃ ^napāt vṛṣṭyā saha bhūmau nipatitaḥ ^anabhimlātavarṇaḥ abhito mlāto mlānaḥ kṣīṇo varṇo yasya tadviparītastathyaṃ dīpyamānaḥ san ^iha asmin loke ^anyasyeva |
anyasya pārthivasyāgneḥ ^tanvā śarīreṇa kāṣṭhendhanatvalakṣaṇena ^viveṣa vyāso babhūva |

a॒sminpa॒de pa̭ra॒me ta̭sthi॒vāṃsa̭ma॒śvasa̭ma॒rbhirvi॒śvahā̭ dī॒di॒vāṃsa̭m | āpo̭ na॒ptre ghṛ॒tama̭nna॒ṃ vaha̭ntīḥ sva॒yamata̭kai॒ḥ pari̭ dīyanti॒ yahvī̭ḥ || 14 || a॒smin | pa॒de | pa॒ra॒me | ta॒sthi॒vāṃsa̭m | a॒śvasa̭m | a॒bhi̭ḥ | vi॒śvahā̭ | dī॒di॒vāṃsa̭m | āpa̭ḥ | na॒ptre | ghṛ॒tam | a॒nnam | vaha̭ntīḥ | sva॒yam | a॒tkai̭ḥ | pari̭ | dī॒yanti̭ | ya॒hvī̭ḥ ||14||
viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhaddema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
pibendra svāhā prahutaṃ varṣatṛtaṃ hotrādā somaṃ prathamo ya īśiṣe ||

jagata īśvaro bhavasi saḥ 1 tvaṃ prathamaḥ anyebhyo devebhyaḥ pūrvabhāvī san svāhā svāhākāreṇa prahutaṃ prakarṣeṇāgnau kṣisaṃ vapaṭkṛtaṃ vapaṭkāreṇa ca vyaktaṃ taṃ somaṃ hotrāt hotaryāgāta ā samantāt piba ||

yajñaiḥ saṃmiślāḥ pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiryāmanśubhrāso agniṣu priyā uta | āsadyā barhirbharatasya sūnavaḥ potrādā somaṃ pibatā divo naraḥ || 2 || yajñaiḥ | saṃ'miślāḥ | pṛṣatībhiḥ | ṛṣṭi'bhiḥ | yāman | śubhrāsaḥ | agniṣu | priyāḥ | uta | ā'sadya | barhiḥ | bharatasya | sūnavaḥ | potrāt | ā | somam | pibata | divaḥ | naraḥ ||2||

he marutaḥ yajñaiḥ yāgaiḥ saṃmiślāḥ saṃyuktāḥ pṛṣatībhiḥ svavāhanabhūtābhiḥ pṛṣadbhīrbhirvarvābhiryukte yāman yāmani gamanasādhane rathe'vasthitāḥ ṛṣṭibhiḥ svakīyairāyudhaiḥ śubhrāsaḥ śubhrāḥ śobhamānāḥ |

agniṣu ābharaṇeṣu priyāḥ ca he bharatasya sūnavaḥ sarvasya jagato bhartu rudrasya putrāḥ divo naraḥ divo'ntarikṣasya netāraḥ evaṃbhūtā he marutaste yūyaṃ barhiḥ āstīrṇe barhiṣi āsadya upaviśya potrāt potryāgāta somam ā pibata ||
tṛtīyasavane 'ameva naḥ' ityepā neṣṭuḥ sthitayājyā ca |
tathā ca sūtritam—'ameva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantanendrāviṣṇū pibataṃ madhvo asya' (āśva. śrau. 5. 5 ) iti ||

amevaṃ naḥ suhavā ā hi gantaṃ ni barhiṣi sadata raṇiṣṭana | athā mandasva jujuṣāṇo andhasastvaṣṭevebhirjanibhiḥ sumadraṇaḥ || 3 || amā'īva | naḥ | su'havāḥ | ā | hi | gantan | ni | barhiṣi | sadata | raṇiṣṭana | atha | mandasva | jujuṣāṇaḥ | andhasaḥ | tvaṣṭaḥ | devebhiḥ | janibhiḥ | sumata'gaṇaḥ ||3||
he suhavāḥ śobhanāhvānāstvaṣṭaprabhṛtayaḥ naḥ asmān ameva sahaiva ā gantana āgacchata |
āgasya ca barhiṣi vedyāmāstīrṇe ni sadatana nipaṇṇā bhavata ||
atha anantaraṃ he tvaṣṭaḥ devebhiḥ anyairdevaiḥ janibhiḥ devapatnībhiśca sumadraṇaḥ śobhanagaṇastvam andhasaḥ somalakṣaṇasyānnasya |
somalakṣaṇamannaṃ jujuṣāṇaḥ sevamānaḥ mandasva tṛpto bhava ||

ā vāṃkṣi devā~ iha vipra yakṣi co'śanhautārni ṣadā yoniṣu triṣu | prati vīhi prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu pibāmrīdhāttvaṃ bhāgasya tṛpṇuhi || 4 || ā | vakṣi | devān | iha | vipra | yakṣi | ca | uśan | hotaḥ | ni | sada | yoniṣu | triṣu | prati | vīhi | pra'sthitam | somyam | madhu | piba | āgnīdhrāt | tava | bhāgasya | tṛpṇuhi ||4||
he <sup>v</sup>hotaḥ devānāmāhvātastvaṃ ca <sup>v</sup>uśan asmadīyaṃ kāmayamānaḥ san <sup>v</sup>triṣu <sup>v</sup>yonipu sthāneṣu gārhapatyādilakṣaṇeṣu <sup>v</sup>ni <sup>v</sup>pada' upaviśa |
upaviśya ca <sup>v</sup>prasthitaṃ homārthamuttaravediṃ prayānatītaṃ <sup>v</sup>somyaṃ somamayaṃ <sup>v</sup>madhu <sup>v</sup>prati <sup>v</sup>vīhi pratikāmayasva |
pītvā ca <sup>v</sup>tava <sup>v</sup>bhāgasya svadīyena bhāgena <sup>v</sup>tṛpnuhi tṛpto bhava |

eṣa sya tai tanvau nṛmṇavardhanaḥ saha ojaḥ pradivi bāhvarhitaḥ | tubhyaṃ suto maghavantubhyamābhṛtastvamasya brāhmaṇādā tupartipa || 5 || eṣaḥ | syaḥ | te | tanvaḥ | nṛmṇa'vardhanaḥ | sahaḥ | ojaḥ | pra'divi | bāhvaḥ | hitaḥ | tubhyam | sutaḥ | maghavan | tubhyam | ā'bhṛtaḥ | tvam | asya | brāhmaṇāt | ā | tṛpat | piba ||5||
he indra <sup>v</sup>syaḥ saḥ <sup>v</sup>epaḥ somaḥ <sup>v</sup>te tava <sup>v</sup>tanvaḥ śarīrasya <sup>v</sup>nṛmṇavardhanaḥ balasya vardhakaḥ |

yena somena <sup>v</sup>pradivi purāṇe <sup>v</sup>tvayi <sup>v</sup>bāhvoḥ hastayoḥ <sup>v</sup>sahaḥ pareṣābhibhavanalakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyam <sup>v</sup>ojaḥ tatkāraṇabhūtaṃ balaṃ ca <sup>v</sup>hitaḥ nihitaṃ bhavati |
he <sup>v</sup>maghavan dhanava- ñjindra <sup>v</sup>tubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ tādṛśaḥ somaḥ <sup>v</sup>sutaḥ adhvaryubhirabhiputaḥ |
<sup>v</sup>asya imaṃ somaṃ <sup>v</sup>brāhmaṇāt brāhmaṇācchaṃsino yāgāt <sup>v</sup>tṛpat tṛpyan <sup>v</sup>tvam <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>piba ābhimukhyena piba |
' kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ' iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt asya iti caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī |

juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ bodhataṃ havasya me sattau hotā nividaḥ pūrvyā anu | acchā rājāno narma etyāvṛtaṃ praśāstrādā pibaṃta somyaṃ madhu || 6 || juṣethām | yajñam | bodhatam | havasya | me | sattau | hotā | ni'vidaḥ | pūrvyāḥ | anu | acchā | rājānau | narmaḥ | eti | ā'vṛtam | pra'śāstrāt | ā | pibatam | somyam | madhu ||6||
udgātṛbhiḥ kṛtasya stotrasyānu- guṇyenajyādīni śastrāṇi śaṃsatītyarthaḥ |
api ca <sup>v</sup>namaḥ somalakṣaṇamannam <sup>v</sup>āvṛttam ṛtvigbhirvaiṣṭitaṃ <sup>v</sup>rājānā rājamānau yuvām <sup>v</sup>acchā ābhimukhyena <sup>v</sup>eti gacchati prāpnoti |
tādṛśaṃ <sup>v</sup>somyaṃ somamayaṃ <sup>v</sup>madhu mādakaṃ haviḥ <sup>v</sup>praśāstrāt praśāstṛryāgāt <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>pibatam ābhimukhyena pibatam |
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśe ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye dvitīyāṣṭake saptamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
dvitīyamaṇḍalasya caturthānuvāke ‘mandasva’ iti ṣaṭkaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ gārsamadam |
pūrvetra ‘ṛtavyaṃ tu jāgataṃ tu’ iti tuśabda- prayogādidamapi jāgatamṛtavyam |
daśarātre ṣaṣṭhe'hani ṛtuyājeṣu praipānatṛśiraskān kṛtvā taiḥ praipaiḥ preṣitavyaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ ca |
tatra saptamādīnāṃ praipāṇāmupariṣṭāt ‘mandasva’ ityādyāḥ ṣaṭkaḥ krameṇa prakṣepaṇīyāḥ |
mandasva hotrādanu joṣamandhaso'dhvaryavaḥ sa pūrṇā vaṣṭyāsicam | tasmāṃ etaṃ bharata tadvaśo dadirhotrātsomaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ || 1 || mandasva | hotrāt | anu | jo
va dradiḥ abhīṣṭaphalasya dātā vayo vanāma yaḥ khalu vapaśyate devatātveneṣṭa tarasmai draviṇodase vasomyaṃ somātmakaṃ vamadhu vaadhvaryubhiḥ vaprasthitaṃ praṇītamāsīt |
haṃ vadraviṇodaḥ vapotrāt poturyāgāna vaṛtubhiḥ urjasaṃjñakaiḥ saha vasomaṃ vapiba ||

medyantu te vahvayo yebhirīyase'riṣaṇyanvīḻayasva vanaspate | āyuyā dhṛṣṇo abhigūryā tvaṃ neṣṭātsomaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ || 3 || medyantu | te | vahvayaḥ | yebhiḥ | īyase | ariṣaṇyan | vīḻayasva | vanaspate | āyuyā | dhṛṣṇo iti | abhigūrya | tvam | neṣṭāt | somam | draviṇaḥ'daḥ | piba | ṛtubhiḥ || 3 ||
he vadraviṇodaḥ vayebhiḥ yairvāheḥ vaīyase prāpnopi |
he vavanaspate vanānāṃ pate vaariṣaṇyan ahiṃsan vavīḻayasva dṛḍhībhava |
he vadhṛṣṇo dharṣaka vatvam vaāyuya āgamya vaabhigūrya udyamya vaneṣṭāt neṣṭaryāṃgāt vaṛtubhiḥ sahaḥsaṃjñakaiḥ saha vasomaṃ vapiba ||

apāddhotrāduta potrādamata neṣṭādajuṣata praryo hitam | turīyaṃ pātramṛktumamartyaṃ draviṇodāḥ pibatu drāviṇodasaḥ || 4 || apāt | hotrāt | uta | potrāt | amatta | uta | neṣṭāt | ajuṣata | praryaḥ | hitam | turīyam | pātram | amṛktam | amartyam | draviṇaḥ'dāḥ | pibatu | drāviṇaḥ'dasaḥ || 4 ||
yo draviṇodāḥ ‘hotrāt hotaryāṃgāt somam vaapāt pītavān |
vauta kiṃca vapotrāt poturyāṃgāt vaamatta somaṃ pītvā amādyat |
vauta api ca vaneṣṭāt neṣṭaryāṃgāt vahitaṃ dattaṃ vaprayaḥ devānānnarūpaṃ somam vaajuṣata aseviṣṭa |
saḥ vadrāviṇodasaḥ havīrūpadraviṇasya pradātṛbhya ṛtvigbhyo hitaḥ ||
‘ṛtvijo'tra draviṇodasa ucyante haviṣo dātāraste caimaṃ janayanti’ (niru. 8. 2) iti yāskenoktatvāt ||
tādṛśaḥ vadraviṇodāḥ vaamṛktaṃ daśāpavitreṇa amṛṣṭam vaamartyam amarasādhanaṃ vaturīyaṃ vapātraṃ caturthapātrasthaṃ somaṃ vapibatu ||

arvāścamadya yuyyaṃ nuvāhaṃ rathe yuñjāthāmiha vāṃ vimocanam | puḍūṃ havīṃṣi madhunā hi kaṃ gṛthamathā somaṃ pibataṃ vājinīvasū || 5 || arvāścam | adya | yuyyam | nu'vāham | ratham | yuñjāthām | iha | vām | vi'mocanam | puḍam | havīṃṣi | madhunā | ā | hi | kam | gṛtham | atha | somam | pibatam | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vasū || 5 ||
he aśvinau ᵛadya asminnahani ᵛyadyaṃ yathi gantāraṃ ᵛnṛvāhanaṃ netroryavayovoḍhāram ᵛiha yajñe ᵛvāṃ yuvayoḥ ᵛvimocanaṃ vimocayitāraṃ ᵛratham ᵛarvāñcaṃ yathā arvāk bhavati tathā ᵛyuṣmāthām |
kiṃca ᵛmadhunā svādurasena ᵛhavīṃṣi ᵛpṛṅktaṃ saṃyojayatam |
annena vāsayitārau balavardhanau vā ᵛsomaṃ ᵛpivatam ||

joṣya̭gne ॒samidha॒ṃ joṣyāhṷtiṃ joṣi॒ brahma̭ janyaṃ joṣi̭ su॒ṣṭuti̭m | viśvḙbhi॒rviśvā̭ ṛ॒tūnā॒ṃ vaso॒ maha॒ uśa̭nde॒vā~ ṷśataḥ pā॒yayā̭ ha॒viḥ || 6 || joṣi̭ | agne | sa॒midha̭m | joṣi̭ | ā'hṷtim | joṣi̭ | brahma̭ | janya̭m | joṣi̭ | su॒ṣṭuti̭m | viśvḙbhiḥ | viśvā̭n | ṛ॒tūnā̭m | vaso॒ iti̭ | mahaḥ | u॒śan | de॒vān | u॒śata̭ḥ | pā॒yaya̭ | ha॒viḥ || 6 ||
ᵛbrahma śāstraṃ ᵛjanyaṃ janebhyo hitaṃ ᵛjoṣi jupasva |

kiṃca ᵛvaso sarvepāmāvāsabhūta he agne ᵛuśataḥ kāmayamānān ᵛmahaḥ mahataḥ ᵛviśvān sarvān ᵛdevān ᵛuśan kāmayamānastvam ᵛṛtunā tapasyasaṃjñakena saha tathā ᵛviśvebhiḥ sarvairdevaiḥ saha ᵛhaviḥ havīrūpaṃ somaṃ ᵛpāyaya ||
‘ udu pyaḥ ’ ityekādaśarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ gātsamadaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ savitṛdevatākam |
atrānukramaṇikā— ‘ udu pya ekādaśa sāvitram ’ iti |
vyūḍhe daśarātre paṣṭhe'hani vaiśvadevaśastre etatsūtaṃ sāvitranividā- nīyam |
‘ vyūhaścet ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘ paṣṭhasyodu pya deva iti gātsamadam ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 8 ) iti |

‘somāpūṣaṇā’ iti ṣaṭkamaṣṭamaṃ sūktaṃ gārhasamadaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ somāpūṣadevatākam |
somāpūṣṇe paśau vapāpuroḍāśahaviṣāmādyāstisraḥ krameṇānuvākyā uttarastisro yājyāḥ |
‘agnīṣomau’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘somāpūṣaṇā jananā rayīṇām’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||

somāpūṣaṇā jananā rayīṇāṃ jananā divo jananā pṛthivyāḥ | jātau viśvasya bhuvanasya gopau devā akṛṇvannamṛtasya nābhim || 1 || somāpūṣaṇā | jananā | rayīṇām | jananā | divaḥ | jananā | pṛthivyāḥ | jātau | viśvasya | bhuvanasya | gopau | devāḥ | akṛṇvan | amṛtasya | nābhim || 1 ||
vsomāpūṣaṇā he somāpūṣaṇau yuvāṃ vrayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ vjananā janayitārau vdivaḥ dyulokasyāpi vjananā janayitārau vpṛthivyāḥ pṛthivyāśca janayitārau bhavataḥ |
kiṃca vjātau jātamātrāveva yuvāṃ vviśvasya vbhuvanasya kṛtsnasya jagataḥ vgopau goptārau vdevāḥ vamṛtasya amarasya vnābhiṃ hetum vakṛṇvan akārpuḥ ||

somāpūṣaṇā rajaso vimānaṃ saptacakraṃ rathamiśvāminvam | viṣpavṛttaṃ manasā yujyamānaṃ taṃ jinvatho vṛṣaṇā pañcaraśmim || 3 || somāpūṣaṇā | rajasaḥ | vi'mānam | sapta'cakram | ratham | aviśva'minvam | viṣ'vṛttam | manasā | yujyamānam | tam | jinvathaḥ | vṛṣaṇā | pañca'raśmim || 3 ||
vvṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇau kāmānāṃ varṣitārau vsomāpūṣaṇā he somāpūṣaṇau vrajasaḥ lokasya |
vaviśvaminvaṃ viśvasyāparicchedyaṃ vviṣpavṛttaṃ vipvaka sarvatra parivartamānaṃ vpañcaraśmiṃ pañcaraśmim |

taṃ prasiddhaṃ rathaṃ jinnathaḥ asmānprati prerayathaḥ ||

he somāpūṣaṇau anyaḥ yuvayorekaḥ somaḥ viśvāni bhuvanā bhuvanāni bhūtāni jajāna ajanayat |
tathā ca mantraḥ—‘somaḥ pavate janitā matīnām’ (ṛ. saṃ. 9. 96. 5) iti |
anyaḥ aparaḥ pūṣā ādityaḥ viśvam abhicakṣāṇaḥ abhipaśyan eti gacchati |

ᵥpūṣā ādityaḥ ᵥviśvamanvaḥ viśvasya prīṇayitā ᵥdhriyam asmākaṃ karma ᵥjinvatu tarpayatu |
ᵥrayipatiḥ dhanapatiḥ ᵥsomaḥ ᵥrayiṃ dhanaṃ ᵥdhadhātu asmabhyaṃ dadātu |
kiṃca ᵥdevī dyotamānā ᵥanarvā apracyutā kenāpi prātikūlyamaprāpitā ᵥaditiḥ ᵥacatu asmān rakṣatu |
‘vāyo ye te’ ityekaviṃśatyṛcaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ gāsramadaṃ gāyatram |
‘ambitame’ iti ṣaṣṭhasya tṛcasya ādito dve anuṣṭubhau tṛtīyā bṛhatī |
‘vāyo ye te’ ityādi ke dve ṛcau vāyavyau |
‘ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā’ iti pañcānāṃ tṛcānāṃ mitrāvaruṇau aśvinau indraḥ viśve devāḥ sarasvatī iti krameṇa devatāḥ |
‘pretāṃ yajñasya’ ityasyamṛco brāhmaṇasūtrayorvidhānapravartane dyāvāpṛthivyanividvānatvena ca viniyuktatvāt dyāvāpṛthivyo havirdhānadevatyo vā |
‘agniṃ ca havya- vāhanam’ iti pādo'pridevatyo vā |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- ‘vāyo saikā gāyatramuktā devatāḥ praugeṇādhe tu tṛce'nyaindravāyavī dyāvāpṛthivyo'nyastṛco hāvirdhāno vā tṛtīyaḥ pādo vāyavyo'mbitame'nuṣṭubhau bṛhatī ca’ iti |

vāyavyatṛcasya ‘vāyo ye te sahasriṇaḥ’ ityādye dve ṛcau aindravāyavatṛcasya ‘śukrasyādha’ ityeṣā ca sūtritaṃ- ‘vāyo ye te sahasriṇa iti tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahītyekobhā devā divispṛśeti dve śukrasyādha gavāśira ityekāyaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇeti pañca tṛcāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 6) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani prātaḥ- savane maitrāvaruṇaśastre ‘ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā’ iti paḻahastonitrasaṃjñakaḥ |
‘caturviṃśe hotājaniṣṭa’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā pururuṇā cidvayasti’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti |
‘ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā no mitrāvaruṇeti tṛcāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti sūtritatvāt |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘maitrāvaruṇasya ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti |
prātaranuvākāśvinaśastrayogyāntre chandasi ‘gomada pu’ iti tṛco viniyuktaḥ |
‘gomad pu nāsyeti tṛcāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti sūtritatvāt |
atirātre prathame paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsi- śastre ‘indro aṅga mahaddhayam’ iti tṛcaḥ |
‘atirātre paryāyāṇām’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘indro aṅga mahaddhayamabhi nyū pu vācam’ (āśva. śrau. 6.4) iti |
‘āgrayaṇam’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘viśve devāsa ā gata ye ke ca jmā mahino ahimāyāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 9) iti |
daśarātre prathame'hani praugaśastre ‘ambitame nadītame’ iti sārasvataḥ saptamastṛcaḥ |
‘caturthe'hani’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘ambitame nadītama ityānuṣṭubhaṃ praugam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 11) iti |
vyūḍhe daśarātre prathame chandome vaiśvadevaśastre ‘pretāṃ yajñasya śaṃbhuvā’ iti dyāvāpṛthivyanividvānīyatṛcaḥ |
‘atha chandomāḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘pretāṃ yajñasya śaṃbhuvāyaṃ devāya janman iti tṛcāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 9) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘pretāṃ yajñasya śaṃbhuvā yame hava yatamāne yadaitam’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 9; ai. brā. 1. 29) iti ||

kiṃca ᵛkā ᵛcidabhibhā ko'pyabhibhavaḥ ᵛtvā tvāṃ ᵛvibhvyā viśvataḥ sarvāsu dikṣu ᵛmā ᵛvidan mā prāpat|
‘śakuniḥ śakkotyuttetumātmānam’; ᵛnyakrandījanama prabhuvāṇo yathāsya śabdastathā nāmeryati vācamīrayiteva nāvam|
sumaṅgalaśca śakune bhava kalyāṇamaṅkalaṃ giraterguṇātyarthe giratyanarthāniti vā’ (niru. 9. 3; 4) iti yāskaḥ ||
mā tvāṃ śyena udvadhīnmā tvāṃ supaṇoṃ mā tvāṃ vidadiṣumānvīro astā|

he śakune ᵛtvā tvāṃ ᵛśyenaḥ prabalaḥ¹ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ ᵛmā ᵛvadhīt mā hiṃsīt|
uta² api ca ᵛsuparṇaḥ garuḍaḥ pakṣī ᵛmā vadhīt²|
tathā ᵛiṣumān bāṇavān ᵛvīro ᵛastā śarāṇāṃ kṣeptā dhanvī ᵛtvā tvāṃ ᵛmā ᵛvidat mā prāpat³|

ᵛkaniṛdat punaḥpunaḥ śabdaṃ kurvan ᵛsumaṅgalaḥ kalyāṇamaṅgalaḥ ᵛbhadravādī śobhanavādī san ᵛiha asma-dviṣaye ᵛvada maṅgalaṃ sūcaya ||
arva kranda dakṣiṇato gṛhāṇāṃ sumaṅgalau bhadravādī śakunte|
mā naḥ stena īśat māghaśaṃso bṛhadema vidathai suvīrāḥ ||
arva | kranda | dakṣiṇataḥ | gṛhāṇām | su'maṅgalaḥ | bhadra'vādī | śakunte | mā | naḥ | stenaḥ | īśat | mā | agha'śaṃsaḥ | bṛhat | vadema | vidathai | su'vīrāḥ || 3 ||
ᵛśakunte he kapiñjala tvaṃ ᵛsumaṅgalau ᵛbhadravādī ca san ᵛgṛhāṇāṃ ᵛdakṣiṇataḥ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi ᵛava ᵛkranda śabdaṃ kuru|
ᵛnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵛstenaḥ taskaraḥ ᵛmā ᵛīśata meśiṣṭa|
vayasāmamanojñāṃ vācaṃ śrutvā ‘pradakṣiṇit’ iti sūktaṃ japet|

pradakṣiṇidbhi gṛṇanti kāravo vayo vadanta ṛtuthā śakunteyaḥ | ubhe vācau vadati sāmagāiva gāyatraṃ ca traiṣṭubhaṃ cānu rājati || 1 || pra'dakṣiṇit | abhi | gṛṇanti | kāravaḥ | vayaḥ | vadantaḥ | ṛtu'thā | śakunteyaḥ | ubhe iti | vācau | vadati | sāmagā'iva | gāyatram | ca | traiṣṭubham | ca | anu | rājati ||1||
ṛtuthā kālekāle vayaḥ akṣaṃ vadantaḥ sūcayantaḥ |
kāravaḥ stotāra iva pradakṣiṇit pradakṣiṇam abhi gṛṇanti abhivadantu |
kiṃca ubhe vācau gānaṃ ca śrautaṃ ca sāmagāḥ gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ ca sāmanī iva śakuntiḥ vadati |

udgāteva śakune sāma gāyasi brahmaputraiva sarvaneṣu śaṃsasi | vṛṣaiva vājī śiśumatīrapītyā sarvatau naḥ śakune bhadramā vada viśvato naḥ śakune puṇyamā vada || 2 || udgātā'iva | śakune | sāma | gāyasi | brahmaputraḥ'iva | sarvaneṣu | śaṃsasi | vṛṣā'iva | vājī | śiśu'matīḥ | api'itya | sarvataḥ | naḥ | śakune | bhadram | ā | vada | viśvataḥ | naḥ | śakune | puṇyam | ā | vada || 2 ||
śakune he kapiñjala udgāteva sāma yathodgātā sāma gāyati tathā tvaṃ gāyasi gānasvanaṃ karoṣi |
brahmaputraiva yathā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī savaneṣu śastrāṇi śaṃsati tathā tvaṃ kāleṣu śaṃsasi śrautasvaraṃ karoṣi |
apītya abhigatya yathā śabdaṃ karoti tathā tvamapi vada |
